AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种统一的生成式八叉树Transformer架构（GAAFormer），通过几何锚定注意力机制，成功同时解决了点云去噪和上采样两个经典难题，且无需针对特定任务重新设计或增加参数量，在多个标准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: HermiteTwin: Bicubic Hermite Shell Digital Twins for Contact-Rich Deformable Manipulation
summary: While existing methods for reconstructing deformable object manipulation have made impressive progress, they typically represent a thin object with a single particle set that must serve two purposes at once: modeling bending, and resolving contact with the robot. To bridge this gap, we present HermiteTwin, a framework that reconstructs a physical digital twin of a thin deformable object from multiview video of a robot manipulating it. Our key idea is to represent deformation and contact separately, each at its own resolution. The object is simulated as a bicubic Hermite shell, a coarse grid of $C^1$ elements whose nodal positions and derivatives define a smooth surface with Kirchhoff--Love bending, while the gripper acts through dense samples in material space that are captured, clamped, and released, and whose attachment forces reach the shell through the Hermite basis. This decoupling keeps the physical state compact while contact stays fine-grained. We identify effective material and contact parameters with CMA-ES followed by adjoint-based refinement, and drive a reconstructed Gaussian appearance model with the simulated shell. In experiments on real cloth and foam manipulation, HermiteTwin outperforms the state-of-the-art spring--mass twin across reconstruction, resimulation, and future prediction.

AI.title_translation: HermiteTwin：用于接触丰富可变形操作的双三次 Hermite 壳数字孪生
AI.tldr: HermiteTwin 是一种通过解耦形变与接触来构建薄型可变形物体数字孪生的框架，利用双三次 Hermite 壳和密集接触采样，实现了优于现有方法的重建和预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常用单个粒子集同时表示薄物体的弯曲和接触解析，这在处理接触丰富的可变形物体操作时存在局限性，难以同时兼顾全局弯曲和精细接触。
AI.method: 提出 HermiteTwin 框架，将物体模拟为双三次 Hermite 壳以实现光滑表面和 Kirchhoff-Love 弯曲，同时通过材料空间中的密集样本处理夹持器接触，并通过 CMA-ES 和基于伴随的方法识别材料与接触参数，最后结合高斯外观模型。
AI.result: 在真实布料和泡沫操作的实验中，HermiteTwin 在重建、重仿真和未来预测三个方面均优于现有的先进质点-弹簧数字孪生方法。
AI.conclusion: HermiteTwin 框架通过解耦形变与接触，实现了对薄型可变形物体（如布料和泡沫）的高精度物理数字孪生重建、重仿真和未来预测。
AI.translation: 尽管现有的可变形物体操作重建方法取得了令人瞩目的进展，但它们通常用单个粒子集来表示薄物体，必须同时满足两个目的：建模弯曲和解决与机器人的接触。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 HermiteTwin，这是一个从机器人操纵它的多视角视频中重建薄可变形物体物理数字孪生的框架。我们的核心思想是将形变和接触分开表示，分别处于各自的分辨率。物体被模拟为一个双三次 Hermite 壳，这是一个由 $C^1$ 元素组成的粗网格，其节点位置和导数定义了一个具有 Kirchhoff-Love 弯曲的光滑表面；而抓取器则通过材料空间中的密集样本起作用，这些样本被捕获、夹紧和释放，其附着力通过 Hermite 基底传递到壳上。这种解耦保持了物理状态的紧凑性，同时使接触保持细粒度。我们首先通过 CMA-ES 识别有效的材料和接触参数，然后进行基于伴随的求精，并用模拟的壳驱动重建的高斯外观模型。在对真实布料和泡沫操作的实验中，HermiteTwin 在重建、重仿真和未来预测方面均优于最先进的质点-弹簧孪生模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 HermiteTwin，一种用于接触丰富可变形操纵的双三次 Hermite 壳数字孪生框架。该方法通过将粗网格的 Hermite 壳用于弯曲形变建模、密集样本用于精细接触解析进行解耦，利用优化算法识别物理参数，并在真实实验中证明了其优于传统质点弹簧模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 数字孪生, 可变形物体操作, 双三次 Hermite 壳, 物理模拟, 接触建模
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了解耦形变建模与接触解析的双分辨率方法（HermiteTwin），使用双三次 Hermite 壳模拟薄物体的弯曲，并通过密集采样处理精细接触，显著优于传统的质点弹簧模型。

title: DermKG: A Concept-Centric Knowledge Graph for Interpretable Skin Disease Diagnosis from Dermatological Morphology
summary: Dermatologists describe lesions with a standardized morphological lexicon, which makes concept-based models attractive for interpretable skin disease diagnosis. How much diagnostic information these concepts actually carry, however, is rarely quantified. We present DermKG, a concept-centric knowledge graph built on the expert-annotated SkinCon subset of Fitzpatrick17k (3,230 images, 48 concepts, 113 diseases). DermKG has 3,452 nodes of 8 types and 19,365 edges of 11 relation types, and encodes disease concept profiles, concept co-occurrence, a three-level diagnostic hierarchy, and 20 clinical morphology rules, all of which are supported by the training data (15 strong, 5 moderate). An information-ceiling analysis shows that the 3,230 lesions collapse onto only 813 distinct concept vectors, bounding concept-only top-1 accuracy at 38.9\% for diseases and 77.6\% for the nine categories. Within this bound, DermKG-Net, a graph neural network that scores lesions against disease prototypes and aggregates them along the hierarchy, raises category-level balanced accuracy from 0.257 to 0.411 over the strongest of 11 baselines (paired bootstrap difference $+0.150$, 95\% CI $[0.073, 0.231]$) and more than doubles minority-category recall. Ablations show that most of this gain comes from the hierarchical prototype objective, with a smaller contribution from graph structure. DermKG further yields rule-based reasoning chains and concept-level explanations for individual predictions.

AI.title_translation: DermKG：一个用于基于皮肤形态学进行可解释皮肤病诊断的概念中心知识图谱
AI.tldr: 本文提出了DermKG知识图谱与DermKG-Net模型，利用皮肤形态学概念和层次结构实现了高可解释性且性能更优的皮肤病诊断。
AI.motivation: 皮肤科医生使用标准化的形态学术语描述病变，使得基于概念的模型对可解释皮肤病诊断极具吸引力，但这些概念实际承载的诊断信息量很少被量化，且缺乏一个全面整合概念、层级和规则的知识库。
AI.method: 构建了包含多种节点和边的知识图谱DermKG，并提出了DermKG-Net图神经网络，通过评分病变与疾病原型并沿层次结构进行聚合来进行诊断，同时结合了信息上限分析和消融实验。
AI.result: 信息上限分析显示纯概念的top-1准确率受限；DermKG-Net将类别级平衡准确率从0.257提升至0.411，并将少数类别的召回率提高了一倍以上，同时还能提供基于规则的推理链和概念级解释。
AI.conclusion: DermKG及其关联网络DermKG-Net通过利用形态学概念、知识图谱和分层推理，显著提升了可解释皮肤病诊断的性能，特别是对少数类别的召回率，同时揭示了纯概念诊断的信息上限。
AI.translation: 皮肤科医生用标准化的形态学词汇来描述皮损，这使得基于概念的模型对可解释的皮肤病诊断具有吸引力。然而，这些概念实际承载了多少诊断信息却很少被量化。我们提出了DermKG，这是一个建立在Fitzpatrick17k的专家注释SkinCon子集（3,230张图像，48个概念，113种疾病）之上的概念中心知识图谱。DermKG拥有来自8种类型的3,452个节点和来自11种关系类型的19,365条边，编码了疾病概念配置文件、概念共现、三级诊断层次结构以及20条临床形态学规则，所有这些都得到训练数据的支持（15条强，5条中）。信息上限分析表明，3,230个皮损仅折叠到813个不同的概念向量上，将仅基于概念的top-1准确率限制在疾病的38.9%和9个类别的77.6%。在此界限内，DermKG-Net是一个图神经网络，它对照疾病原型对皮损进行评分并沿层次结构进行聚合，在11个最强基线中，将类别级平衡准确率从0.257提高到0.411（配对自助法差异+0.150，95% CI [0.073, 0.231]），并且使少数类别的召回率翻倍以上。消融实验表明，大部分增益来自于分层原型目标，图结构的贡献较小。DermKG进一步为个别预测产生了基于规则的推理链和概念级解释。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了DermKG，一个基于专家注释数据构建的概念中心皮肤病知识图谱，并开发了DermKG-Net图神经网络模型，有效提升了皮肤病诊断的准确性、少数类召回率及模型的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱, 可解释皮肤病诊断, 皮肤形态学, 图神经网络, 临床规则
AI.comments: 该论文构建了首个针对皮肤病形态学的概念中心知识图谱DermKG，并提出了DermKG-Net，显著提升了皮肤病诊断的可解释性和分类性能，具有很高的临床应用价值和研究创新性。

title: SIR-Agent: Skill-Augmented Image Restoration Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Agents for Image Restoration (IR) aim to leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to autonomously perceive image degradation and invoke IR tools. However, existing IR agents typically rely on fine-tuning MLLM parameters to adapt to new IR tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting of IR knowledge. To address this limitation, we propose a skill-augmented IR agent, dubbed SIR-Agent, that maintains IR knowledge in a scalable skill library and uses Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) to facilitate efficient skill-library evolution. Specifically, we design a Chain Feedback-driven Skill Revision (CFSR) to evolve the skill library. The CFSR analyzes restoration chains to identify and revise weak operations in existing skills. The compatibility of a revised skill with known tasks decides if it replaces the original skill or is appended independently. Furthermore, to advance CFSR's skill-library evolution, we present an RSI-driven skill meta-learning mechanism, which identifies CFSR's inefficient operations and autonomously refines its revision strategy. Extensive experiments across 14 IR benchmarks, covering 6 single-degradation and 8 mixed-degradation scenarios, demonstrate SIR-Agent's superior IR performance. Further evaluation on 7 unseen tasks validates SIR-Agent's generalization to new IR tasks.

AI.title_translation: SIR-Agent：具有递归自我改进功能的技能增强图像恢复智能体
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 SIR-Agent 的图像恢复智能体，利用可扩展的技能库和递归自我改进机制，在避免灾难性遗忘的同时实现了卓越的图像恢复性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像恢复（IR）智能体通常依赖于微调多模态大模型（MLLMs）的参数来适应新的 IR 任务，这会导致 IR 知识的灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出 SIR-Agent，采用可扩展的技能库存储图像恢复知识，并通过链式反馈驱动的技能修订（CFSR）和递归自我改进（RSI）驱动的技能元学习机制来演化技能库。
AI.result: 在涵盖6种单一退化和8种混合退化的14个 IR 基准测试中表现出优异的性能，并且在7个未见任务上的评估验证了其对新任务的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SIR-Agent 通过技能增强和递归自我改进，有效解决了图像恢复代理中的灾难性遗忘问题，在多个基准测试和未见任务上取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 图像恢复（IR）智能体旨在利用多模态大模型（MLLMs）自主感知图像退化并调用 IR 工具。然而，现有的 IR 智能体通常依赖于微调 MLLM 参数来适应新的 IR 任务，导致 IR 知识的灾难性遗忘。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一个技能增强的 IR 智能体，被称为 SIR-Agent，它在可扩展的技能库中维护 IR 知识，并使用递归自我改进（RSI）来促进高效的技能库演化。具体而言，我们设计了链式反馈驱动的技能修订（CFSR）来演化技能库。CFSR 分析恢复链以识别和修订现有技能中的薄弱操作。修订后的技能与已知任务的兼容性决定了它是替换原始技能还是独立追加。此外，为了推进 CFSR 的技能库演化，我们提出了一个 RSI 驱动的技能元学习机制，该机制识别 CFSR 的低效操作并自主细化其修订策略。在涵盖 6 种单一退化和 8 种混合退化场景的 14 个 IR 基准测试上的大量实验证明了 SIR-Agent 卓越的 IR 性能。对 7 个未见任务的进一步评估验证了 SIR-Agent 对新 IR 任务的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SIR-Agent，这是一种结合了技能库与递归自我改进机制的图像恢复智能体。通过链式反馈驱动的技能修订和递归自我改进的元学习机制，SIR-Agent 能够在不微调模型参数的情况下有效演化恢复技能，在多个基准测试和未见任务中展现出卓越的性能和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 图像恢复, 多模态大模型, 智能体, 技能库, 递归自我改进
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了技能库与递归自我改进机制，避免了微调多模态大模型带来的灾难性遗忘问题，在图像恢复任务中表现出优异的性能和泛化能力。

title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
summary: Current large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to forecast real-world events. This stems from two primary limitations: i) standard ReAct harness accumulates reasoning and evidence within one growing context, and ii) outcome-based rewards in forecasting lead to a slow and noisy signal that cannot distinguish sound reasoning from lucky guesses. To address these, we introduce a forecasting training framework including harness design and post-training. For the harness side, we propose Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM), equipping agents with a fold tool to compress lengthy context into compact belief states and reset the context for subsequent exploration. For the training side, we develop SEIPH, a five-dimensional, outcome-blind rubric, providing process-quality rewards. Using the rubric-based reward, we post-train a 35B model with PPO and GRPO, yielding DeepForecaster-PPO and DeepForecaster-GRPO. Theoretically, we prove that idealized fold-based stopping converges and calibrated local rewards reduce segment-level gradient variance. Empirically, DeepForecaster-PPO (35B) achieves the best Brier score on both ForecastBench and Polymarket-Sim, outperforming frontier agents based on DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T), Kimi-K2.6 (1T), and GPT-5.5. DeepForecaster-GRPO ranks second on both FutureX metrics. Ablations reveal that PBM also improves the untrained base model without any training. Calibration analysis shows that DeepForecaster-PPO makes more accurate high-confidence predictions than Qwen3.6 and GPT-5.5. Trajectory analysis further shows that forecasts generally improve from the first to the final belief state as agents gather evidence and revise their judgments.

AI.title_translation: 信念状态管理与量规奖励在智能体预测中的结合
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合信念状态管理（PBM）与过程奖励（SEIPH）的智能体预测框架DeepForecaster，显著提升了大模型在现实事件预测中的表现。
AI.motivation: 解决当前大语言模型智能体在现实预测中面临的标准ReAct框架累积上下文导致的混乱，以及基于结果的奖励信号缓慢且充满噪声、无法区分合理推理与幸运猜测的两大核心局限。
AI.method: 提出Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM)折叠工具压缩长上下文，并开发五维结果无关量规（SEIPH）提供过程质量奖励，使用PPO和GRPO对35B模型进行后训练。
AI.result: DeepForecaster-PPO (35B)在ForecastBench和Polymarket-Sim上取得了最佳Brier分数，表现超越了多个1T量级以上的行业前沿大模型。
AI.conclusion: 结合PBM推理框架与SEIPH过程奖励的DeepForecaster在多个预测基准测试中超越了许多参数量远超自身的顶级大模型，证明了信念状态压缩和过程奖励在智能体预测中的有效性。
AI.translation: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在预测真实世界事件时仍然面临困难。这主要源于两个局限性：i）标准的ReAct框架在不断增长的单一上下文中累积推理和证据，ii）预测中的基于结果的奖励会导致缓慢且嘈杂的信号，无法区分健全的推理与幸运的猜测。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了一个包含框架设计和后训练的预测训练框架。在框架设计方面，我们提出了主动信念状态管理（PBM），为智能体配备了一个折叠工具，将冗长的上下文压缩为紧凑的信念状态，并重置后续探索的上下文。在训练方面，我们开发了SEIPH，这是一个五维度的、与结果无关的量规，可提供过程质量奖励。利用基于量规的奖励，我们使用PPO和GRPO对一个35B模型进行了后训练，得到了DeepForecaster-PPO和DeepForecaster-GRPO。在理论上，我们证明了理想的基于折叠的停止机制是收敛的，并且校准的局部奖励减少了段落级梯度方差。在实证上，DeepForecaster-PPO（35B）在ForecastBench和Polymarket-Sim上均实现了最佳的Brier分数，表现优于基于DeepSeek-V4-Pro（1.6T）、Kimi-K2.6（1T）和GPT-5.5的前沿智能体。DeepForecaster-GRPO在两个FutureX指标上排名第二。消融实验表明，PBM在没有任何训练的情况下也能改善未训练的基底模型。校准分析表明，DeepForecaster-PPO比Qwen3.6和GPT-5.5做出更准确的高置信度预测。轨迹分析进一步表明，随着智能体收集证据并修正其判断，预测结果通常从第一个信念状态到最终信念状态不断改善。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型智能体在预测任务上的不足，提出了结合PBM上下文折叠管理与SEIPH过程量规奖励的DeepForecaster训练框架，在理论和实证上均证明了其能有效提升智能体预测的准确性与校准度。
AI.keywords: 大模型智能体, 预测, 信念状态管理, 过程奖励, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型智能体在现实世界预测中的局限性，创新性地提出了主动信念状态管理（PBM）和基于五维结果无关量规的奖励机制（SEIPH），在保持长文本有效探索的同时提供了密集且高质量的过程监督信号，显著提升了预测模型的准确性和校准性。

title: GRADPlace: Geometry-Based Routing-Augmented Differentiable Placement for Routability Optimization
summary: Routability-driven placement needs gradients that show how cell movement redistributes routing demand. Cell inflation exploits routing feedback only indirectly, and differentiable methods rely on black-box congestion predictors or on virtual-cell congestion fields frozen between routing updates. We present GRADPlace, which represents probability-weighted candidate routes as movable horizontal and vertical segments. Routing feedback sets their probabilities, while their geometry and expected demand evolve with cell coordinates. An electrostatic routing objective propagates gradients through this geometry to connected cells, complementing cell inflation. On the ISPD 2015 benchmarks, our reproduced Xplace-route and published DCGP results have on average 3.37x and 2.56x as many design-rule violations as GRADPlace, with more vias and comparable routed wirelength.

AI.title_translation: GRADPlace：基于几何路由增强的可微分布线性优化布局方法
AI.tldr: GRADPlace是一种新型的可微分布局方法，通过将候选路由建模为可移动线段并引入静电路由目标，显著减少了芯片布局中的设计规则违例（DRV）。
AI.motivation: 现有的布线性驱动布局方法存在局限性，单元膨胀仅能间接利用路由反馈，而现有可微分方法则依赖于黑盒拥塞预测器或在路由更新之间保持不变的虚拟单元拥塞场，缺乏直接且实时的梯度引导。
AI.method: 提出GRADPlace，将概率加权候选路由表示为可移动的水平和垂直线段，其概率由路由反馈设定，几何形状和预期需求随单元坐标演化，并通过静电路由目标将梯度传播到相连单元。
AI.result: 在ISPD 2015基准测试中，与复现的Xplace-route和已发表的DCGP结果相比，GRADPlace的设计规则违例（DRV）平均分别减少到它们的1/3.37和1/2.56，同时具有更多通孔且布线线长相当。
AI.conclusion: GRADPlace通过结合概率加权候选路由和静电路由目标，实现了高效的布线性优化，在减少设计规则违例方面显著优于Xplace-route和DCGP。
AI.translation: 布线性驱动的布局需要能够显示单元移动如何重新分配布线需求的梯度。单元膨胀仅间接利用路由反馈，而可微分方法则依赖于黑盒拥塞预测器或在路由更新之间冻结的虚拟单元拥塞场。我们提出了GRADPlace，它将概率加权的候选路线表示为可移动的水平和垂直线段。路由反馈设定其概率，而其几何形状和预期需求随单元坐标演化。静电路由目标通过该几何形状将梯度传播到相连的单元，从而补充了单元膨胀。在ISPD 2015基准测试中，我们复现的Xplace-route和已发表的DCGP结果的设计规则违例平均分别为GRADPlace的3.37倍和2.56倍，且具有更多通孔和相当的布线线长。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GRADPlace，一种基于几何与路由增强的可微分布局方法。它通过将概率加权的候选路由表示为可移动线段，并引入静电路由目标将梯度直接传播至单元，从而实现了优异的布线性优化，在ISPD 2015基准测试中大幅减少了设计规则违例。
AI.keywords: 可微分布局, 布线性优化, 几何路由, 静电路由目标, 单元膨胀
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于几何和路由增强的可微分布局方法（GRADPlace），创新性地将候选路由表示为可移动的线段，并利用静电路由目标直接将梯度传播至相连单元，有效解决了传统方法中路由反馈滞后或间接的问题，在ISPD 2015基准测试中显著减少了设计规则违例（DRV）。

title: Preserving Pretrained CFG Structure in RL for Diffusion Models with Conditional Contrast Regularization
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important component in the post-training of diffusion models. In practice, however, standard RL often improves the target reward without reliably preserving holistic generation quality, leading to unstable reward-quality trade-offs that we view as a form of reward hacking. Since Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is known to improve visual clarity, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality in generation, we investigate whether its underlying structure can serve as a useful prior during RL. We present a unified geometric view that interprets both CFG and RL as correction vectors in a common prediction space, and identify the projection of the RL-induced correction onto the pretrained CFG correction as a useful diagnostic of quality-related structural preservation. Geometric analysis and rotation intervention further show that the pretrained CFG direction carries information useful for generation quality that reward-driven RL updates do not necessarily preserve. Based on this insight, we propose Conditional Contrast Regularization (CCR), which uses the frozen reference model's conditional contrast as a local structural prior during RL. Experiments across multiple reward settings and backbones show that CCR more consistently preserves generation quality while maintaining competitive reward, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than standard RL and generic regularization methods.

AI.title_translation: 利用条件对比正则化在扩散模型强化学习中保持预训练CFG结构
AI.tldr: 本文提出了条件对比正则化（CCR），通过利用预训练CFG的结构先验，解决了扩散模型强化学习中的奖励作弊和生成质量下降问题。
AI.motivation: 标准强化学习（RL）在扩散模型的后训练阶段容易导致奖励作弊，无法可靠地保持整体生成质量，从而产生不稳定的奖励-质量平衡。
AI.method: 提出条件对比正则化（CCR），利用冻结参考模型的条件对比作为RL过程中的局部结构先验，并在预测空间中统一了CFG与RL。
AI.result: 在多种奖励设置和骨干网络上的实验表明，CCR能够更稳定地保持生成质量并保持竞争力的奖励，优于标准RL和通用正则化方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将冻结参考模型的条件对比作为局部结构先验，所提出的CCR方法在扩散模型的RL后训练中实现了奖励提升与生成质量保持的最佳平衡。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）已成为扩散模型后训练的重要组成部分。然而在实践中，标准RL往往在提高目标奖励的同时无法可靠地保持整体生成质量，导致不稳定的奖励-质量权衡，我们将其视为一种奖励作弊。由于分类器自由引导（CFG）已知能提高生成的视觉清晰度、提示词对齐和感知质量，我们研究了其底层结构是否可以作为RL期间有用的先验。我们提出了一种统一的几何视角，将CFG和RL都解释为公共预测空间中的校正向量，并确定了RL引起的校正投影到预训练CFG校正上的作用，以此作为质量相关结构保持的有用诊断。几何分析和旋转intervention（干预）进一步表明，预训练的CFG方向携带了对生成质量有用但受奖励驱动的RL更新不一定能保持的信息。基于这一见解，我们提出了条件对比正则化（CCR），它在RL期间使用冻结参考模型的条件对比作为局部结构先验。在多个奖励设置和骨干网络上的实验表明，CCR能够更一致地保持生成质量，同时保持有竞争力的奖励，比标准RL和通用正则化方法产生更好的奖励-质量权衡。
AI.summary: 论文针对扩散模型强化学习中常见的奖励作弊和生成质量退化问题，提出了一种名为条件对比正则化（CCR）的方法。该方法通过在预测空间中结合预训练的分类器自由引导（CFG）结构作为局部先验，实现了在优化奖励的同时更好地保持生成质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 强化学习, 分类器自由引导, 条件对比正则化, 奖励作弊
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将分类器自由引导（CFG）与强化学习（RL）在预测空间中进行几何统一，并提出了条件对比正则化（CCR），有效解决了扩散模型RL后训练中的奖励作弊和生成质量退化问题。

title: InterBand-EMG: A Cross-Band Foundation Model for Generalizable Hand-Pose Estimation
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.title_translation: InterBand-EMG：用于可泛化手部姿态估计的跨频段基础模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了InterBand-EMG模型和SynapMyo数据集，有效提高了表面肌电图手部姿态估计的跨用户和跨动作泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电图（sEMG）虽然能够实现连续的手部姿态估计，但学习能够跨用户和跨动作泛化的高效表征依然充满挑战。
AI.method: 提出InterBand-EMG模型，结合了频段特定量化、跨频段重建以及结构化掩码代码预测；同时构建了包含499名用户、1227.74小时数据的SynapMyo数据集。
AI.result: 在emg2pose和SynapMyo数据集上的实验表明，InterBand-EMG在三个泛化设置下的关节角度准确率均优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: InterBand-EMG通过跨频段表征学习和大规模数据集SynapMyo，有效解决了sEMG在手部姿态估计中的泛化难题，实验表现优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.translation: 表面肌电图（sEMG）能够实现连续的手部姿态估计，但学习能够跨用户和跨动作泛化的表征仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍了InterBand-EMG，它结合了频段特定的量化与跨频段重建以及结构化掩码代码预测，以学习用于手部姿态跟踪的可迁移EMG表征。我们还介绍了SynapMyo，这是一个包含499名用户、68个动作类别、共计1227.74小时手部运动的八通道EMG到姿态数据集。在emg2pose和SynapMyo上的实验表明，InterBand-EMG在两个数据集的所有三个泛化设置下的关节角度准确率均优于最先进的基线方法。本研究的源代码和SynapMyo数据集将在论文被接收后公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了InterBand-EMG，一个用于手部姿态估计的跨频段肌电信号基础模型，它通过频段量化、跨频段重建和掩码代码预测来学习可迁移的表征。同时，作者还推出了包含大量用户和动作类别的SynapMyo数据集，实验证明该模型在关节角度准确率上超越了现有先进方法。
AI.keywords: 表面肌电图, 手部姿态估计, 基础模型, 跨频段表征, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 本文提出了InterBand-EMG基础模型和SynapMyo大规模数据集，创新性地结合了频段量化与跨频段重建，显著提升了肌电信号手势估计的跨用户和跨动作泛化能力。

title: EgoLAM: Learning Latent Actions from Hand and Head Motion
summary: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. Alongside LARYBench classification and regression, we measure how much wrist motion a frozen code retains and how strongly it responds to a synthetic view or lighting change. EgoLAM has the highest hand-motion decoding score among eight evaluated models. Across three LIBERO suites, policies pretrained on its codes and fine-tuned on expert demonstrations achieve 79.38% mean success, 28.73 points above expert behavior cloning and 9.76 points above the strongest other latent action model in each suite on average.

AI.title_translation: EgoLAM：从手部和头部运动中学习隐式动作
AI.tldr: EgoLAM通过解耦第一人称视角下的相机运动和手部操作，从视频中学习精确的隐式动作，显著提升了机器人学习的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的隐式动作模型在处理第一人称视角（egocentric）视频时，无法区分是因为手部推动物体还是因为佩戴者转头导致的画面变化，从而混淆了真正的操作与单纯的相机运动。
AI.method: EgoLAM在训练期间利用测得的手腕运动监督动作代码，并将相机运动单独提供给前向模型；动作编码器围绕每只手汇聚物体槽位，并可以在公共参考系统中从代码中解码出手腕的平移和旋转。
AI.result: EgoLAM在八个评估模型中获得了最高的手腕运动解码分数；在三个LIBERO套件中，基于其代码预训练并经专家示范微调的策略平均成功率达到79.38%，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EgoLAM通过解耦手部和相机运动，成功从第一人称视角视频中学习到精确的隐式动作，显著提升了机器人策略预训练的性能。
AI.translation: 隐式动作模型允许机器人策略通过将两帧之间的变化转化为训练目标来从视频中学习。在第一人称视角视频中，杯子在图像中移动可能是因为手推它，也可能是因为佩戴者转头。这两种变化都有助于预测下一帧，但只有第一种描述了操作。在训练期间，EgoLAM用测得的手腕运动监督动作代码，并将相机运动单独提供给前向模型。即使佩戴者在推杯子时转头，训练目标仍然描述了手是如何推它的。动作编码器汇聚每只手周围的物体槽位，并且可以在公共参考坐标系中从代码中解码出手腕的平移和旋转。提取代码因此只需要两帧RGB图像。除了LARYBench分类和回归之外，我们还测量了冻结代码保留的手腕运动量，以及它对合成视图或光照变化的响应强度。EgoLAM在八个评估模型中拥有最高的手腕运动解码分数。在三个LIBERO套件中，在其代码上预训练并经专家示范微调的策略达到了79.38%的平均成功率，比专家行为克隆高出28.73个百分点，比每个套件中最强的其他隐式动作模型平均高出9.76个百分点。
AI.summary: EgoLAM是一种从手部和头部运动中学习隐式动作的模型。通过将手部操作引起的视觉变化与相机转动引起的视觉变化分离，EgoLAM能够仅从两帧RGB图像中提取出精准描述手部操作的隐式动作代码，从而大幅提升机器人策略的预训练效果和操作成功率。
AI.keywords: 隐式动作模型, 具身智能, 第一人称视频, 机器人操作, 视觉表征学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的EgoLAM模型，通过结合手部和头部运动来学习隐式动作，成功解决了传统隐式动作模型无法区分相机运动与物体操作的痛点。其在LIBERO套件上的出色表现证明了其在机器人模仿学习中的巨大潜力。

title: Two-phase visco-elastic FENE-P model: Thermodynamically consistent modeling, sharp interface limit analysis and unconditionally energy stable numerical scheme
summary: Although mathematical modeling and numerical simulations for two-phase Newtonian flows have been extensively studied for many years, relatively little work has focused on developing thermodynamically consistent models for two-phase Non-Newtonian viscoelastic flows, and to the author's best konowledge, no structure-preserving numerical methods have been reported for such models. In this paper, we focus on modeling the two-phase non-Newtonnian visco-elastic FENE-P model based on the energetic variational approach (EnVarA). In the model, a phase-field function is introduced to describe the diffuse interface which satisfies the Cahn-Hilliard (CH) equation. And all the physical variables can be connected smoothly. We conduct a matched asymptotic analysis for the sharp interface limit, which shows the diffuse interface model will converge to the sharp interface model when the interface thickness trends to zero. We then reformulate the model in an equivalent form that facilitates the construction of the numerical scheme. A weakly decoupled scheme is proposed for the resulting FENE-P-CH system, and its unconditional energy stability is proved theoretically. Finally, a series of numerical experiments is conducted to validate the model and assess the performance of the proposed scheme.

AI.title_translation: 两相粘弹性FENE-P模型：热力学一致建模、尖锐界面极限分析与无条件能量稳定数值格式
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两相粘弹性FENE-P模型的热力学一致建模方法，分析了其尖锐界面极限，并开发了无条件能量稳定的数值求解格式。
AI.motivation: 尽管两相牛顿流体的数学建模和数值模拟已被广泛研究，但针对两相非牛顿粘弹性流体开发热力学一致的模型的研究相对较少，且此前尚无此类模型的保结构（结构保持）数值方法。
AI.method: 采用能量变分方法（EnVarA）结合Cahn-Hilliard方程构建两相粘弹性FENE-P相场模型；通过匹配渐近分析研究尖锐界面极限；提出一种弱解耦的数值格式并证明其无条件能量稳定性。
AI.result: 成功建立了热力学一致的两相粘弹性FENE-P模型；理论上证明了当界面厚度趋于零时，弥散界面模型收敛于尖锐界面模型；证明了所提出的弱解耦数值格式的无条件能量稳定性；并通过数值实验验证了模型和算法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了两相粘弹性FENE-P模型的热力学一致建模框架，证明了其尖锐界面极限，并开发了无条件能量稳定的数值格式，为两相复杂流体模拟提供了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 尽管两相牛顿流体的数学建模和数值模拟已被广泛研究多年，但相对较少的工作聚焦于为两相非牛顿粘弹性流体开发热力学一致的模型，据作者所知，此类模型尚未见结构保持的数值方法报道。在本文中，我们基于能量变分方法（EnVarA）重点研究了两相非牛顿粘弹性FENE-P模型的建模。在该模型中，引入了一个相场函数来描述满足Cahn-Hilliard（CH）方程的弥散界面，所有物理变量均可平滑连接。我们对尖锐界面极限进行了匹配渐近分析，表明当界面厚度趋于零时，弥散界面模型将收敛到尖锐界面模型。随后，我们将模型重新表述为便于构建数值格式的等效形式。针对所得的FENE-P-CH系统提出了一种弱解耦格式，并在理论上证明了其无条件能量稳定性。最后，通过一系列数值实验验证了该模型并评估了所提格式的性能。
AI.summary: 本文基于能量变分方法建立了一个热力学一致的两相粘弹性FENE-P相场模型，利用Cahn-Hilliard方程描述弥散界面，并通过匹配渐近分析推导了其尖锐界面极限。在此基础上，提出了一种无条件能量稳定的弱解耦数值格式，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 两相流, 粘弹性流体, FENE-P模型, 能量变分方法, 能量稳定格式
AI.comments: 该论文首次针对两相非牛顿粘弹性流体（FENE-P模型）开发了热力学一致的模型，并通过能量变分方法（EnVarA）和相场法处理界面。其最大创新在于提出了具有无条件能量稳定性的弱解耦数值格式，并通过渐近分析证明了尖锐界面极限的收敛性，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: A Vision-Based Framework for Manual Assembly Verification and Adaptive Operator Assistance
summary: Manual assembly remains difficult to monitor because operator actions, components, and task progress must be interpreted together. This paper presents a modular framework based on a single overhead red-green-blue (RGB) camera, combining object detection, hand-motion tracking, region-aware interaction detection, finite-state verification, task-specific pose classification, and configurable visual guidance. The system was evaluated during pneumatic-piston assembly and disassembly with eight participants under three assistance conditions: full, mid, and no guidance. Mixed-effects analysis identified an association between assistance condition and a composite measure of motion quality, with lower estimated scores under mid and no guidance relative to full guidance. However, the condition-by-trial interaction was not statistically significant, and the estimated differences in learning trajectories remain descriptive. No condition differences were detected in completion time or failed-stage counts. The study demonstrates the integration of visual perception, procedural verification, and configurable operator feedback in a single-camera workflow. Selecting assistance according to operator expertise remains a design objective for future investigation.

AI.title_translation: 基于视觉的手动装配验证与自适应操作员辅助框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于单一RGB摄像头的模块化框架，用于监控手动装配过程，结合了物体检测、手部运动追踪、状态验证、姿态分类和视觉引导，以验证装配过程并辅助操作员。评估结果表明，与完全指导相比，中等或无指导条件下操作员的运动质量较低，但完成时间和错误数量无显著差异。该框架整合了视觉感知、程序验证和操作员反馈，但根据操作员专业知识选择辅助级别仍是未来研究的目标。
AI.motivation: 手动装配过程难以监控，因为需要同时解读操作员的行为、组件和任务进展。因此，需要一个系统来有效监控和辅助手动装配。
AI.method: 提出一个基于单一RGB摄像头的模块化框架，整合了物体检测、手部运动追踪、区域感知交互检测、有限状态验证、任务特定姿态分类和可配置的视觉引导。该系统在气动活塞的组装和拆卸任务中进行了评估，有八名参与者在三种辅助条件下（完全、中等、无指导）进行测试。
AI.result: 混合效应分析表明，辅助条件与运动质量的综合指标相关，在中等和无指导条件下，运动质量得分低于完全指导条件。然而，条件与试验的交互作用不显著，学习轨迹的差异描述性较强。在完成时间和失败阶段计数方面，未检测到条件差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功整合了单一摄像头工作流程中的视觉感知、程序验证和可配置的操作员反馈。虽然完全指导下的运动质量最高，但完成时间和错误数量未显示显著差异。根据操作员专业知识选择辅助级别是未来研究的目标。
AI.translation: 手动装配仍然难以监控，因为必须同时解释操作员的行为、组件和任务进度。本文提出了一个基于单一的顶视红绿蓝（RGB）摄像头的模块化框架，结合了物体检测、手部运动追踪、区域感知交互检测、有限状态验证、任务特定姿态分类和可配置的视觉引导。该系统在气动活塞的组装和拆卸过程中进行了评估，有八名参与者在三种辅助条件下：完全、中等和无指导。混合效应分析确定了辅助条件与运动质量的综合指标之间的关联，在中等和无指导条件下估计的得分低于完全指导条件。然而，条件与试验的交互作用不具有统计学意义，并且学习轨迹的估计差异仍然是描述性的。在完成时间和失败阶段计数方面，未检测到条件差异。该研究证明了单一摄像头工作流程中视觉感知、程序验证和可配置操作员反馈的整合。根据操作员的专业知识选择辅助仍然是未来研究的一个设计目标。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个创新的、基于单一RGB摄像头的框架，用于监控手动装配过程。该框架集成了多种视觉分析技术，包括物体检测、手部追踪和状态验证，并能提供自适应的视觉辅助。实验结果表明，虽然完全指导能提升运动质量，但在装配时间和错误率方面，不同指导程度的差异不显著。该框架有效地结合了视觉感知、程序验证和操作员反馈，为未来实现更智能、更个性化的装配辅助提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 手动装配, 视觉监控, 操作员辅助, 计算机视觉, 框架
AI.comments: 该研究在手动装配监控和辅助方面取得了重要进展，通过单一摄像头实现了多项视觉技术的集成。然而，其结果表明运动质量的提升并未直接转化为效率的提高，这提示了在设计辅助系统时需要更全面地考虑用户体验和任务目标。未来研究可以进一步探索如何根据操作员的个体差异和技能水平，更精细地调整辅助策略。

title: HookEvo: A Framework for Coordinated Plugin Evolution on Hook-Enabled Agent Runtimes
summary: Repairing failures in tool-using agents can require coordinated changes to how the harness interprets tool receipts, assembles context, and checks actions. We introduce HookEvo, a framework that uses an existing agent runtime's lifecycle hooks to evolve task-specific harnesses. We instantiate HookEvo on DeepSeek Harness. In each round, a separate improver diagnoses failures from execution traces and proposes a candidate. HookEvo evaluates the candidate against the current harness on matched tasks and carries the retained version into the next round. A single candidate can jointly edit executable plugin handlers and the state they share within a task, allowing a tool receipt to inform context and control a later action. Using a frozen Qwen3-4B executor, the selected harnesses lead the reported Qwen3-4B comparisons, achieving 95.41% on ALFWorld, 70.56% on DBBench, 48.17% on WebShop, and 41.67% on OSBench. Across three improvers and three edit scopes, from skill text to single-component and coordinated executable edits, GPT-6.1 Sol shows the largest average gain from the broadest scope. Our code is available at https://huangshengzebluesky.github.io/hookevo/.

AI.title_translation: HookEvo：钩子使能智能体运行时上协同插件演化的框架
AI.tldr: HookEvo 是一个利用生命周期钩子联合演化智能体插件和共享状态的框架，显著提升了工具使用智能体的执行性能。
AI.motivation: 修复使用工具的智能体中的故障通常需要对工具回执解释、上下文组装和动作检查的方式进行协调修改，现有的方法缺乏一种高效的协同演化机制。
AI.method: 引入 HookEvo 框架，利用代理运行时的生命周期钩子在多轮迭代中通过改进器诊断执行轨迹中的故障并提出候选方案，同时联合编辑可执行插件处理器及其共享状态，并在匹配的任务上进行评估与筛选。
AI.result: 使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B 执行器时，HookEvo 选出的适配方案在 ALFWorld 上达到 95.41%，在 DBBench 上达到 70.56%，在 WebShop 上达到 48.17%，在 OSBench 上达到 41.67%，表现领先。
AI.conclusion: HookEvo 框架通过利用生命周期钩子协调插件演化，有效修复并提升了工具使用智能体在各项复杂基准测试中的性能。
AI.translation: 修复工具使用智能体中的故障可能需要对工具 harness 解释工具回执、组装上下文以及检查动作的方式进行协调修改。我们介绍了 HookEvo，这是一个利用现有智能体运行时的生命周期钩子来演化任务特定 harness 的框架。我们在 DeepSeek Harness 上实例化了 HookEvo。在每一轮中，一个单独的改进器会从执行轨迹中诊断故障并提出候选方案。HookEvo 在匹配的任务上评估候选方案与当前 harness 的表现，并将保留的版本带入下一轮。单个候选方案可以联合编辑可执行插件处理器以及它们在一个任务中共享的状态，从而允许工具回执通知上下文并控制后续动作。使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B 执行器时，所选出的 harness 在报告的 Qwen3-4B 比较中处于领先地位，在 ALFWorld 上达到 95.41%，在 DBBench 上达到 70.56%，在 WebShop 上达到 48.17%，在 OSBench 上达到 41.67%。跨越三个改进器和三个编辑范围（从技能文本到单组件和协同可执行编辑），GPT-6.1 Sol 从最广泛的范围中显示出最大的平均增益。我们的代码可在 https://huangshengzebluesky.github.io/hookevo/ 获取。
AI.summary: HookEvo 是一个基于钩子使能的智能体运行时的协同插件演化框架，通过多轮迭代和联合编辑可执行插件及其共享状态来修复智能体故障，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: HookEvo, 智能体运行时, 生命周期钩子, 插件演化, 工具使用智能体
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于生命周期钩子的协同插件演化框架 HookEvo，能够联合编辑可执行插件处理程序及其共享状态，显著提升了工具使用智能体在多个基准测试中的性能。这一思路对智能体运行时的持续优化具有重要价值。

title: Strong Functional Observability and Strong Functional Detectability: Applications to Functional Observer Design for Systems with Unknown Inputs
summary: This paper investigates strong functional observability, strong functional detectability, and strong$^*$ functional detectability for continuous-time linear systems with unknown inputs in both the state and measurement equations. Extending Kratz's finite algebraic approach \cite{26}, zero-output trajectories are characterized through the projected kernel of a finite matrix, without differentiating the unknown inputs. This characterization yields a necessary and sufficient rank condition for strong functional observability. For strong functional detectability, a frequency-dependent rank criterion involving only the original system matrices is derived, along with an equivalent finite test based on reduced zero-output dynamics. Strong$^*$ functional detectability is then characterized by an additional algebraic rank condition, and its relationship with the existence of stable functional observers is examined. A constructive observer design procedure based on constrained Sylvester equations is also developed. Particular cases and a numerical process example illustrate the theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 强功能可观测性与强功能可检性：在未知输入系统功能观测器设计中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了含未知输入线性系统的强功能可观测性与可检性，并提出了基于约束西尔维斯特方程的功能观测器设计方法。
AI.motivation: 为了解决含状态和测量方程未知输入的连续时间线性系统中的强功能可观测性、强功能可检性以及强*功能可检性问题，并为稳定功能观测器的设计提供理论与构造支持。
AI.method: 扩展了Kratz的有限代数方法，通过有限矩阵的投影核对零输出轨迹进行表征，推导了秩条件、频率相关判据以及基于约化零输出动态的有限测试方法，并开发了基于约束西尔维斯特方程的构造性观测器设计程序。
AI.result: 得到了强功能可观测性的必要和充分秩条件、强功能可检性的频率相关秩判据及有限测试方法、强*功能可检性的代数秩条件，并证明了其与稳定功能观测器存在的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功建立了含未知输入系统的一系列强功能可观测与可检性理论，并提出了相应的稳定功能观测器构造方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究了状态和测量方程中均含有未知输入的连续时间线性系统的强功能可观测性、强功能可检性以及强*功能可检性。通过扩展Kratz的有限代数方法，在不对未知输入进行微分的情况下，通过有限矩阵的投影核对零输出轨迹进行了表征。这一表征为强功能可观测性产生了必要和充分的秩条件。对于强功能可检性，导出了仅涉及原系统矩阵的频率相关秩准则，以及基于约化零输出动态的等效有限测试。接着，通过附加的代数秩条件对强*功能可检性进行了表征，并研究了其与稳定功能观测器存在性的关系。同时，开发了一种基于约束西尔维斯特方程的建设性观测器设计程序。最后，通过特例和数值过程示例说明了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了含有未知输入的连续时间线性系统的强功能可观测性、强功能可检性和强*功能可检性。通过扩展有限代数方法，无需对未知输入进行微分即可表征零输出轨迹，从而推导出一系列充要条件和秩准则，并开发了基于约束西尔维斯特方程的实用功能观测器设计方法。
AI.keywords: 强功能可观测性, 强功能可检性, 未知输入系统, 功能观测器, 线性系统
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究了含有未知输入的连续时间线性系统的强功能可观测性、强功能可检性及强*功能可检性，不仅推导出了充要秩条件，还给出了基于约束西尔维斯特方程的实用观测器构造方法，具有较高的理论价值。

title: Re-JEPA: Coupling Representation Prediction and Signal Reconstruction for State-Conditioned EMG Tracking
summary: Improving continuous hand tracking from surface electromyography (sEMG) requires generalization across users and motion types while maintaining sensitivity to subtle movements. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent representation spaces through contextual prediction, but their effectiveness for tracking depends on which motion-relevant details these representations preserve and how those details are interpreted as the hand state evolves. We introduce Re-JEPA, a tracking framework that couples representation prediction with signal reconstruction and incorporates state-conditioned motion decoding. During pretraining without kinematic labels, Re-JEPA predicts continuous latent targets at multiple levels from visible EMG patches and reconstructs masked amplitude and phase attributes from the fused predictions. Signal reconstruction imposes an additional constraint on the contextual predictor, encouraging its outputs to retain information needed for signal recovery. For downstream tracking, the Gated Persistent Motion (GPM) decoder conditions EMG-token readout on recurrent state tokens and motion history, then generates continuous trajectories through gated state updates and incremental pose prediction. Under the emg2pose tracking protocol, Re-JEPA reduces angular MAE after full fine-tuning by approximately 10.3%, 19.3%, and 14.9% relative to vemg2pose on the cross-user, cross-stage, and joint cross-user-stage splits, respectively.

AI.title_translation: Re-JEPA：耦合表示预测与信号重建用于状态条件的EMG追踪
AI.tldr: Re-JEPA通过结合表示预测、信号重建和状态条件解码，显著提升了肌电信号（sEMG）手势追踪的精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 改善基于表面肌电信号（sEMG）的连续手势追踪需要跨用户和运动类型的泛化能力，同时保持对微妙动作的敏感性；现有的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对于追踪的有效性取决于其潜在表示保留了哪些与运动相关的细节以及这些细节如何随手部状态演变而被解释。
AI.method: 引入Re-JEPA框架，在无运动学标签的预训练阶段耦合多级连续潜在目标预测与被屏蔽的幅度及相位属性的信号重建；在下游追踪阶段，利用门控持久运动（GPM）解码器，将EMG标记读出与循环状态标记及运动历史相结合，通过门控状态更新和增量姿态预测生成连续轨迹。
AI.result: 在emg2pose追踪协议下，经过充分微调后，Re-JEPA在跨用户、跨阶段以及联合跨用户-阶段划分上的角度平均绝对误差（MAE）分别比vemg2pose降低了约10.3%、19.3%和14.9%。
AI.conclusion: Re-JEPA通过耦合表示预测与信号重建，并采用状态条件运动解码，显著提升了基于sEMG的连续手势追踪精度和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 改善基于表面肌电信号（sEMG）的连续手部追踪，需要在跨用户和运动类型的泛化能力与保持对微妙动作的敏感性之间取得平衡。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过上下文预测学习潜在表示空间，但其用于追踪的有效性取决于这些表示保留了哪些与运动相关的细节，以及随着手部状态的演变如何解释这些细节。我们介绍了Re-JEPA，这是一个将表示预测与信号重建相结合，并结合状态条件运动解码的追踪框架。在没有运动学标签的预训练期间，Re-JEPA从可见的EMG块中多级别地预测连续潜在目标，并从融合的预测中重建被屏蔽的振幅和相位属性。信号重建对上下文预测器施加了额外的约束，鼓励其输出保留信号恢复所需的的信息。对于下游追踪，门控持久运动（GPM）解码器将EMG标记的读出条件化于循环状态标记和运动历史上，然后通过门控状态更新和增量姿态预测生成连续轨迹。在emg2pose追踪协议下，经过充分微调后，在跨用户、跨阶段以及联合跨用户-阶段的划分上，Re-JEPA的角度MAE相比vemg2pose分别降低了约10.3%、19.3%和14.9%。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了Re-JEPA框架，通过将表示预测与信号重建相结合并引入状态条件运动解码器，实现了对表面肌电信号（sEMG）的高精度连续手势追踪，在跨用户和跨阶段的评估中表现出优异的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 表面肌电信号 (sEMG), 联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA), 手势追踪, 信号重建, 状态条件解码
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将表示预测（JEPA）与信号重建相结合，并引入了状态条件运动解码器，有效解决了肌电信号（sEMG）连续手势追踪中泛化性与对微妙动作敏感性之间的矛盾，在多个交叉验证基准上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Observed, Curated, Reused: Observation Bias in Clinical AI Evaluation
comments: Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026. 2 figures, 1 table. Code: https://gitlab.sdu.dk/screen4care/observed-curated-reuse
summary:
Clinical AI evaluations are vulnerable to observation bias embedded in routine medical documentation, which captures only what clinicians notice, test, and record rather than a complete clinical picture. As this evidence travels into publications and reference knowledge graphs, crucial distinctions disappear: unexamined symptoms blur with confirmed negatives, and chronological disease progression is lost. Surviving evidence can also enter both the benchmark query and the reference knowledge base, creating a self-referential loop where a patient is evaluated against clues derived from their own published case report.
  To quantify this bias, we tracked 6,503 clinical cases across six historical Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) releases (October 2021-June 2026) to identify when HPO first cited the publications describing them. This yielded a confirmatory cohort with an observable "source ingestion" event, where HPO cited a case's source publication as target-disease evidence. Diagnostic rankers depended heavily on these source publications: for our primary semantic ranker (Resnik), publication-weighted mean reciprocal rank rose from 0.26 before paper ingestion to 0.84 upon inclusion in HPO, but collapsed to 0.05 when source-linked assertions were counterfactually removed. Two additional rankers (IC-cosine and LIRICAL) reproduced this trajectory, and control experiments confirmed the diagnostic jump was driven by the patient's publication rather than background HPO growth.
  Clinical AI systems may therefore score well because their knowledge base contains evidence linked to the test case's source publication, rather than through generalization. Modern knowledge is not the problem; evaluation evidence must match the claim. Trustworthy benchmarks must separate patients, source-linked evidence, and time: historical tests should use only knowledge available at the intended decision time.

AI.title_translation: 观察、整理、重用：临床AI评估中的观察偏差
AI.tldr: 临床AI评估存在观察偏差，AI系统可能因为知识库包含与测试案例源出版物直接关联的证据而表现良好，而非通过泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 临床AI评估容易受到常规医疗文档中嵌入的观察偏差的影响，这种偏差导致关键区别消失，并可能创建一种自我参照循环，即患者根据其自身已发表病例报告中的线索进行评估。这可能使AI系统看似表现良好，但并非基于泛化能力，而是因为其知识库包含了与测试案例源出版物相关的证据。
AI.method: 研究人员追踪了6,503个临床病例在六个历史人类表型本体论（HPO）版本（2021年10月至2026年6月）中的引用情况，以确定HPO何时首次引用描述这些病例的出版物。这形成了一个具有可观察到的“来源摄取”事件的证实队列。他们使用诊断排名器（包括Resnik、IC-cosine和LIRICAL）评估了出版物摄取前后以及反事实移除源链接断言后的性能。通过对照实验确认诊断性能的提升是由患者出版物驱动而非HPO背景增长。
AI.result: 对于主要语义排名器（Resnik），在出版物被摄取到HPO之前，出版物加权平均倒数排名为0.26；摄取后上升至0.84；但在反事实移除源链接断言后，该值骤降至0.05。另外两个排名器（IC-cosine和LIRICAL）也重现了这一趋势。对照实验证实，诊断性能的显著提升是由患者的出版物而非HPO的背景增长所驱动。
AI.conclusion: 临床AI系统可能因为其知识库包含与测试案例源出版物链接的证据而得分很高，而非通过泛化能力。可信赖的基准测试必须将患者、源链接证据和时间分开：历史测试应仅使用在预期决策时间可用的知识。
AI.translation:
临床AI评估容易受到常规医疗文档中嵌入的观察偏差的影响，这些文档仅捕获临床医生注意、测试和记录的内容，而非完整的临床全貌。随着这些证据进入出版物和参考知识图谱，关键的区别消失了：未经检查的症状与已确认的阴性混淆，时间性的疾病进展也随之丢失。幸存的证据也可能同时进入基准查询和参考知识库，从而形成一个自我参照的循环，即患者根据其自身已发表病例报告中的线索进行评估。
为了量化这种偏差，我们追踪了六个历史人类表型本体论（HPO）版本（2021年10月至2026年6月）中的6,503个临床病例，以确定HPO何时首次引用描述这些病例的出版物。这产生了一个具有可观察到的“来源摄取”事件的证实队列，即HPO引用了病例的源出版物作为目标疾病证据。诊断排名器严重依赖这些源出版物：对于我们的主要语义排名器（Resnik），在论文摄取之前，出版物加权平均倒数排名为0.26，在被纳入HPO后上升到0.84，但在反事实移除源链接断言后，该值骤降至0.05。另外两个排名器（IC-cosine和LIRICAL）也重现了这一轨迹，并且对照实验证实诊断性能的显著提升是由患者的出版物而非HPO的背景增长所驱动。
因此，临床AI系统可能因为其知识库包含与测试案例源出版物链接的证据而得分很高，而非通过泛化能力。现代知识本身不是问题；评估证据必须与所声称的相符。可信赖的基准测试必须将患者、源链接证据和时间分开：历史测试应仅使用在预期决策时间可用的知识。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了临床AI评估中存在的观察偏差，这种偏差源于医疗记录的不完整性以及证据在知识传播过程中关键信息的丢失。通过追踪6,503个临床病例在HPO中的引用情况，研究发现，诊断排名器在知识库摄取了与测试病例源出版物相关的证据后，其性能（如平均倒数排名）显著提高，但在移除这些源链接证据后则大幅下降。这表明，临床AI系统可能因直接利用与测试案例相关的已发表证据而表现良好，而非通过泛化能力。论文强调，为确保AI评估的可靠性，需要构建分离患者、源链接证据和时间的基准，确保历史测试仅使用决策时可用的知识。
AI.keywords: 观察偏差, 临床AI, 评估, 知识库, HPO
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了临床AI评估中一个关键且被忽视的问题：观察偏差和数据泄露。其创新之处在于通过量化实验，明确展示了AI系统性能提升并非总来源于泛化能力，而可能是由于知识库中包含了与测试案例直接相关的已发表证据。这一发现对临床AI模型的开发、评估和部署具有重要指导意义，强调了在构建基准测试时严格分离数据源、时间戳和患者信息的必要性，以确保AI系统的真正泛化能力和可靠性。

title: Can Reasoning and Image Description Enhance Yes/No Visual Mathematical Understanding?
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general visual tasks, yet their ability to understand mathematical images remains limited. This paper investigates whether explicit reasoning and textual image descriptions can enhance VLMs' performance on binary yes/no visual mathematical questions. To achieve this, we curated a paired evaluation set to benchmark prominent open-source VLMs under varying prompt and input conditions. In particular, we leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and use textual descriptions, either replacing or augmenting visual inputs, to isolate and evaluate mathematical comprehension. Our results show that explicit reasoning improves performance, especially in paired consistency accuracy, while textual image descriptions do not consistently help and may degrade performance. These findings suggest that reasoning is important for stable visual mathematical judgement, whereas description-based intermediates require more careful design.

AI.title_translation: 推理和图像描述能否增强是/否视觉数学理解？
AI.tldr: 推理可以提高视觉数学问题的理解能力，但图像描述不一定有帮助，甚至可能损害性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在通用视觉任务上表现出色，但在理解数学图像方面能力有限。本文旨在探究显式推理和文本图像描述是否能提升VLM在二元是/否视觉数学问题上的表现。
AI.method: 创建了一个配对评估集，用于在不同的提示和输入条件下对主流的开源VLM进行基准测试。利用思维链（CoT）提示，并使用文本描述替换或增强视觉输入，以分离和评估数学理解能力。
AI.result: 显式推理可以提高性能，尤其是在配对一致性准确率方面。而文本图像描述并不总是有帮助，有时甚至会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理对于稳定的视觉数学判断很重要，而基于描述的中间过程需要更仔细的设计。
AI.translation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在通用视觉任务上表现出色，但在理解数学图像方面能力有限。本文旨在探究显式推理和文本图像描述是否能提升VLM在二元是/否视觉数学问题上的表现。为此，我们创建了一个配对评估集，用于在不同的提示和输入条件下对主流的开源VLM进行基准测试。具体来说，我们利用思维链（CoT）提示，并使用文本描述替换或增强视觉输入，以分离和评估数学理解能力。我们的结果表明，显式推理可以提高性能，尤其是在配对一致性准确率方面，而文本图像描述并不总是有帮助，有时甚至会降低性能。这些发现表明，推理对于稳定的视觉数学判断很重要，而基于描述的中间过程需要更仔细的设计。
AI.summary: 本文研究了推理和图像描述对视觉语言模型（VLM）在是/否视觉数学问题理解能力的影响。通过构建评估集并采用思维链提示，研究发现显式推理能有效提升模型性能，特别是配对一致性准确率。然而，使用文本图像描述作为替代或补充输入，其效果并不稳定，甚至可能导致性能下降。研究结论强调了推理在视觉数学判断中的重要性，并指出需要更精细地设计基于描述的中间表示方法。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 数学理解, 推理, 图像描述, 思维链
AI.comments: 该研究通过实验验证了推理在视觉数学理解中的关键作用，并指出了当前基于描述的方法的局限性，为未来VLM在数学领域的应用提供了有价值的见解。然而，对于“不一致”的描述如何影响性能的具体分析可以更深入。

title: ManipScope: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Instruction Following and Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Completing a manipulation task does not establish that a robot follows the requested goal rather than a familiar routine. ManipScope is an evaluation-only diagnostic benchmark for robotic instruction following under changed task requirements. Built on RoboTwin 2.0's simulation resources, it specifies 48 held-out scenes across six task families with explicit source-task links; policies are trained on unmodified RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrations, and no demonstrations of the scenes are provided, so success requires reusing skills under a changed request rather than fitting supplied examples. Beyond task success, ManipScope provides a chain of diagnostics in which each step tests one explanation of a failure. For twelve policy checkpoints, 84.6% of failures in 13,200 episodes on eleven selection scenes displace a distractor, and gripper records show that failed episodes usually grasp a non-target. When the target is reassigned among the candidates on identical initial states, ten checkpoints follow every instruction on 3.9% of 1,000 states, below the 16% of an instruction-blind chooser, while a GPT-6 agent run as positive control reaches 88%. The failure recurs on unmodified training tasks and is not explained by missing manipulation skills, so success in these scenes largely reflects instruction-independent preferences; two checkpoints trained on the same data nevertheless follow color instructions. In a feasibility test, letting an agent select the target and the policy execute partly restores instruction following. Case studies with future-video and internal-intervention probes further show that forecasts and execution can agree on the wrong target and that action changes need not transfer the goal. Success, consistency, and sensitivity must each be checked against the requested goal.

AI.title_translation: 机器人操作中的指令遵循与泛化诊断基准：ManipScope
AI.tldr: ManipScope 是一个机器人操作指令遵循的诊断基准，用于评估机器人在任务需求改变时遵循指令的能力。它包含 48 个未在训练中使用的场景，政策在未修改的演示上训练，不提供新场景的演示。结果表明，许多现有政策在遵循指令方面表现不佳，往往依赖于固有的偏好而非指令，并且即使在修改后的场景中也可能失败。该基准还提供了诊断步骤来分析失败原因，并发现改进策略（如允许代理选择目标）可以部分恢复指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 评估机器人系统在面对变化的任务需求时，是否真正理解并遵循指令，而不是仅仅依赖于熟悉的例行程序或固有偏好。
AI.method: ManipScope 基准包含了 48 个针对六种任务类型的未在训练中使用的场景。政策在 RoboTwin 2.0 的模拟环境中，基于未修改的演示进行训练，并且不提供新场景的演示。该基准通过任务成功率以及一系列诊断步骤来评估政策的表现，这些步骤旨在逐一排查失败的原因。此外，还进行了包括 GPT-6 在内的代理测试，以及未来视频和内部干预等探测方法的案例研究。
AI.result: 在 13,200 次试验中，12 个政策检查点的失败率很高（84.6%），主要表现为抓取了非目标物体，而非目标物体通常是干扰物。当目标在相同初始状态下被重新分配时，10 个检查点在 1,000 个状态下的指令遵循率仅为 3.9%，低于随机选择的 16%，而 GPT-6 基线达到了 88%。失败并非源于缺乏操作技能，表明成功很大程度上依赖于指令无关的偏好。部分恢复策略（如允许代理选择目标）可将指令遵循率提高到 3.9% 到一定程度。案例研究表明，预测和执行可能在错误的目标上达成一致，并且动作改变不一定会转移目标。
AI.conclusion: 在机器人操作中，仅仅依靠现有演示数据训练的政策，在面对指令变化时，往往表现出指令无关的偏好，而非真正遵循指令。ManipScope 基准揭示了当前技术在指令遵循和泛化方面存在的显著局限性。为了实现可靠的指令遵循，必须同时检查成功率、一致性和对指令的敏感性。
AI.translation: 完成一项操作任务并不意味着机器人遵循了所要求的目标，而不是遵循一个熟悉的例行程序。ManipScope 是一个仅用于评估的诊断基准，用于在改变任务要求的情况下进行机器人操作指令遵循。它基于 RoboTwin 2.0 的模拟资源，包含六种任务类型的 48 个未使用的场景，并明确了源任务链接；策略在未修改的 RoboTwin 2.0 演示上进行训练，并且不提供这些场景的演示，因此成功需要重用技能而不是拟合提供的示例。除了任务成功之外，ManipScope 还提供了一系列诊断步骤，其中每个步骤都测试了失败的一种解释。对于十二个策略检查点，在 13,200 次试验中的 84.6% 的失败发生在十一个选择场景中，这些失败涉及移动干扰物，并且夹具记录显示失败的试验通常抓取了非目标物体。当在相同的初始状态下，目标在候选对象之间重新分配时，十个检查点在 1,000 个状态下的指令遵循率为 3.9%，低于指令无关的选择者的 16%，而作为阳性对照运行的 GPT-6 代理达到了 88%。失败在未修改的训练任务中再次出现，并且并非由缺乏操作技能所解释，因此这些场景中的成功很大程度上反映了指令无关的偏好；然而，在相同数据上训练的两个检查点确实遵循了颜色指令。在可行性测试中，允许代理选择目标和策略执行部分恢复了指令遵循。未来视频和内部干预探测的案例研究进一步表明，预测和执行可能在错误的目标上达成一致，并且动作改变不一定会转移目标。成功、一致性和敏感性都必须针对所要求的目标进行检查。
AI.summary: ManipScope 是一个创新的诊断基准，旨在解决当前机器人操作中指令遵循评估的不足。它通过在 RoboTwin 2.0 模拟环境中设计包含 48 个未见过的场景，并严格限制训练数据（仅使用原始演示，不提供新场景的示例），来测试机器人在任务需求变化时是否真正理解并遵循指令。研究发现，现有的大多数政策在面对指令变化时，表现出对指令不敏感的固有偏好，失败率高，并且经常抓取错误的目标。该基准还提供了一系列诊断工具，帮助分析失败原因，并验证了部分改进策略（如允许代理选择目标）的有效性。最终，ManipScope 强调了在评估机器人指令遵循能力时，必须综合考量成功率、一致性和对指令的敏感性。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作,指令遵循,泛化能力,诊断基准,RoboTwin 2.0
AI.comments: ManipScope 提出了一个非常有价值的诊断基准，解决了当前机器人操作评估中的一个关键盲点：即机器人是否真正理解并遵循指令，还是仅仅在执行预设程序。该基准的设计巧妙，通过使用未在训练中见过的场景和严格的评估流程，有效地揭示了现有方法的局限性。然而，该研究也指出了未来工作的方向，例如如何设计出真正能够理解和泛化指令的机器人系统，以及如何进一步完善评估方法，使其能够更全面地反映机器人的智能水平。

title: $γ$-Scape: An Agent-Centric World for Mobile Embodied Intelligence
summary: Recent embodied agents construct and adapt robot behavior through executable programs, tool use, and interaction feedback. Studying these systems in mobile manipulation calls for physical worlds that connect agent-directed execution with its physical consequences and reusable interaction experience. We introduce $γ$-Scape, an agent-centric simulation and benchmark platform for mobile embodied intelligence. Agents compose motion tools and learned skills to carry out complete tasks that combine navigation and manipulation in a persistent physical world. BenchForge grounds structured objectives in physical task instances with instructions, reference programs, and goal evaluators, defining task goals while preserving agents' choice of valid solutions. An agentic collection harness further enables agents to produce demonstrations by carrying out contact-rich interactions through sustained control and physical feedback. Assisted reference execution and human guidance provide complementary experience. The resulting tool traces and aligned observation-action records support program refinement and policy learning, with common task-goal criteria for subsequent evaluation. We benchmark representative agent systems on complete tasks and demonstrate contact collection and trace-informed program revision. Together, these workflows provide infrastructure for research on embodied recursive self-improvement.

AI.title_translation: γ-Scape：面向移动具身智能的智能体中心世界
AI.tldr: 本文提出了γ-Scape，一个用于移动具身智能的仿真与基准测试平台，支持智能体在持久物理世界中进行移动操作、任务执行和自我改进。
AI.motivation: 当前的具身智能系统需要能够将代理驱动的执行与其物理后果以及可重用交互经验联系起来的物理世界，以研究移动操作中的机器人行为。
AI.method: 引入γ-Scape模拟与基准平台，结合BenchForge将结构化目标接地到物理任务实例中，并利用智能体收集 harness 生成具身交互演示，支持程序精炼和策略学习。
AI.result: 基准测试了代表性的智能体系统在完整任务上的表现，并展示了接触收集和基于轨迹的程序修正能力。
AI.conclusion: γ-Scape及其配套工具为移动具身智能的研究提供了坚实的基础设施，能够有效支持任务执行、联系收集以及基于轨迹的程序修正。
AI.translation: 近期的具身智能体通过可执行程序、工具使用和交互反馈来构建和调整机器人的行为。在移动操作中研究这些系统，需要将智能体驱动的执行与其物理后果及可复用的交互经验联系起来的物理世界。我们介绍了γ-Scape，这是一个面向移动具身智能的以智能体为中心的仿真与基准测试平台。智能体组合运动工具和学习到的技能，在持久的物理世界中执行结合了导航和操作的完整任务。BenchForge将结构化目标与指令、参考程序和目标评估器一起接地到物理任务实例中，在保持智能体对有效解决方案的选择权的同时定义任务目标。智能体收集框架进一步使智能体能够通过持续控制和物理反馈进行丰富的接触交互来生成演示。辅助参考执行和人类指导提供了补充经验。由此产生的工具轨迹和对齐的观测-动作记录支持程序精炼和策略学习，并为后续评估提供共同的任务目标标准。我们在完整任务上对代表性的智能体系统进行了基准测试，并展示了接触收集和轨迹知情的程序修正。这些工作流共同为具身递归自我改进的研究提供了基础设施。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了γ-Scape，这是一个面向移动具身智能的以智能体为中心的仿真与基准测试平台，旨在通过结合导航与操作的持久物理世界、任务接地工具BenchForge以及智能体演示收集框架，支持具身递归自我改进的研究。
AI.keywords: 移动具身智能, 仿真平台, 智能体, 移动操作, 递归自我改进
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种以智能体为中心的移动具身智能模拟与基准测试平台γ-Scape，有效连接了智能体驱动的程序执行、物理后果及可复用的交互经验，对推动具身递归自我改进研究具有重要价值。

title: Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian Path Planning
summary: This paper introduces Frontier Voltage Boost Laplacian path planning. The method inherits many of the attractive features of earlier Harmonic Potential Field planning methods, including absence of local minima and smooth paths, while improving the original. The piecewise approach we introduce is able to solve larger maps and handle narrow passages more quickly than earlier Harmonic Potential Field methods. After explaining the algorithm, we experimentally characterize its cor- rectness, performance, and path smoothness as a function of map size. Code is available at https://github.com/vpritamani/FrontierVoltageBoostLaplacianPathPlanning

title: A Geometric Approach to the Classification of Locally-APN Niho-Type Power Functions
summary: Let $q=2^m$ with $m\geq 2$. We develop a geometric approach to the classification of locally-APN Niho-type power functions over $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$. Our approach begins with a characterization of $\mathbb{F}_q$-homogeneous functions: the conditions $D_F(a,F(a))=q$ and $D_F(a,b)\leq 2$ for every $a\in\mathbb{F}_{q^2}^*$ and $b\neq F(a)$ hold if and only if the projective graph of $F$ is a $(q+1)$-arc in $\mathrm{PG}(3,q)$. For Niho-type power functions, this differential condition is equivalent to the locally-APN property. Applying the classification of $(q+1)$-arcs and the description of their stabilizers, we prove, for $m\geq 3$, that $F_s(x)=x^{s(q-1)+1}$ is locally-APN if and only if $s\equiv(2^k+1)^{-1}\pmod{q+1}$ for some $1\leq k\leq 2m-1$ satisfying $\gcd(k,m)=\gcd(2^k+1,q+1)=1$. Together with the known case $m=2$ and the sufficient condition of Xie et al., this gives the complete classification and confirms the conjecture of Cui, Luo, and Xiang.

title: A Framework for AI-Ready Data in Earth and Environmental Science
comments: 12 pages excluding appendixes. Submitted to Earth System Science Data (ESSD), Oct 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), specifically machine learning (ML), is increasingly integral to Earth and environmental research, yet the suitability of current research data infrastructures for supporting AI workflows remains poorly defined. While the FAIR principles provide a foundation for scientific data management, they do not explicitly address several requirements arising when datasets are used for training, evaluating, and deploying AI models. This article presents a practically motivated framework for assessing and improving AI-readiness of research data within distributed Earth and environmental data infrastructures. The framework was developed through a structured, community-driven process, beginning with a review of existing literature and readiness frameworks combined with feedback from a limited survey of scientists applying ML methods. Its main aspects were shaped by a multidisciplinary expert group representing data providers, infrastructure developers, data managers, and AI practitioners. It identifies 25 criteria covering data preparation, data quality, documentation, access, and supervised learning targets. The criteria emphasize aspects particularly relevant to AI applications, including provenance, treatment of missing data, bias documentation, uncertainty characterization, machine-actionable metadata, efficient access formats, and the quality and reproducibility of target generation. Application to a broad range of representative environmental use cases highlights how the relevance of individual criteria varies by application. We argue that AI-readiness should be understood primarily as a property of transparency and fitness for purpose rather than as a fixed level of data quality. The framework lays a foundation for communication and community-driven action to advance AI-ready data and support next-generation AI-enabled scientific workflows.

title: BioCL-POS: Biological Completer-aware Learning with Predictive Observation Selection - A Wild Ginseng Study
summary: Growers and traders rely on root morphology to assess wild ginseng, yet breakage can obscure important structural traits. We study point cloud completion to provide geometric references for morphological analysis. Does providing more observed points always improve 3D completion? We test whether selected subsets improve recovery of the original missing region while keeping the pretrained completer fixed. We introduce BioCL-POS, an external selector that predicts how the completer responds to candidate inputs. For each candidate, we predict the displacement and distance from shared spatial locations to the nearest points in its completion. We use these spatial responses to estimate recovery quality and supervise them with measurements from actual completions. At inference, we select an input from the observed geometry and run the completer once. We evaluate four frozen completers on controlled gaps in ginseng and tree data at 5%,10%, and 20% omission, and examine 30% omission on ginseng. At 5--20% omission, we outperform full-input completion and all five alternative selectors on both datasets with all four completers. We achieve lower mean reconstruction error and higher mean F-score and coverage. We thus show that selecting observations can improve geometric recovery without retraining the completer, providing more accurate geometric references for subsequent morphological analysis.

title: Do Language Models Know Which Words Steer Their Reasoning?
summary: While chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits intermediate reasoning steps from language models, it is unclear which words in the context actually steer the CoT. We identify Phantom Context Influence (PCI): language models are disproportionately steered by semantically irrelevant context words, even as the same models deny those words' relevance when asked. To localize PCI, we introduce Leave-One-Out Word JSD analysis, which removes one context word at a time from the otherwise intact context to isolate its marginal effect on the next-token distribution; words whose removal flips the prediction (pivot words) are passed to the same LLM to self-judge whether it recognizes this predictive dependence. Across four models and three benchmarks, language models largely do not know which words steer their reasoning, a mismatch we call the Generation-Judgment Contradiction. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Online KV Suppression: it scores every prompt word's influence over the whole chain of thought in a single pass, then zeroes the KV-cache entries of the highest-influence word the model itself judges inert and redecodes. This single-word intervention improves CoT accuracy across four models and five reasoning benchmarks, by up to 8.9 percentage points on math reasoning benchmark.

title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves a word recall of 0.93. When the resulting layout-aware OCR output is used as context for document question answering, it attains an F1 score of 0.89, outperforming both open- and closed-source models such as GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.

title: Bring Cloud-Native Networking to FreeBSD Jails: Porting Calico from Linux
comments: 7 pages, 12 figures. Appeared in the peer-reviewed Proceedings of AsiaBSDCon 2025
summary: While Linux containers benefit from a rich ecosystem of Container Network Interface (CNI) plugins such as Calico and Cilium, FreeBSD Jails lacked native, standardized solutions for advanced networking. As a result, users have relied on manual, error-prone configurations, limiting scalability and integration with modern orchestration platforms. This paper introduces porting Calico, a widely adopted CNI plugin, to the FreeBSD operating system. Our approach replaced Linux-specific components with FreeBSD-native equivalents: iptables with ipfw, netlink sockets with routing sockets, and Linux network namespaces with FreeBSD's vnet. This work aims to bridge the gap between Linux and BSD container networking. By providing scalable, policy-driven capabilities that are compatible with existing Linux-centric infrastructure, FreeBSD can participate more fully in the broader container networking ecosystem.

title: Spiking Neural Networks Incrementally Track Firing-Rate Networks
comments: 45 pages, 7 figures. Code will be released at https://github.com/snuhcs/LIF-Stream
summary: Understanding how spiking neural networks (SNNs) efficiently process data streams is key to (i) studying how biological brains conserve energy for lifelong predictions and (ii) enabling efficient continuous AI inference. In this work, we propose a theory on how an SNN incrementally tracks its corresponding firing-rate network, a continuous-valued neural network (ANN). We prove that the output of a discrete SNN continuously tracks the instantaneous ANN output implicitly determined by the SNN input. Based on this principle, we develop LIF-Stream, a conversion framework for efficient SNN inference over unbounded data streams. It enables the converted SNN to reuse its prior activation state and compute only the activation updates between frames, thereby reducing the average number of time steps needed per frame. Specifically, LIF-Stream controls the SNN to continuously track the reference ANN output, which gives a high-accuracy prediction for every frame. Evaluation on three large-scale streaming inference benchmarks with distinct modalities shows that LIF-Stream achieves the best efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to high-accuracy SNN techniques.

title: Cruella: A Unified Microscaling and Floating-Point Dot-Product Unit for LLM Inference on FPGAs
summary: The number formats that accelerators execute natively are fixed at fabrication, yet large language model (LLM) checkpoints are released with MXFP4 weights in the Microscaling (MX) formats standardized in 2023. FPGAs adopt new formats through bitstreams. However, to the best of our knowledge, no deployed FPGA LLM accelerator executes MXFP4 weights alongside BF16 products. We characterize the decoding of MXFP4 checkpoints, whose layers alternate between MXFP4$\times$BF16 products and BF16$\times$BF16 products of attention and BF16 layers. With a BF16 KV cache, BF16$\times$BF16 products take 56%-77% of the datapath time, during which a separate MXFP4 unit idles. We present Cruella, whose unified dot-product unit (UDPU) executes both product types on one DSP array and reduction pipeline. First, per-group pre-alignment keeps this pipeline at the BF16 width and changes perplexity by at most 0.7%. Second, pre-adder packing places two signed MXFP4$\times$BF16 products in one DSP48E2 multiplier with an exact correction. On an Alveo U55C, the UDPU needs 23% fewer DSP slices and 36% fewer LUTs than separate MXFP4 and BF16 units of equal throughput. On this board, MXFP4 weights speed up decoding by 1.15$\times$-1.87$\times$ over BF16 weights, and an NVIDIA A40 GPU decodes faster but spends 0.92$\times$-2.01$\times$ the board's energy per token.

title: A fast automatically adaptive integral equation solver for nonlinear two-point boundary value systems
summary: We present a fast, high-order, automatically adaptive integral-equation solver for nonlinear two-point boundary value systems. The method builds on the fast direct solver for linear second-kind integral equations and completes the mathematical formulation needed for general boundary conditions, including cases in which the simplest background Green's function is singular and cases with genuinely rank-deficient boundary conditions. Nonlinear problems are written as nonlinear second-kind integral equations and are solved by combining this fast adaptive linear solver with Newton iteration and user-specified continuation. In this way the nonlinear solver inherits the full strengths of the linear integral-equation method: a fast direct solver, arbitrary order accuracy, and automatic adaptive resolution with only a small overhead over a solve on the final mesh. The resulting algorithm is particularly effective for problems with localized or multiscale structure, including boundary layers, dense oscillations, transition regions, hypersensitive optimal-control systems, and singular perturbations. The same framework also provides a computational foundation for future studies of bifurcation and solution-branch exploration.

title: Reasoning in Fewer Tokens: Concept-Normalized Multilingual Scratchpads and Reversible Model-Adaptive Reasoning Codes
summary: Chain-of-thought prompting significantly improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) but incurs high inference costs due to lengthy autoregressive decoding. While previous efficiency approaches reduce costs by discarding tokens or utilizing continuous latent representations, these lossy methods fundamentally sacrifice interpretability and auditability. In this work, we introduce a novel compression framework for intermediate reasoning. We apply Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) to reasoning corpora to learn a compressed vocabulary of Private Use Area (PUA) tokens, each representing frequent semantic spans. After expanding the LLM's vocabulary, we fine-tune the model via strictly 1:1, our method is lossless. We evaluate our approach on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, and Qwen2.5-32B across four diverse benchmarks. Our method reduces total generated tokens by 14.7% on average with reasoning trace lengths dropping by up to 27.1%, while incurring a negligible average accuracy cost of 1.6 percentage points. Crucially, this approach is orthogonal to existing lossy methods, allowing practitioners to stack lossless and irreversible compression techniques. We demonstrate that a compressed intermediate language provides a highly efficient computational resource that accelerates inference while fully preserving the transparency of LLM reasoning.

title: Embodied Interaction Policy: A Unified Model for Full-Duplex Human-Robot Interaction
comments: 24 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://youqiang-gui.github.io/EIP/
summary: Real-time human-robot social interaction requires continuous coordination between speech and physical behavior. Existing systems often separate interaction agents from motion generation, complicating coordination as conversational states change. We propose \textbf{Embodied Interaction Policy (EIP)}, a unified streaming framework that couples an Audio-Interaction expert with a motion expert through layer-wise joint attention. This allows motion generation to directly access the evolving interaction context. A chunk-wise causal mask prevents access to future context, while a vocal token encodes speaking state and the semantic emotion of the response. We construct \textbf{Embodied Interaction Dataset (EI-Data)} from co-speech and dyadic interaction data and train our model in two stages to learn state-adaptive and emotion-conditioned behavior. Combined with the frozen interaction expert, EIP supports continuous robot motion during proactive responses and interruption-aware turn-taking. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate improved motion quality over representative gesture-generation baselines. Compared with a representative cascaded system, EIP achieves higher interaction success and reduces warm-start latency by 64\%. Physical deployment and user studies further demonstrate improved motion naturalness and interaction comfort.

title: H-MSAE: Hierarchical Sparse Concept Coverage for Efficient and Diverse Instruction Data Selection
summary: Large instruction-tuning corpora contain substantial semantic redundancy, motivating the selection of compact subsets that preserve useful supervision while reducing training cost. Existing diversity-aware selectors often rely on generated semantic tags and explicit graph structures, introducing considerable annotation and preprocessing overhead. We introduce H-MSAE, a hierarchical sparse instruction selection framework that organizes multi-resolution concepts learned by a Matryoshka sparse autoencoder into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Quality-weighted, diminishing-return coverage with ancestor propagation promotes high-quality and non-redundant semantic coverage, while pool-relative length constraints regulate subset composition. We motivate this design through a local quality-diversity analysis of subset SFT utility and examine it using example-quality and representation-space diversity diagnostics. On Tulu 3 data pool, H-MSAE achieves the highest Final Avg among the evaluated 50K selectors across scales and initialization. The selected subset also exhibits the highest mean quality and effective rank among the evaluated methods. By avoiding full-pool generative tagging and supporting efficient sparse selection, H-MSAE reduces measured end-to-end runtime by approximately $5\times$ relative to MIG.

title: GGDriver: Glance at What Is Shared, Gaze at What Differs for Perception-Free Planning
summary: A planner deciding whether to turn left or continue straight needs to inspect different parts of the scene for each maneuver. Yet many end-to-end driving planners evaluate every candidate trajectory against the same compressed scene representation. We let each candidate select the visual evidence used to refine and score it. A global glance first produces trajectory hypotheses from shared scene features. We then project a corridor around each trajectory into the camera views and use the resulting mask to attend to patch features at the backbone's native resolution. After refinement, the scorer projects each final proposal again and ranks it using evidence along its own path. This geometric selection requires only the predicted trajectory and camera calibration. On three planners with different scene representations (learned registers, a perception-supervised bird's-eye-view grid, and a coarse image-token grid), adding this gaze improves planning scores. In ablations, path-aligned patches outperform both a matched number of randomly selected patches and attention over all patches. Using the gaze for ranking yields larger gains than using it for refinement alone. With a ViT-S backbone and no perception labels, GGDriver achieves a rater feedback score of 8.110 on the WOD-E2E test set, 94.2 PDMS on NAVSIM-v1, 48.6 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2, and a closed-loop Driving Score of 72.18 on Bench2Drive.

title: Karcher means of structured matrices are asymptotically structured: a study via Schatten estimates for the additive Richardson iteration
summary: In the present work, we first study the additive Richardson iteration for the Karcher mean of complex Hermitian positive definite (HPD) matrix sequences, by obtaining normalized Schatten estimates independent of the matrix dimension. These estimates are used to prove that Karcher means of structured matrices are asymptotically structured and this is proven for input HPD Toeplitz and generalized locally Toeplitz (GLT) matrix sequences. More precisely, we provide the a.c.s. approximation, which is the key for demonstrating the GLT closure under Schatten spectral bounds, and the GLT conclusion can be extended to matrix sequences with symbols that are positive definite almost everywhere. Ad hoc numerical experiments illustrate the spectral distribution consequences of these results and few related computational advantages. Concluding remarks and open problems are provided in the final section.

title: Zing-1.0: A Playable World System Built on Controllable Rendering
comments: 34 pages, 17 figures. Authors listed in reverse alphabetical order by surname
summary: We present Zing-1.0, a Playable World System built on Controllable Rendering. An executable engine resolves player actions under the world's rules and produces proxy video from the updated state. A streaming video model synthesizes the player's view from this proxy, and the runtime delivers it to inform subsequent actions. (1) Principle and system. We formulate Controllable Rendering and define the interfaces among world construction, world execution, observation synthesis, and the interaction runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first implementation-independent specification of a Playable World System. (2) AI-native engine. WorldKit provides structured authoring tools and reusable character, camera, and control components for coding agents to construct executable proxy worlds. It supports extensible interactions and precise geometric motion control while separating executable behavior from final visual appearance. (3) Streaming renderer. We adapt MiniMax-H3 for block-causal autoregressive generation and incremental decoding. Proxy video constrains structure and motion, while text and separate scene and subject references specify appearance. We train the generator on diverse tasks and distill it to generate each block in a few denoising steps. The renderer leads the compared streaming editors on OpenVE (3.90) and LongV2VBench (3.44). On StreamEval, Zing-1.0 scores 57.86 on instruction editing and 54.06 on reference editing, exceeding the published baselines on both tracks. (4) Interaction infrastructure. We build an Interaction Runtime that routes player actions to WorldKit while supporting in-play prompt and reference updates. Cross-block joint execution and sparse attention with compressed K/V reduce inference overhead. With the DiT on a single H200 and encoding and decoding on one H100 each, the serving system achieves a steady-state throughput of 23.82 FPS at $832\times480$.

title: Latent Jacobian Steer: Eliciting Contact-Rich Out-of-Distribution Behaviors from Pretrained Humanoid Controllers
summary: Given a pretrained general latent-conditioned whole-body humanoid controller, say a behavioral foundation model (BFM), how can we elicit complex and contact-rich out-of-distribution behaviors? Raw joint-action exploration enables direct, task-specific adjustments but can disrupt coordination learned by the pretrained controller, whereas latent exploration retains that coordination but is difficult to steer toward desired physical effects. To combine the complementary strengths of these exploration spaces, we propose Latent Jacobian Steer (LJS), which couples sampling in direct joint-action space with the semantics of the learned frozen controller's input latent space. For a task specified through desired physical effects, we sample task-relevant joint-action perturbations and map them through a damped local inverse of the policy Jacobian to obtain candidate latent ($z$) commands. These commands are executed through the frozen pretrained policy, while exploration is directed toward the physical outcomes required by the new task. Candidate outcomes are evaluated in simulation and composed into latent-command sequences that accomplish the task. Ablations show that neither action-space nor latent-space exploration alone provides the same capability as their coupling. Across diverse out-of-distribution tasks, simulation-based searching using this method produces contact-rich behaviors, including hurdling, manipulating articulated objects, and opening doors through non-prehensile contact. Over ten seeds, LJS completes more of each humanoid task than when searching in either space alone. Beyond humanoids, it also steers a goal-conditioned dexterous hand policy through four assembly tasks better than searching in goal space directly.

title: Unimodal Shortcuts and Joint Scene-Intent Dependence in Vision-Language Safety Representations
comments: 39 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables (14 pages main paper, 25 pages supplementary material)
summary: The safety of a request to a vision-language model often depends on the image: asking how to serve a dish is harmless for fresh food and harmful for spoiled food. High accuracy on situational safety benchmarks does not tell us whether a model's safety representation encodes both the scene and the user's intent, because a benchmark can often be solved from one modality alone. Studying frozen vision-language safety representations, we audit five public situational benchmarks and find that each admits a unimodal shortcut: images alone predict the labels, and on same-image prompt pairs a probe that never sees the photograph reaches 0.9645 AUROC. We therefore build a controlled evaluation that crosses safe and hazardous scenes with observation and action requests, so that no single-modality rule can exceed 0.500 group-ranking accuracy. On this control, linear probes on intermediate states of Qwen3-VL-8B and SmolVLM2-2.2B reach 0.958 and 0.930, showing that the scene-intent conjunction is linearly decodable; concatenating separately encoded image and text states already recovers most of this signal, so decodability is not evidence of a fusion mechanism. The same probes screen cheaply but generalize poorly to unseen images and other benchmarks. Reliable multimodal safety evaluation therefore needs controls that rule out unimodal shortcuts before accuracy is read as evidence of joint understanding.

title: CoGITAtion: Collaborative Gaze-based Interpretable Task-adaptive Representation for Privacy-sensitive Applications
summary: Gaze-based analysis provides rich behavioural information for privacy-sensitive applications, but deployment is challenged by heterogeneous, scarce, and distributed data. We present CoGITAtion (Collaborative Gaze-based Interpretable Task-Adaptive Representation), a framework for privacy-preserving inference over vertically distributed gaze data. CoGITAtion transforms variable-length gaze recordings into compact, interpretable gaze-transition graphs and descriptors computed locally by each data owner. Task-adaptive models accommodate heterogeneous and missing feature blocks through task and availability gating, avoiding unnecessary private computation. Results show that shared components capture patterns that generalise across tasks, while task-specific components provide capacity without increasing model size. Public availability gating further reduces encrypted computation by removing branches determined by publicly known task and owner availability without altering predictions. Overall, CoGITAtion enables gaze model reuse, efficient privacy-preserving deployment, and robust inference under incomplete owner availability while retaining interpretable gaze representations.

title: ReSA: Preserving Reference-Specified Foreground in In-Context Segmentation
summary: In-context segmentation uses annotated references to specify the target and its extent in a query image. Accurately transferring this reference-specified foreground requires recovering target regions while suppressing irrelevant predictions. We propose ReSA, a reference-guided framework that unifies query adaptation and mask selection through a shared reference kernel. ReSA leverages foreground and background reference prototypes to constrain prediction changes during adaptation and guide foreground selection through reference-weighted reconstruction. This shared guidance promotes consistent use of reference information across prediction refinement and mask formation. ReSA further selects among adapted predictions and aligns boundary refinement with the selected foreground threshold. We establish a theoretical bound connecting reference-response changes during adaptation and soft reconstruction. With a frozen visual encoder and lightweight test-time adaptation, ReSA requires no offline task training. Ablation studies demonstrate improved foreground retention and effective suppression of false-positive regions, while qualitative results show more complete masks with fewer isolated artifacts. Across ten object, part, and cross-domain segmentation benchmarks, ReSA achieves the highest average mIoU among the evaluated methods, reaching 62.6% in 1-shot and 71.8% in 5-shot.

title: Learning Interaction Dynamics via Motion-Region Guidance for Robotic Video World Models
summary: Action-conditioned video world models imagine future observations under candidate robot actions, providing a promising visual tool for robot policy evaluation and interaction simulation. However, existing video world models often optimize global reconstruction errors instead of emphasizing interaction-relevant regions. As a result, they may preserve overall scene appearance but overlook local interaction details, leading to physically implausible outcomes such as hallucinated contact effects and inconsistent robot-object interactions. We introduce MoReWorld, a unified motion-region-guided framework that uses a shared motion region, the part of the environment that moves in response to the robot's actions, to focus dynamics learning and video generation on interaction-relevant regions. The same motion region guides local motion prediction, region-aware supervision, and motion-gated future-feature conditioning. At inference time, the motion region is predicted as a motion probability map from visual history and robot actions, without requiring future observations or ground-truth motion labels. On WorldSimProbe, MoReWorld achieves the highest overall simulator-faithfulness score, with the strongest performance on local consistency, global consistency, and interaction dynamics. These results indicate that motion-region guidance helps the model preserve scene-level consistency while more faithfully predicting action-conditioned interaction dynamics.

title: Dual-Agent DRL based Cooperative Beamforming and Trajectory Optimization for UAV-ISAC Networks
comments: 16 pages, 10 figures, accepted by IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: This paper considers a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) network, where multiple ground base stations (BSs) provide integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) services for multiple communication UAVs (C-UAVs) and sensing UAVs (S-UAVs). With the objective of maximizing the average sum rate of C-UAVs over the entire flight episode, we jointly optimize the multi-BS multi-UAV ISAC beamforming and trajectory design, subject to the BS transmit power budget and the sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) constraints of S-UAVs, as well as the flight mission and collision avoidance constraints of C-UAVs and S-UAVs. Based on the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) technique, we develop a dual-agent scheme, termed DeepDA-OPT, to solve the resulting constrained Markov decision process (MDP). In the proposed DeepDA-OPT scheme, two agents, i.e., Agent-B and Agent-T, are specifically deployed for learning the multi-BS ISAC transmit beamformers and the C-UAV/S-UAV trajectories, respectively, where the optimal BS receive beamformers for the sensing echo signals of S-UAVs are obtained in closed form by leveraging the generalized Rayleigh quotient theorem. To mitigate the overestimation of value functions, both Agent-B and Agent-T are trained based on the twin-delayed deep deterministic (TD3) policy-gradient algorithm. In addition, a constraint-aware noise exploration policy is employed, and the reward function is designed to incorporate a sensing penalty and a flight urgency penalty, thereby guiding the training of Agent-B and Agent-T. Numerical results show that, compared with the baseline schemes, the proposed DeepDA-OPT scheme achieves a higher average sum rate of C-UAVs, while the sensing SINR constraints are empirically well satisfied and no collision violation is observed under the evaluated settings.
