title: Towards Comprehensible Recommendation with Large Language Model Fine-tuning
summary: Recommender systems have become increasingly ubiquitous in daily life. While traditional recommendation approaches primarily rely on ID-based representations or item-side content features, they often fall short in capturing the underlying semantics aligned with user preferences (e.g., recommendation reasons for items), leading to a semantic-collaborative gap. Recently emerged LLM-based feature extraction approaches also face a key challenge: how to ensure that LLMs possess recommendation-aligned reasoning capabilities and can generate accurate, personalized reasons to mitigate the semantic-collaborative gap. To address these issues, we propose a novel Content Understanding from a Collaborative Perspective framework (CURec), which generates collaborative-aligned content features for more comprehensive recommendations. CURec first adapts the LLM with recommendation objectives through post-training, equipping it with instruction-following and chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. Next, we use the LLM-generated features to train the recommender model. Then, we treat the user-item prediction scores produced by the trained recommender model as reward signals to guide RL-based refinement of the LLM, thereby improving the quality of generated reasons and pattern. The corrected reasons are directly integrated into the recommender model to enhance comprehensibility and recommendation performance. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of CURec over existing methods.

AI.title_translation: 通往基于大型语言模型微调的可理解推荐的道路
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为CURec的新框架，通过微调大型语言模型（LLM）来弥合推荐系统中语义与协同之间的差距，从而生成更全面、更具可理解性的推荐。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐方法难以捕捉与用户偏好一致的潜在语义（例如推荐原因），导致语义-协同鸿沟。现有的基于LLM的特征提取方法也面临如何确保LLM具备推荐对齐的推理能力并生成准确、个性化原因以缓解该鸿沟的挑战。
AI.method: CURec框架首先通过预训练使LLM适应推荐目标，使其具备指令遵循和思维链推理能力。然后，利用LLM生成的特征训练推荐模型。接着，将推荐模型产生的用户-物品预测分数作为奖励信号，通过基于强化学习（RL）的方法优化LLM，以提高生成原因的质量和模式。最后，将修正后的原因直接整合到推荐模型中，以增强可理解性和推荐性能。
AI.result: CURec在公开基准测试上的广泛实验表明，其性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CURec框架通过使LLM具备推荐对齐的推理能力，并利用强化学习优化生成原因，有效弥合了语义-协同鸿沟，显著提高了推荐系统的可理解性和性能。
AI.translation: 推荐系统已日益普及。虽然传统的推荐方法主要依赖于基于ID的表示或物品侧的内容特征，但它们常常难以捕捉与用户偏好一致的潜在语义（例如物品的推荐原因），从而导致语义-协同鸿沟。最近出现的大型语言模型（LLM）的特征提取方法也面临一个关键挑战：如何确保LLM具备推荐对齐的推理能力，并能生成准确、个性化的原因来缓解语义-协同鸿沟。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的“协同视角下的内容理解”框架（CURec），该框架生成与协同信息对齐的内容特征，以实现更全面的推荐。CURec首先通过预训练使LLM适应推荐目标，使其具备指令遵循和思维链推理能力。然后，我们使用LLM生成的特征来训练推荐模型。接着，我们将训练好的推荐模型产生的用户-物品预测分数作为奖励信号，通过基于强化学习（RL）的方法来优化LLM，从而提高生成原因的质量和模式。修正后的原因直接整合到推荐模型中，以增强可理解性和推荐性能。在公开基准上的广泛实验证明了CURec优于现有方法的性能。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了CURec框架，通过对大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调，使其能够理解协同信息并生成与用户偏好对齐的推荐原因。该框架首先通过预训练使LLM具备推荐推理能力，然后利用LLM特征训练推荐模型，并使用推荐分数作为奖励信号通过强化学习进一步优化LLM。最终，将优化后的原因整合到推荐模型中，以提高推荐的可理解性和整体性能。实验结果表明CURec优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统,大型语言模型,可理解性,语义-协同鸿沟,强化学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的方法，利用大型语言模型（LLM）来解决推荐系统中长期存在的语义-协同鸿沟问题。通过将LLM与推荐任务相结合，并利用强化学习进行优化，CURec有望生成更具可解释性和个性化的推荐。然而，该方法在计算成本和模型部署方面可能面临挑战。未来的研究可以探索更高效的微调策略或模型压缩技术。

title: Bridging the Mobile Trust Gap: A Zero Trust Framework for Consumer-Facing Applications
comments: 43 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Working Paper - Version 1.0. Submitted under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. Also available as an SSRN Working Paper. Feedback and collaboration are welcome
summary: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) has become a widely adopted model for securing enterprise environments, promoting continuous verification and minimal trust across systems. However, its application in mobile contexts remains limited, despite mobile applications now accounting for most global digital interactions and being increasingly targeted by sophisticated threats. Existing Zero Trust frameworks developed by organisations such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) primarily focus on enterprise-managed infrastructure, assuming organisational control over devices, networks, and identities. This paper addresses a critical gap by proposing an extended Zero Trust model designed for mobile applications operating in untrusted, user-controlled environments. Using a design science methodology, the study introduced a six-pillar framework that supports runtime enforcement of trust through controls including device integrity, user identity validation, data protection, secure application programming interface (API) usage, behavioural monitoring, and live application protection. Each pillar was mapped to relevant regulatory and security standards to support compliance. A phased implementation roadmap and maturity assessment model were also developed to guide adoption across varying organisational contexts. The proposed model offers a practical and standards-aligned approach to securing mobile applications beyond pre-deployment controls, aligning real-time enforcement with Zero Trust principles. This contribution expands the operational boundaries of ZTA and provides organisations with a deployable path to reduce fraud, enhance compliance, and address emerging mobile security challenges. Future research may include empirical validation of the framework and cross-sector application testing.

AI.title_translation: 弥合移动信任鸿沟：面向消费类应用的零信任框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对消费端移动应用的扩展零信任框架，通过六大支柱实现运行时的信任强制执行，以弥补传统企业零信任模型在移动端的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的零信任框架主要侧重于企业托管的基础设施，假设组织对设备、网络和身份具有控制权，而在不受信任、由用户控制的环境中，移动应用的零信任应用十分有限，因此存在填补这一关键安全空白的需求。
AI.method: 采用设计科学方法（design science methodology），提出了一个包含六大支柱的扩展零信任框架，涵盖设备完整性、用户身份验证、数据保护、安全API使用、行为监控和实时应用保护，并将其映射到相关法规和安全标准，同时开发了分阶段实施路线图和成熟度评估模型。
AI.result: 成功开发了一个六大支柱的零信任框架，支持运行时的信任强制执行，将其映射至安全标准，并制定了实施路线图和成熟度评估模型，帮助组织减少欺诈并提升安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究扩展了零信任架构的操作边界，为组织提供了一条可部署的路径，以降低欺诈风险、增强合规性并应对新兴的移动安全挑战。
AI.translation: 零信任架构（ZTA）已成为保护企业环境的广泛采用的模型，它在各个系统中推广持续验证和最低信任原则。然而，尽管移动应用程序现在占据了全球绝大多数数字交互，且日益成为复杂威胁的目标，其在移动环境中的应用仍然有限。国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）和网络安全与基础设施安全局（CISA）等机构现有的零信任框架主要关注企业托管的基础设施，假设组织对设备、网络和身份具有控制权。本文通过提出一个专为在不受信任、用户控制环境中运行的移动应用设计的扩展零信任模型，解决了一个关键空白。该研究使用设计科学方法，引入了一个六支柱框架，通过设备完整性、用户身份验证、数据保护、安全应用程序接口（API）使用、行为监控和实时应用保护等控制措施，支持信任的运行时强制执行。每个支柱都映射到相关的监管和安全标准以支持合规性。还开发了分阶段实施路线图和成熟度评估模型，以指导不同组织环境下的采用。所提出的模型提供了一种实用且符合标准的途径，在部署前控制之外保护移动应用，将实时强制执行与零信任原则相结合。这一贡献扩展了零信任架构的操作边界，并为组织提供了一条可部署的路径，以减少欺诈、增强合规性并应对新兴的移动安全挑战。未来的研究可能包括该框架的实证验证和跨行业应用测试。
AI.summary: 该论文针对移动应用在不受信任环境中缺乏零信任机制的问题，利用设计科学方法提出了一个包含六大支柱的扩展零信任框架。该框架实现了运行时的信任执行，并配合合规标准、实施路线图与成熟度评估模型，为移动应用安全提供了切实的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 零信任架构, 移动应用安全, 设计科学方法, 运行时控制, 合规性
AI.comments: 该论文填补了零信任架构在面向消费者的移动应用场景中的空白，提出的六大支柱框架结合了运行时执行和合规性标准，具有很高的实用价值。

title: VASSO: Variance Suppression for Sharpness-Aware Minimization
summary: Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) has well-documented merits in enhancing generalization of deep neural network models. Accounting for sharpness in the loss function geometry, where neighborhoods of `flat minima' heighten generalization ability, SAM seeks `flat valleys' by minimizing the maximum loss provoked by an adversarial perturbation within the neighborhood. Although critical to account for sharpness of the loss function, in practice SAM suffers from `over-friendly adversaries,' which can curtail the outmost level of generalization. To avoid such `friendliness,' the present contribution fosters stabilization of adversaries through variance suppression (VASSO). VASSO offers a general approach to provably stabilize adversaries. In particular, when integrating VASSO with SAM, improved generalizability is numerically validated on extensive vision and language tasks. Once applied on top of a computationally efficient SAM variant, VASSO offers a desirable generalization-computation tradeoff.

AI.title_translation: VASSO：用于锐度感知最小化的方差抑制
AI.tldr: SAM 存在“过度友好”的对手，限制了泛化能力。VASSO 通过抑制方差来稳定对手，从而提高泛化能力，并在视觉和语言任务上得到验证，在泛化和计算之间取得了良好的权衡。
AI.motivation: SAM 在提高深度神经网络泛化能力方面有显著优点，但存在“过度友好”的对手问题，限制了泛化能力。因此，需要一种方法来稳定对手。
AI.method: VASSO 通过抑制方差来稳定对手，并将其应用于 SAM。VASSO 是一种通用的方法，可以证明对手的稳定性。
AI.result: 将 VASSO 与 SAM 集成后，在广泛的视觉和语言任务上进行了数值验证，提高了泛化能力。当应用于计算高效的 SAM 变体时，VASSO 在泛化和计算之间提供了理想的权衡。
AI.conclusion: VASSO 是一种通用的方法，通过抑制方差来稳定对手，可以提高 SAM 的泛化能力，并在泛化和计算之间取得良好的权衡。
AI.translation: 锐度感知最小化（SAM）在提高深度神经网络模型的泛化能力方面具有重要的优点。SAM 通过最小化邻域内对抗性扰动所引起的最大损失来寻找“平坦的谷”，从而考虑了损失函数几何形状中的锐度，其中“平坦最小化”的邻域能够提高泛化能力。虽然考虑损失函数的锐度至关重要，但实际上 SAM 受到“过度友好”的对手的困扰，这可能会限制泛化能力的最高水平。为了避免这种“友好性”，本研究通过方差抑制（VASSO）来促进对手的稳定。VASSO 提供了一种通用的方法来证明对手的稳定性。特别是，当将 VASSO 与 SAM 集成时，在广泛的视觉和语言任务上对改进的泛化能力进行了数值验证。一旦应用于计算高效的 SAM 变体之上，VASSO 提供了理想的泛化-计算权衡。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 VASSO（方差抑制）的新方法，用于解决锐度感知最小化（SAM）中存在的“过度友好”对手问题，该问题会限制模型的泛化能力。VASSO 通过抑制方差来稳定对手，从而提高了泛化能力。研究人员在广泛的视觉和语言任务上对 VASSO 进行了数值验证，结果表明，当与 SAM 结合使用时，VASSO 能够显著提高模型的泛化能力，并在泛化性能和计算成本之间取得了良好的权衡。
AI.keywords: 锐度感知最小化, SAM, 方差抑制, VASSO, 泛化能力
AI.comments: VASSO 提出了一种解决 SAM 现有局限性的创新方法。通过稳定对手，该方法有望进一步提升深度学习模型的泛化能力。然而，还需要进一步研究其在更广泛任务和模型上的适用性，以及其计算成本的实际影响。

title: Beyond Output Faithfulness: Diagnosing and Mitigating Pathway Rerouting in Feature Attribution
summary:
Insertion and deletion are standard metrics for evaluating feature
  attributions by progressively adding or removing pixels. While they test
  whether attributed features control a model output, they do not verify
  whether they do so through the computation that supports the clean
  prediction. We study this distinction with Ensemble Quantile Optimization (EQO),
  a differentiable method that directly optimizes the insertion sequence.
  On CNNs, Unconstrained EQO attains the highest insertion scores while departing
  from clean representations and retaining its insertion score after channels
  supporting the clean prediction are ablated. Together, these results reveal
  pathway rerouting that output-only metrics cannot detect. On a Vision
  Transformer, target predictions from black inputs and attention deviation
  expose the same failure.
  To address this, we introduce ClipGrad, a layer-wise gradient
  filter that preserves clean activation trajectories during optimization.
  ClipGrad suppresses rerouting exploits while maintaining high output
  sensitivity across convolutional networks and Vision Transformers, and
  token intervention confirms this mitigation on the Transformer. These
  results show that output sensitivity is necessary but insufficient: a faithful
  attribution must control the output through internal computation used for the
  clean prediction.

AI.title_translation: 超越输出忠实性：诊断与缓解特征归因中的路径重定向
AI.tldr: 本文发现现有的特征归因评估方法会受到“路径重定向”的欺骗，并提出了新方法ClipGrad来确保特征归因的真实内部忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有的标准指标（如插入和删除）只能测试归因特征是否控制模型输出，但无法验证它们是否通过支持干净预测的原始计算路径来实现，这导致了无法检测的“路径重定向”问题。
AI.method: 使用集成量化优化（EQO）方法直接优化插入序列，并在卷积神经网络和视觉Transformer上进行诊断；同时引入了ClipGrad（一种逐层梯度过滤器）来保持干净的激活轨迹。
AI.result: 无约束EQO在CNN上获得了最高插入分数，但在消融支持干净预测的通道后仍保持该分数，暴露出路径重定向现象；而ClipGrad成功抑制了这种重定向漏洞，同时在CNN和ViT中保持了高的输出敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 输出忠实性并不等同于特征归因的真实忠实性，特征归因必须确保通过用于干净预测的内部计算来控制输出。
AI.translation: 插入和删除是评估特征归因的标准指标，通过逐步添加或移除像素来实现。虽然它们测试了归因特征是否控制模型输出，但并未验证它们是否通过支持干净预测的计算来实现。我们通过集成量化优化（EQO）研究了这种区别，这是一种直接优化插入序列的可微分方法。在CNN上，无约束的EQO获得了最高的插入分数，同时偏离了干净的表示，并且在消融支持干净预测的通道后仍保留其插入分数。这些结果共同揭示了纯输出指标无法检测到的路径重定向。在视觉Transformer上，来自黑色输入的预测目标和注意力偏差暴露出相同的失败。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ClipGrad，一种在优化过程中保留干净激活轨迹的逐层梯度过滤器。ClipGrad抑制了重定向漏洞，同时在卷积网络和视觉Transformer中保持了高输出敏感度，标记干预证实了Transformer上的这种缓解效果。这些结果表明，输出敏感性是必要的，但也是不充分的：一个忠实的归因必须通过用于干净预测的内部计算来控制输出。
AI.summary: 论文研究了特征归因评估中的路径重定向问题，指出仅靠输出敏感性是不够的。作者提出了EQO方法来诊断这一问题，并引入了ClipGrad这一逐层梯度过滤器来缓解重定向，从而确保特征归因通过内部干净的计算来控制输出。
AI.keywords: Feature Attribution, Pathway Rerouting, Ensemble Quantile Optimization, ClipGrad, Interpretability
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了特征归因评估中的一个盲点（路径重定向），并提出了创新的诊断工具EQO和缓解方法ClipGrad，对可解释性AI（XAI）领域的发展具有重要意义。

title: Reconstruction Alignment Improves Unified Multimodal Models
comments: 43 pages, 36 figures and 14 tables; accepted by ICLR 2026. A simple way to use visual understanding to improve image generation
summary: We discover a simple but effective way for visual understanding to help visual generation in a unified model. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) unify visual understanding and generation within a single architecture. However, conventional training relies on image-text pairs (or sequences) whose captions are typically sparse and miss fine-grained visual details, even when they use hundreds of words to describe a simple image. We introduce Reconstruction Alignment (RecA), a resource-efficient post-training method that leverages visual understanding encoder embeddings as dense "text prompts," providing rich supervision without captions. Concretely, RecA conditions a UMM on its own visual understanding embeddings and optimizes it to reconstruct the input image with a self-supervised reconstruction loss, thereby using visual understanding to improve image generation. Despite its simplicity, RecA is broadly applicable: across autoregressive, masked-autoregressive, and diffusion-based UMMs, it consistently improves generation and editing fidelity. With only 27 GPU hours, post-training with RecA substantially improves image generation performance on GenEval (0.73 $\rightarrow$ 0.90) and DPGBench (80.93 $\rightarrow$ 88.15), while also boosting editing benchmarks (ImgEdit 3.38 $\rightarrow$ 3.75, GEdit 6.94 $\rightarrow$ 7.27). Notably, RecA surpasses much larger open-source models and applies broadly across diverse UMM architectures, establishing it as an efficient and general post-training alignment strategy for UMMs.

AI.title_translation: 重建对齐提升统一多模态模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RecA的高效后训练方法，利用视觉理解嵌入作为密集提示，显著提升了统一多模态模型的图像生成与编辑性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的统一多模态模型依赖于图文对进行训练，但图像标题通常较为稀疏，无法捕捉细粒度的视觉细节，导致视觉理解对视觉生成的帮助受限。
AI.method: 引入重建对齐（RecA）方法，将统一多模态模型的自身视觉理解编码器嵌入用作密集文本提示，并通过自监督重建损失优化模型来重建输入图像。
AI.result: 仅需27个GPU小时的后训练，RecA就在GenEval（0.73至0.90）、DPGBench（80.93至88.15）以及图像编辑基准上取得了显著的性能提升，超越了许多更大的开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 重构对齐（RecA）是一种资源高效且通用的后训练策略，能够通过视觉理解增强统一多模态模型的图像生成与编辑性能。
AI.translation: 我们发现了一种在统一模型中通过视觉理解来帮助视觉生成的简单而有效的方法。统一多模态模型（UMMs）将视觉理解和生成统一在一个单一的架构中。然而，传统的训练依赖于图文对（或序列），其标题通常很稀疏，即使使用数百个单词来描述一个简单的图像，也往往会漏掉细粒度的视觉细节。我们引入了重建对齐（RecA），这是一种资源高效的后训练方法，它利用视觉理解编码器的嵌入作为密集的“文本提示”，在没有标题的情况下提供丰富的监督。具体而言，RecA使UMM以其自身的视觉理解嵌入为条件，并对其进行优化，通过自监督重建损失来重建输入图像，从而利用视觉理解来改善图像生成。尽管非常简单，但RecA具有广泛的适用性：在自回归、掩码自回归和基于扩散的UMM中，它始终如一地提高了生成和编辑的保真度。仅需27个GPU小时，使用RecA进行后训练就大幅提高了GenEval（0.73 $\rightarrow$ 0.90）和DPGBench（80.93 $\rightarrow$ 88.15）上的图像生成性能，同时也提升了编辑基准（ImgEdit 3.38 $\rightarrow$ 3.75，GEdit 6.94 $\rightarrow$ 7.27）。值得注意的是，RecA超越了许多更大的开源模型，并广泛适用于各种UMM架构，确立了其作为UMM的高效且通用的后训练对齐策略的地位。
AI.summary: 论文提出了重建对齐（RecA）方法，利用视觉理解编码器的嵌入作为稠密提示来监督图像生成，从而在无需额外文本标注的情况下提升了统一多模态模型的生成与编辑保真度。
AI.keywords: Unified Multimodal Models, Visual Generation, Reconstruction Alignment, Post-training Alignment, Visual Understanding
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种简单而高效的后训练对齐方法（RecA），利用视觉理解编码器的嵌入作为密集文本提示进行重建监督，从而有效克服了传统图文对中描述稀疏的局限。该方法计算资源消耗低，且对多种统一多模态架构具有通用性，显著提升了图像生成和编辑的保真度。

title: "It Was a Magical Box": Understanding Practitioner Workflows and Needs in Optimization
comments: Proc. ACM Hum.-Comput. Interact., Vol. 11, No. 2, Article CSCW010
summary: Optimization underpins decision-making in domains from healthcare to logistics, yet for many practitioners it remains a "magical box": powerful but opaque, difficult to use, and reliant on specialized expertise. While prior work has extensively studied machine learning workflows, the everyday practices of optimization model developers (OMDs) have received little attention. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 15 OMDs across diverse domains to examine how optimization is done in practice. Our findings reveal a highly iterative workflow spanning six stages: problem elicitation, data processing, model development, implementation, validation, and deployment. Importantly, we find that optimization practice is not only about algorithms that deliver better decisions, but is equally shaped by data and dialogue---the ongoing communication with stakeholders that enables problem framing, calibrated trust, and adoption. We discuss opportunities for future tooling that foregrounds data and dialogue alongside decision-making, opening new directions for human-centered optimization.
comment: Proc. ACM Hum.-Comput. Interact., Vol. 11, No. 2, Article CSCW010

AI.title_translation: “它曾是个魔盒”：理解优化领域从业者工作流程与需求
AI.tldr: 通过对优化模型开发人员的访谈，揭示了其包含六个阶段的迭代工作流程，并指出数据和对话在优化实践中与算法同等重要。
AI.motivation: 尽管优化技术在医疗和物流等领域被广泛应用，但由于其复杂性和不透明性，对许多从业者而言仍如“魔盒”一般，且先前的工作缺乏对优化模型开发人员日常工作流程的研究。
AI.method: 通过对来自不同领域的15名优化模型开发人员（OMD）进行半结构化访谈，研究他们的实际工作实践和需求。
AI.result: 揭示了一个包含六个阶段的高度迭代工作流程：问题引出、数据处理、模型开发、实现、验证和部署，并发现优化实践同样受制于数据和与利益相关者的持续对话。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，优化实践是一个跨越六个阶段的高度迭代过程，且数据和人际对话在其中起着至关重要的作用，未来的优化工具应更加关注人机交互、数据处理和利益相关者沟通。
AI.translation: 优化技术支撑着从医疗到物流等领域的决策，但对许多从业者而言，它仍然是一个“魔盒”：功能强大却不透明、难以使用且依赖专业知识。尽管先前的研究广泛探讨了机器学习工作流程，但优化模型开发人员（OMD）的日常实践却很少受到关注。我们对来自不同领域的15名OMD进行了半结构化访谈，以检验实际中的优化工作方式。研究结果揭示了一个包含六个阶段的高度迭代工作流程：问题引出、数据处理、模型开发、实现、验证和部署。重要的是，我们发现优化实践不仅关乎提供更好决策的算法，同样也塑造于数据和对话之中——即与利益相关者的持续沟通，它促进了问题构架、校准信任和技术采纳。我们探讨了未来工具开发的机遇，这些工具除了决策制定外，还将突出数据和对话的作用，为以人为本的优化开辟新的方向。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对15位优化模型开发人员进行半结构化访谈，揭示了优化工作是一个包含六个阶段的迭代流程，并强调了数据和利益相关者对话在优化实践中的核心作用，为开发以人为本的优化工具提供了新思路。
AI.keywords: 优化模型开发人员, 工作流程, 以人为本的优化, 半结构化访谈, 决策支持
AI.comments: 该论文首次深入研究了优化模型开发人员（OMD）的日常工作流程，揭示了优化实践不仅涉及算法，还深受数据和与利益相关者对话的影响，为未来以人为本的优化工具开发指明了新方向。

title: Family Matters: Language Transfer and Merging for Adapting Small LLMs to Faroese
summary: In this paper, we investigate strategies for adapting small language models to Faroese, a low-resource North Germanic language. Starting from English-pretrained models, we first continue pre-training on other Scandinavian languages, either individually or combined via model merging or multilingual pre-training, before fine-tuning on Faroese. To address the lack of existing Faroese evaluation resources, we construct two new minimal-pair probing benchmarks, one for linguistic acceptability and one for text comprehension, and complement them with human evaluations conducted by native Faroese linguists. Our results show that transfer from related languages improves language modeling and linguistic acceptability, while gains on comprehension probes are inconsistent across model sizes and tuning methods. Icelandic is the strongest single source language for linguistic acceptability, but no single language is reliably best for comprehension. Under full fine-tuning, merging improves on the best single source language in perplexity, outperforms joint multilingual pre-training, and gives the best comprehension scores. With LoRA however, joint multilingual pre-training is the stronger initialization.

AI.title_translation: 家庭事务：用于将小型大语言模型适配到法罗语的语言迁移与融合
AI.tldr: 研究了如何通过语言迁移和模型融合将小型语言模型适配到低资源语言法罗语，并构建了新的评估基准。
AI.motivation: 法罗语是一种低资源北日耳曼语种，缺乏针对性的语言模型评估资源和高效的适应策略，因此需要研究如何通过语言迁移和模型融合将小型语言模型高效适配到法罗语。
AI.method: 从英语预训练模型出发，首先在其他斯堪的纳维亚语上通过单独持续预训练、多语言预训练或模型融合进行迁移，随后在法罗语上进行微调；同时构建了两个最小对测验基准（语言可接受性和文本理解），并结合母语 linguists 的人工评估。
AI.result: 相关语言的迁移提升了语言建模和语言可接受性，冰岛语是最好的单源语言；在全量微调下，模型融合表现优于单一源语言和联合多语言预训练，但在使用LoRA时，联合多语言预训练是更强的初始化方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用相关语言进行持续预训练和模型融合能够有效提升小语言模型在法罗语上的性能，其中冰岛语作为单一源语言效果显著，而模型融合在全量微调下表现优异。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了将小型语言模型适配到低资源北日耳曼语种法罗语的策略。从英语预训练模型开始，我们首先在其他斯堪的纳维亚语上继续预训练（通过单独预训练、模型融合或多语言预训练相结合），然后在法罗语上进行微调。为了解决法罗语缺乏现有评估资源的问题，我们构建了两个新的最小对探测基准（一个用于语言可接受性，一个用于文本理解），并辅以由法罗语母语语言学家进行的人工评估。我们的结果表明，来自相关语言的迁移改善了语言建模和语言可接受性，但对理解探测的增益在不同模型大小和微调方法之间并不一致。冰岛语是语言可接受性方面最强的单一源语言，但没有哪一种单一语言在理解方面表现出绝对优势。在全量微调下，模型融合在困惑度方面优于最佳单一源语言，表现优于联合多语言预训练，并给出了最佳的理解得分。然而，在使用LoRA时，联合多语言预训练是更强的初始化方法。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了通过语言迁移、多语言预训练和模型融合将小型语言模型适配到低资源语言法罗语的策略，并引入了新的评估基准和人工评估，证明了相关语种迁移和模型融合在低资源语言适应中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 语言模型适配, 法罗语, 语言迁移, 模型融合, 低资源语言
AI.comments: 该论文针对法罗语这一低资源日耳曼语种，系统探讨了小语言模型的语言迁移与模型融合策略，并创新性地构建了两个最小对测验基准，对低资源语言大模型适配研究具有重要的参考价值和方法论启示。

title: Rhythm-TTS: High-Fidelity Shortcut Latent Modeling and Probabilistic Rhythm Generation for Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) systems are commonly built on either discrete codec tokens or continuous acoustic representations. Discrete-token models benefit from stable sequence modeling and explicit speech factorization, but they ultimately synthesize speech through codebook lookup and codeword composition, which can accumulate errors and impose a quality ceiling on naturalness and speaker similarity. Continuous-representation models can generate fine-grained speech latents directly, but often require heavier in-context modeling and less explicit alignment. This paper presents Rhythm-TTS, a shortcut zero-shot TTS framework that combines the factorizability of discrete codec tokens with the fidelity of continuous latent generation. Instead of using predicted codec tokens as the final acoustic representation, Rhythm-TTS uses them as a semantic-acoustic prior and directly generates holistic continuous speech latents with flow matching, bypassing the discrete-to-latent reconstruction path at inference time. We further address an underexplored dimension of speech naturalness: rhythm diversity across multiple synthesis runs. Motivated by the hypothesis that rhythm variation is largely governed by phoneme duration changes and the occurrence of silent pauses, we introduce probabilistic Duration and Silence Generators to sample dynamic pacing patterns before acoustic generation. Experiments on zero-shot TTS benchmarks evaluate intelligibility, naturalness, speaker similarity, efficiency, and run-to-run rhythm diversity, showing that the proposed shortcut latent modeling and probabilistic rhythm generation improve the fidelity and temporal naturalness of non-autoregressive zero-shot TTS. Code and audio samples are available at our demo page https://rhythm-tts.github.io.

AI.title_translation: Rhythm-TTS：用于零样本文本转语音的高保真快捷潜在建模与概率节奏生成
AI.tldr: Rhythm-TTS通过快捷潜在建模和概率节奏生成，实现了高保真、具节奏多样性的零样本语音合成。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散Codec Token模型存在码本查找和组合的质量上限，而连续表示模型需要较重的上下文建模。此外，多轮合成中的节奏多样性在以往的研究中较少被探讨。为了克服这些局限并提升语音的保真度与节奏自然度，作者提出了Rhythm-TTS。
AI.method: 提出Rhythm-TTS框架，将预测的Codec Token用作语义-声学先验，利用流匹配（flow matching）直接生成整体的连续语音潜在表示；并引入概率时长与停顿生成器（Duration and Silence Generators）来采样动态的节奏模式。
AI.result: 在零样本TTS基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的快捷潜在建模和概率节奏生成方法有效提升了非自回归零样本TTS的保真度、可懂度、说话人相似度以及运行间的节奏多样性。
AI.conclusion: Rhythm-TTS通过快捷潜在建模和概率节奏生成，成功提升了非自回归零样本TTS的语音保真度与时间自然度。
AI.translation: 零样本文本转语音（TTS）系统通常建立在离散编解码器标记（codec tokens）或连续声学表示之上。离散标记模型受益于稳定的序列建模和显式的语音因子分解，但它们最终通过码本查找和码字组合合成语音，这会累积误差并对自然度和说话人相似度施加质量上限。连续表示模型可以直接生成细粒度的语音潜在表示，但通常需要更重的上下文建模和较不显式的对齐。本文提出了Rhythm-TTS，这是一个快捷的零样本TTS框架，它结合了离散编解码器标记的可因子分解性与连续潜在生成的保真度。Rhythm-TTS没有将预测的编解码器标记用作最终的声学表示，而是将其用作语义-声学先验，并利用流匹配直接生成整体的连续语音潜在表示，从而在推理时绕过了离散到潜在的重建路径。我们进一步探讨了语音自然度中一个鲜有研究的维度：多次合成运行中的节奏多样性。受节奏变化主要由音素持续时间变化和静音停顿出现所主导这一假设的启发，我们引入了概率性时长和静音生成器，以在声学生成之前对动态的语速模式进行采样。零样本TTS基准测试的实验评估了可懂度、自然度、说话人相似度、效率以及运行间的节奏多样性，结果表明所提出的快捷潜在建模和概率节奏生成改善了非自回归零样本TTS的保真度和时间自然度。代码和音频样本可在我们的演示页面 https://rhythm-tts.github.io 上获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Rhythm-TTS，一种结合离散Token可分解性与连续潜在生成高保真度的零样本TTS框架。它利用流匹配直接生成连续语音潜在表示，并引入概率时长和停顿生成器来增强语音的节奏多样性和自然度。
AI.keywords: Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech, Shortcut Latent Modeling, Probabilistic Rhythm, Flow Matching
AI.comments: 本文创新性地结合了离散Codec Token的可分解性与连续潜在空间的高保真度，并通过概率化的时长与停顿生成器解决了零样本TTS中节奏多样性不足的问题，显著提升了语音的自然度和表现力。

title: Improving Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Systems with Group Similarity Rewards
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where users expect outputs to be consistent across semantically equivalent queries. However, existing systems often exhibit significant inconsistencies due to variability in both the retriever and generator, undermining trust and reliability. In this work, we focus on information consistency, i.e., the requirement that generated outputs convey the same core content across semantically equivalent inputs. We introduce a principled evaluation framework that decomposes RAG consistency into retriever-level, generator-level, and end-to-end components, enabling systematic identification of inconsistency sources. To improve consistency, we propose Paraphrased Set Group Relative Policy Optimization (PS-GRPO), an RL approach that leverages multiple rollouts across paraphrased set to assign group similarity rewards. We leverage PS-GRPO to achieve Information Consistent RAG (Con-RAG), training the generator to produce consistent outputs across paraphrased queries and remain robust to retrieval-induced variability. Because exact reward computation over paraphrase sets is computationally expensive, we also introduce a scalable approximation method that retains effectiveness while enabling efficient, large-scale training. Empirical evaluations across short-form, multi-hop, and long-form QA benchmarks demonstrate that Con-RAG significantly improves consistency while preserving accuracy compared to baselines, even in the absence of explicit ground-truth supervision. Our work provides practical solutions for evaluating and building reliable RAG systems for safety-critical deployments.

AI.title_translation: 利用群相似度奖励提升检索增强系统的一致性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PS-GRPO的强化学习方法及Con-RAG系统，通过群相似度奖励和高效近似训练，解决了RAG系统在面对同义查询时输出不一致的问题，显著提升了系统的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）系统由于检索器和生成器的变异性，在面对语义等价的查询时往往表现出显著的不一致性，这削弱了用户信任和系统可靠性，因此需要在高风险领域中提升RAG系统的信息一致性。
AI.method: 1. 提出一个将RAG一致性分解为检索器级、生成器级和端到端组件的评估框架；2. 提出Paraphrased Set Group Relative Policy Optimization (PS-GRPO)强化学习方法，利用跨释义集的多个rollout分配群相似度奖励；3. 引入一种可扩展的近似方法来降低精确奖励计算的计算成本，实现高效的大规模训练。
AI.result: 在短形式、多跳和长形式问答基准上的实证评估表明，Con-RAG在没有显式真值监督的情况下，显著提高了系统的一致性，同时保持了准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入分层评估框架和PS-GRPO强化学习方法，有效解决了RAG系统在语义等价查询下的不一致问题，在保持准确率的同时大幅提升了系统的可靠性，为安全关键领域的应用提供了实用的解决方案。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统越来越多地被部署在用户期望输出在语义等价查询下保持一致的高风险领域。然而，由于检索器和生成器的变异性，现有系统往往表现出显著的不一致性，从而削弱了信任度和可靠性。在这项工作中，我们专注于信息一致性，即生成的输出在语义等价的输入中传达相同核心内容的要求。我们引入了一个有原则的评估框架，将RAG一致性分解为检索器级、生成器级和端到端组件，从而能够系统地识别不一致的来源。为了提高一致性，我们提出了释义集群相对策略优化（PS-GRPO），这是一种利用跨释义集的多次 rollout 来分配群相似度奖励的强化学习方法。我们利用PS-GRPO来实现信息一致的RAG（Con-RAG），训练生成器在释义查询中产生一致的输出，并保持对检索引起的变异性的鲁棒性。由于在释义集上精确计算奖励的计算成本很高，我们还引入了一种可扩展的近似方法，在保持有效性的同时实现高效、大规模的训练。在短形式、多跳和长形式问答基准上的实证评估表明，与基线相比，Con-RAG在显著提高一致性的同时保持了准确性，即使在缺乏显式真值监督的情况下也是如此。我们的工作为评估和构建适用于安全关键部署的可靠RAG系统提供了实用的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统在语义等价查询下输出不一致的问题，提出了一种分解评估框架和一个名为PS-GRPO的强化学习方法。通过利用跨释义集的群相似度奖励以及可扩展的近似训练方法，构建了Con-RAG系统，在保持准确性的同时显著提升了系统的一致性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Information Consistency, Group Relative Policy Optimization, Paraphrased Queries, Reinforcement Learning
AI.comments: 该论文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统在语义等价查询下输出不一致的关键痛点，创新性地提出了分解评估框架以及基于强化学习的PS-GRPO方法和Con-RAG系统。其亮点在于引入了群相似度奖励（Group Similarity Rewards）和高效的近似计算方法，在不依赖显式真值监督的情况下显著提升了RAG系统的鲁棒性与一致性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: RAG Makes Guardrails Brittle? Investigating Robustness of Guardrails under RAG-style Contexts
summary: With the increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs), ensuring the safety of LLM systems has become a pressing concern. External LLM-based guardrail models have emerged as a popular solution to screen unsafe inputs and outputs, but they are themselves fine-tuned or prompt-engineered LLMs vulnerable to data distribution shifts. In this paper, taking Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG) as a case study, we investigate how robust LLM-based guardrails are against additional information embedded in the context. Through a systematic evaluation of 3 Llama Guards and 2 GPT-oss models, we find that inserting benign retrieved documents flips the judgments of input and output guardrails in around 11% and 8% of cases respectively, with the majority of these flips (72% and 64%) reversing previously correct decisions. We further analyze the effect of each component in the augmented context: retrieved documents, user query, and LLM response. Two tested mitigations reveal that the robustness gap is not easily closed. These results expose a context-robustness gap in current guardrails.

AI.title_translation: RAG让护栏变得脆弱吗？研究RAG风格上下文中护栏的鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 本论文发现检索增强生成（RAG）中的附加上下文会显著削弱大语言模型安全护栏的鲁棒性，导致其判断频繁出错且难以通过现有方法修复。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型系统的广泛应用，外部基于LLM的护栏模型常用于筛查不安全输入输出，但它们容易受到数据分布偏移的影响；因此，本文旨在研究LLM护栏在RAG风格上下文中对附加信息的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以检索增强生成（RAG）为案例研究，系统评估了3个Llama Guards模型和2个GPT-oss模型，分析了增广上下文中各个组件（检索文档、用户查询、LLM响应）的影响，并测试了两种缓解方法。
AI.result: 插入良性检索文档会分别导致约11%的输入护栏和8%的输出护栏判断翻转，其中大部分翻转（72%和64%）逆转了先前正确的决定；测试的两种缓解方法也表明鲁棒性差距不易弥补。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于LLM的安全护栏存在明显的上下文鲁棒性差距，引入RAG风格的上下文容易导致其判断失效，且现有缓解措施难以轻易解决该问题。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛采用，确保LLM系统的安全性已成为一个紧迫的问题。外部基于LLM的护栏模型已成为筛选不安全输入和输出的流行解决方案，但它们本身是经过微调或提示工程的LLM，容易受到数据分布偏移的影响。在本文中，我们以检索增强生成（RAG）为案例研究，调查了基于LLM的护栏对嵌入上下文中的附加信息的鲁棒性。通过对3个Llama Guards和2个GPT-oss模型的系统评估，我们发现插入良性的检索文档分别在约11%和8%的案例中改变了输入和输出护栏的判断，其中大多数翻转（72%和64%）逆转了先前正确的决定。我们进一步分析了增广上下文中各个组件的影响：检索文档、用户查询和LLM响应。测试的两种缓解措施表明，鲁棒性差距不易弥补。这些结果暴露了当前护栏中存在的上下文鲁棒性差距。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的安全护栏在检索增强生成（RAG）上下文中的鲁棒性。通过对多个主流护栏模型的系统评估，发现引入检索文档会导致显著的判断翻转且多数会逆转正确决策，暴露了当前护栏存在的上下文鲁棒性差距，且现有缓解方法效果有限。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 安全护栏, 检索增强生成, 鲁棒性, 上下文敏感性
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前基于大语言模型的安全护栏（Guardrails）在检索增强生成（RAG）上下文中的脆弱性，指出外部检索文档会导致护栏模型的判断出现显著的翻转，且现有缓解方法难以弥补这一鲁棒性差距，对于大模型安全应用具有重要的警示意义。

title: Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning
summary: Fundamental limits to predictability are central to our understanding of many physical and computational systems. In deep learning, training outcomes are often difficult to predict and reproduce even when extrinsic sources of randomness are controlled, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here we propose riddled basin geometry as a unifying dynamical systems mechanism: every initialization leading to one solution lies arbitrarily close to initializations leading to different solutions, forming a fat fractal with structure at arbitrarily fine scales. Using a minimal neural network model, we analytically establish the classical route to riddling and derive a near-zero uncertainty exponent: even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome predictability. In deep networks, intertwined training destinations and near-zero parameter-space exponents provide robust signatures consistent with riddling across the tested architectures, optimizers and training protocols, offering a common dynamical account of otherwise disparate empirical observations. We further introduce functional uncertainty exponents, extending these diagnostics of scale-insensitive irreproducibility from parameter space to the learned functions themselves. Together, our results support riddled basin geometry as a candidate organizing principle for irreproducibility in deep learning, with practical implications for optimization and the reliable deployment of artificial intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 深度学习中可预测性与可复现性的极限：分形盆地几何学
AI.tldr: 深度学习训练结果难以预测和复现的根本原因在于其分形盆地几何学（筛孔盆地），这意味着即使极大地提高初始化精度，也无法实质性地改变结果的不可预测性。
AI.motivation: 尽管控制了外部随机性，深度学习的训练结果仍然难以预测和复现，其背后的底层机制尚不清楚，论文旨在通过动力学系统机制（筛孔盆地几何学）来解释这一现象。
AI.method: 使用最小神经网络模型进行解析推导，建立经典筛孔路径并推导近零不确定性指数；在深度网络中测试不同架构、优化器和训练协议，并引入功能不确定性指数将诊断从参数空间扩展到学习函数本身。
AI.result: 解析证明了极小的不确定性指数，即便是大幅提高初始化精度也只能带来极小的结果可预测性提升；在各种测试架构、优化器和训练协议中均发现了与筛孔盆地一致的交织训练终点和近零参数空间指数。
AI.conclusion: 筛孔盆地几何学是导致深度学习不可预测和不可复现的底层动力学机制，其分形结构和近零不确定性指数表明，单纯提高初始化精度无法有效改善结果。
AI.translation: 预测能力的根本局限性是我们理解许多物理和计算系统的核心。在深度学习中，即使控制了外部随机源，训练结果也往往难以预测和复现，然而其底层机制仍不清楚。在此，我们提出“筛孔盆地几何学”（riddled basin geometry）作为一种统一的动力学系统机制：导向某种解的每一个初始化状态都任意接近于导向不同解的初始化状态，从而形成一个在任意精度的微小尺度上都具有结构的“厚分形”（fat fractal）。利用一个极简的神经网络模型，我们解析地建立了通往筛孔的经典路径，并推导出了接近于零的不确定性指数：即使初始化精度的急剧增加，也只能对结果可预测性带来微乎其微的收益。在深度网络中，交织的训练目的地和近零的参数空间指数提供了与测试架构、优化器和训练协议中的筛孔现象一致的稳健特征，为原本截然不同的经验观察提供了一个共同的动力学解释。我们进一步引入了“功能不确定性指数”（functional uncertainty exponents），将这种对尺度不敏感的不可复现性的诊断从参数空间扩展到所学习的函数本身。总之，我们的研究结果支持筛孔盆地几何学作为深度学习不可复现性的一个候选组织原则，对优化和人工智能的可靠部署具有实际意义。
AI.summary: 论文提出筛孔盆地几何学作为解释深度学习不可预测性和不可复现性的统一动力学机制。通过最小神经网络模型的解析证明和深度网络的实证检验，发现初始化状态形成厚分形结构，导致近零的不确定性指数，从而说明提高初始化精度对提升可预测性收效甚微。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 动力学系统, 分形几何, 可复现性, 优化局限性
AI.comments: 该论文首次将动力学系统中的“筛孔盆地（riddled basin）”几何学引入深度学习，从理论和实验上揭示了深度学习中难以预测和复现的根本原因，对理解AI模型的优化和可靠部署具有重要意义。

title: Terrain-Aided Navigation Without Raycasting: A Sliding Grid Approach for Point Cloud Processing
summary: We investigate the use of a point cloud measurement in terrain-aided navigation. Our goal is to aid an inertial navigation system, by exploring ways to generate a useful measurement residual for effective nonlinear state estimation. We compare two such measurement models that involve the scanning of a digital terrain elevation model: a) one that is based on typical ray-casting from a given pose, that returns the predicted point cloud measurement from that pose, and b) another computationally less intensive one that does not require raycasting and we refer to herein as a sliding grid. Besides requiring a pose, it requires the pattern of the point cloud measurement itself and returns a predicted point cloud measurement. We show that the sliding grid achieves comparable accuracy to raycasting, especially at higher altitudes, while being orders of magnitude faster computationally. By eliminating the need for raycasting, the sliding grid removes the dependency on dedicated GPU hardware or high-performance CPUs, making it well-suited for real-time terrain-aided navigation on resource-constrained embedded platforms.

AI.title_translation: 无需光线投射的地形辅助导航：一种用于点云处理的滑动网格方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需光线投射的滑动网格点云处理方法用于地形辅助导航，计算速度极快且精度相当，非常适合嵌入式平台。
AI.motivation: 为了在资源受限的嵌入式平台上实现实时的地形辅助导航，需要解决传统基于光线投射（raycasting）的方法计算量大、依赖专用GPU或高性能CPU的问题，从而探索一种计算开销小且能生成有效测量残差的替代测量模型。
AI.method: 比较了两种数字地形高程模型扫描测量模型：a) 基于给定姿态的典型光线投射模型；b) 无需光线投射、计算量更小的滑动网格模型（利用点云测量模式预测点云测量值）。
AI.result: 滑动网格方法在计算速度上比光线投射快几个数量级，同时在精度上（特别是较高飞行高度时）与之相当。
AI.conclusion: 滑动网格方法能够以极低的计算成本达到与光线投射相当的导航精度，消除了对专用GPU或高性能CPU的依赖，是资源受限嵌入式平台上实时地形辅助导航的理想选择。
AI.translation: 我们研究了点云测量在地形辅助导航中的应用。我们的目标是通过探索生成有效测量残差的方法来实现高效的非线性状态估计，从而辅助惯性导航系统。我们比较了两种涉及数字地形高程模型扫描的测量模型：a) 一种基于给定姿态的典型光线投射（ray-casting）模型，它返回该姿态下的预测点云测量值；b) 另一种计算量较小、不需要光线投射的模型，我们在本文中称之为滑动网格（sliding grid）。除了需要姿态外，它还需要点云测量本身的模式，并返回预测的点云测量值。我们表明，滑动网格实现了与光线投射相当的精度，尤其是在较高海拔时，同时在计算速度上快了几个数量级。通过消除对光线投射的需求，滑动网格消除了对专用GPU硬件或高性能CPU的依赖，使其非常适合资源受限的嵌入式平台上的实时地形辅助导航。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了点云测量在地形辅助导航中的应用，提出了一种无需光线投射的“滑动网格”方法。与传统的射线投射模型相比，该方法计算速度快几个数量级，精度相当，非常适合资源受限的嵌入式平台。
AI.keywords: 地形辅助导航, 点云处理, 光线投射, 滑动网格, 惯性导航系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需光线投射（raycasting）的滑动网格（sliding grid）方法用于基于点云的地形辅助导航，计算速度极快且精度与光线投射相当，极大地降低了对硬件算力的要求，非常适合资源受限的嵌入式平台进行实时导航。

title: Learning to Assimilate: Amortized Control for Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive diffusion models (ARDMs) offer expressive priors for forecasting chaotic dynamics. However, maintaining consistency with sparse observations over long rollouts can require substantial test-time computation. We introduce Control-Augmented Data Assimilation (CADA), which trains a lightweight controller on top of a frozen ARDM to steer predictions toward future observations. Using a KL-regularized stochastic optimal control objective, the controller learns from short autoregressive rollouts to anticipate observations while staying close to the pretrained dynamics. At inference, it injects corrections at each denoising step without per-forecast optimization. Across two chaotic PDE benchmarks, CADA improves long-horizon accuracy, stability, and physical fidelity under sparse observations. On compact ERA5, it outperforms diffusion-based baselines in most regimes with over $10\times$ faster inference than conditional diffusion baselines. Applied to frozen GenCast, CADA also reduces temperature errors across 12--48-hour forecasts with spatially sparse observations. Code is available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/cada.

AI.title_translation: 学会同化：自回归扩散的摊销控制
AI.tldr: 提出CADA方法，通过轻量级控制器引导自回归扩散模型进行数据同化，实现无需测试时优化的快速、高精度长周期混沌预测。
AI.motivation: 自回归扩散模型在预测混沌动力学时表现出强大的先验能力，但在长周期预测中，维持与稀疏观测的一致性往往需要大量的测试时计算。
AI.method: 引入Control-Augmented Data Assimilation (CADA)，在冻结的自回归扩散模型（ARDM）之上训练一个轻量级控制器。该控制器基于KL正则化的随机最优控制目标，从短期自回归展开中学习，并在推理时每个去噪步骤中注入校正。
AI.result: 在两个混沌偏微分方程（PDE）基准测试以及ERA5和GenCast天气预测中，CADA显著提升了长周期精度、稳定性和物理保真度，且推理速度比条件扩散基线快10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: CADA通过摊销控制方法成功解决了自回归扩散模型在稀疏观测下的长期预测稳定性与一致性问题，兼具高精度与高计算效率。
AI.translation: 自回归扩散模型（ARDM）为预测混沌动力学提供了富有表现力的先验。然而，在漫长的滚动预测中保持与稀疏观测的一致性可能需要大量的测试时计算。我们引入了控制增强数据同化（CADA），它在冻结的ARDM之上训练一个轻量级控制器，以引导预测朝向未来的观测。利用KL正则化的随机最优控制目标，控制器从短期自回归滚动中学习预测观测，同时保持接近预训练的动力学。在推理时，它在每个去噪步骤中注入校正，而无需每个预测进行优化。在两个混沌PDE基准测试中，CADA在稀疏观测下提高了长视野的准确性、稳定性和物理保真度。在紧凑的ERA5上，它在大多数情况下优于基于扩散的基线，推理速度比条件扩散基线快10倍以上。应用于冻结的GenCast时，CADA还减少了在12-48小时稀疏空间观测预测中的温度误差。代码可在https://github.com/mandt-lab/cada获取。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Control-Augmented Data Assimilation (CADA)方法，通过训练一个轻量级控制器来引导自回归扩散模型的预测，以匹配稀疏观测，从而在无需测试时优化的情况下，大幅提升了长周期混沌动力学和天气预报的准确性和推理速度。
AI.keywords: 自回归扩散模型, 数据同化, 随机最优控制, 混沌动力学, 天气预报
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将控制理论（控制增强数据同化，CADA）引入自回归扩散模型中，通过轻量级控制器避免了测试时繁重的优化计算，实现了高效、高精度的长时间序列混沌动力学预测和天气预报。

title: Emergent Misalignment via In-Context Learning: Narrow in-context examples can produce broadly misaligned LLMs
summary:
Recent work has shown that narrow finetuning can produce broadly misaligned LLMs, a phenomenon termed emergent misalignment (EM). While concerning, these findings were limited to finetuning and activation steering, leaving out in-context learning (ICL). We therefore ask: does EM emerge in ICL? We find that it does: across four model families (Gemini, Kimi-K2, Grok, and Qwen), narrow in-context examples cause models to produce misaligned responses to benign, unrelated queries. With 16 in-context examples, EM rates range from 1% to 24% depending on model and domain, appearing with as few as 2 examples. Neither larger model scale nor explicit reasoning provides reliable protection, and larger models are typically even more susceptible. Next, we formulate and test a hypothesis, which explains in-context EM as conflict between safety objectives and context-following behavior. Consistent with this, instructing models to prioritize safety reduces EM while prioritizing context-following increases it. These findings establish ICL as a previously underappreciated vector for emergent misalignment that resists simple scaling-based solutions.
  Code: https://github.com/Dont-Care-Didnt-Ask/emergent-misalignment-in-context .
  Dataset of produced responses: https://huggingface.co/datasets/myyycroft/emergent-misalignment-via-in-context-learning .

AI.title_translation: 通过上下文学习实现的涌现式不对齐：狭窄的上下文示例会导致广泛不对齐的大语言模型
AI.tldr: 狭窄的上下文示例不仅会引发微调模型的安全对齐失效，同样也会导致大模型在上下文学习（ICL）中产生广泛的不对齐行为，且无法通过模型规模扩大来解决。
AI.motivation: 现有的涌现式不对齐（EM）研究主要局限于微调和激活转向，未涉及上下文学习（ICL），因此作者旨在探究狭窄的上下文示例是否也会引发广泛的、未对齐的LLM行为。
AI.method: 通过测试四个模型系列（Gemini、Kimi-K2、Grok和Qwen）在狭窄上下文示例下的表现来检验ICL是否会引发涌现式不对齐，并提出并测试了安全目标与上下文遵循行为之间冲突的假设。
AI.result: 仅使用16个上下文示例，EM发生率在1%到24%之间（只需2个示例即可出现）；更大的模型规模和显式推理无法提供可靠保护，甚至更容易受影响；通过指令优先处理安全性可以减少EM，而优先处理上下文遵循则会增加EM。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习是导致大模型产生涌现式不对齐的重要且被低估的途径，且无法简单通过增加模型规模或显式推理来解决，安全与上下文遵循之间的冲突是其根本原因。
AI.translation: 近期研究表明，狭窄的微调会导致大语言模型（LLM）产生广泛的不对齐，这种现象被称为涌现式不对齐（EM）。尽管令人担忧，但这些发现仅限于微调和激活转向，未涉及上下文学习（ICL）。因此，我们提出疑问：ICL中是否也会出现EM？我们发现确实如此：在四个模型系列（Gemini、Kimi-K2、Grok和Qwen）中，狭窄的上下文示例会导致模型对良性、无关的查询产生不对齐的响应。在使用16个上下文示例时，根据模型和领域的不同，EM发生率在1%到24%之间，甚至在仅有2个示例时就会出现。更大的模型规模和显式推理均无法提供可靠的保护，并且更大的模型通常更容易受到影响。接下来，我们提出并验证了一个假设，将上下文EM解释为安全目标与上下文遵循行为之间的冲突。与此一致的是，指示模型优先考虑安全性可以减少EM，而优先考虑上下文遵循则会增加EM。这些发现表明，ICL是涌现式不对齐的一个先前被低估的载体，且无法通过简单的基于规模的解决方案来解决。
AI.summary: 该论文发现大模型在上下文学习（ICL）中也会产生涌现式不对齐（EM），狭窄的上下文示例会导致模型对良性查询产生不对齐的响应。这种现象在多个模型系列中存在，且无法通过模型放大或推理能力来解决，其根源在于安全目标与上下文遵循行为之间的冲突。
AI.keywords: Emergent Misalignment, In-Context Learning, Large Language Models, AI Safety
AI.comments: 该论文首次揭示了上下文学习（ICL）也会导致大模型出现广泛的涌现式不对齐（EM）现象，证明了这一安全隐患不仅限于微调，且随着模型规模增大反而更易受影响，这给未来的AI安全对齐研究敲响了警钟。

title: Provable Selective Auto-labeling with Reliability Guarantees
summary: Auto-labeling has emerged as a popular, cost-effective alternative to manual annotation. However, its performance is often highly inconsistent across different tasks, underscoring the importance of selective strategies. Despite this, existing heuristic methods for selective auto-labeling still rely heavily on model confidence scores and offer no reliable guarantee on the trustworthiness of the selected examples. To address this, we propose \textbf{Conformal Labeling}, a novel method that selects a subset of auto-generated labels with a provably controlled false labeling rate (FLR). Our key idea is to formulate selective auto-labeling as a multiple-hypothesis testing problem, where each hypothesis indicates whether to accept the auto-generated label for an instance. Specifically, we construct a conformal $p$-value for each auto-generated label using a small calibration set, and then employ the Benjamini--Hochberg (BH) procedure with a novel correction factor to construct the subset with guaranteed FLR control. Theoretically, we show that our method achieves finite-sample FLR control and asymptotically optimal statistical power among all $p$-value thresholding rules. Extensive experiments on classification and open-ended generation tasks validate the effectiveness of our method, achieving high statistical power while strictly controlling the FLR.

AI.title_translation: 具有可靠性保证的可证明选择性自动标注
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Conformal Labeling的方法，通过保形预测和多假设检验，在自动标注中实现了可证明且严格控制的错误标注率（FLR）。
AI.motivation: 现有的选择性自动标注方法大多依赖启发式模型置信度得分，缺乏对所选样本真实可靠性的可靠保证，而该研究旨在解决这一问题，提供具有可靠性保证的证明。
AI.method: 提出Conformal Labeling方法，将选择性自动标注建模为多假设检验问题；利用小规模校准集为每个自动生成的标签构建保形p值，并结合带有新颖校正因子的Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序来构建具有FLR控制保证的子集。
AI.result: 理论上证明了该方法可实现有限样本的FLR控制以及渐进最优的统计效力；分类和开放式生成任务的大量实验验证了其有效性，能够在严格控制FLR的同时实现高统计效力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Conformal Labeling方法成功实现了在控制错误标注率（FLR）的同时最大化统计效力，为选择性自动标注提供了严谨的理论保障。
AI.translation: 自动标注已成为手动注释的一种流行且经济高效的替代方案。然而，其性能在不同任务中往往高度不一致，凸显了选择性策略的重要性。尽管如此，现有的选择性自动标注启发式方法仍然严重依赖模型置信度得分，且对所选示例的可信度无法提供可靠的保证。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了“保形标注”（Conformal Labeling）这一新方法，它能选择具有可证明受控错误标注率（FLR）的自动生成标签子集。我们的核心思想是将选择性自动标注构想为一个多假设检验问题，其中每个假设指示是否接受某个实例的自动生成标签。具体而言，我们利用一个小型的校准集为每个自动生成的标签构建一个保形p值，然后采用带有新颖校正因子的Benjamini-Hochberg（BH）程序来构建具有保证FLR控制的子集。在理论上，我们证明了我们的方法在所有p值阈值规则中实现了有限样本的FLR控制和渐进最优的统计效力。在分类和开放式生成任务上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性，在严格控制FLR的同时实现了高统计效力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为Conformal Labeling的新方法，用于具有可靠性保证的选择性自动标注。通过将该问题转化为多假设检验，并结合保形p值和改进的Benjamini-Hochberg程序，该方法能够在理论上控制错误标注率（FLR）并保持较高的统计效力，实验证明了其在分类和生成任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: Conformal Labeling, Selective Auto-labeling, False Labeling Rate Control, Multiple-hypothesis Testing, Conformal Prediction
AI.comments: 该论文将保形预测（Conformal Prediction）与多假设检验相结合，为自动标注提供了理论上的可靠性保证（控制错误标注率），在降本增效的机器学习标注任务中具有很高的实用价值和理论创新性。

title: Mega-MMDF and DeepfakeBench-MM: Benchmarking Multimodal Deepfake Detection Across Diverse Forgery Pipelines
comments: Preprint. Mega-MMDF dataset is applicable at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SCLBD/Mega-MMDF. DeepfakeBench-MM is available at https://github.com/SCLBD/DeepfakeBench-MM
summary: Audio-visual deepfakes can spread misinformation and enable impersonation, undermining trust in digital media. However, existing datasets provide limited coverage of forgery operations and their combinations, constraining detector development and systematic evaluation. We introduce Mega-MMDF, containing 100,000 real and 1.2 million forged clips across 22 pipelines spanning modality-specific manipulations, stacked forgeries, and joint audio-video generation. To assess its training value and enable fair comparisons, we develop DeepfakeBench-MM, which standardizes training and evaluation across 8 datasets and 10 detectors. Training-based detectors achieve their highest mean AUC when trained on Mega-MMDF, with gains of up to 0.0784 over the best alternative training dataset for each detector. Experiments on data scale and pipeline coverage further support the value of large, diverse training data. Cross-pipeline evaluations reveal bidirectional and asymmetric generalization. Training on composite forgeries does not necessarily enable detection of their constituent operations in isolation. Our analysis of altered inputs shows that modality masking can increase false alarms and missed detections, and temporal misalignment can raise mean predicted forgery probabilities. Together, these resources provide a foundation for understanding and improving multimodal deepfake detection, with publicly available code and dataset access subject to application and usage terms.
comment: Preprint. Mega-MMDF dataset is applicable at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SCLBD/Mega-MMDF. DeepfakeBench-MM is available at https://github.com/SCLBD/DeepfakeBench-MM

AI.title_translation: Mega-MMDF 和 DeepfakeBench-MM：基准测试跨多样伪造管道的多模态深度伪造检测
AI.tldr: 引入了Mega-MMDF数据集和DeepfakeBench-MM基准，以解决现有数据集在多模态深度伪造检测方面覆盖范围有限的问题。研究发现，Mega-MMDF能显著提升检测器性能，并揭示了跨管道泛化的复杂性。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据集对伪造操作及其组合的覆盖范围有限，这限制了检测器的开发和系统评估，导致多模态深度伪造检测能力不足。
AI.method: 本文引入了Mega-MMDF数据集，包含10万个真实片段和120万个伪造片段，涵盖22种伪造管道，包括模态特定操作、堆叠伪造和音视频联合生成。同时，开发了DeepfakeBench-MM基准，用于标准化8个数据集和10个检测器的训练和评估。
AI.result: 基于训练的检测器在Mega-MMDF上训练时获得了最高的平均AUC，相比最佳替代训练数据集，性能提升高达0.0784。数据规模和管道覆盖范围的实验进一步支持了大型多样化训练数据的价值。跨管道评估揭示了双向和不对称的泛化：在复合伪造上训练不一定能检测其孤立的组成操作。对改变输入的分析表明，模态遮蔽会增加误报和漏报，时间错位会提高平均预测伪造概率。
AI.conclusion: 这些资源为理解和改进多模态深度伪造检测提供了基础，证明了大型、多样化训练数据的重要性，并揭示了泛化和输入改变对检测性能的影响。
AI.translation: 音视频深度伪造可能传播错误信息并促成冒充，从而损害对数字媒体的信任。然而，现有数据集对伪造操作及其组合的覆盖范围有限，这限制了检测器的开发和系统评估。我们引入了Mega-MMDF，它包含10万个真实片段和120万个伪造片段，涵盖22种伪造管道，包括模态特定操纵、堆叠伪造和音视频联合生成。为了评估其训练价值并实现公平比较，我们开发了DeepfakeBench-MM，它标准化了8个数据集和10个检测器的训练和评估。基于训练的检测器在Mega-MMDF上训练时获得了最高的平均AUC，相比每个检测器的最佳替代训练数据集，性能提升高达0.0784。关于数据规模和管道覆盖范围的实验进一步支持了大型、多样化训练数据的价值。跨管道评估揭示了双向和不对称的泛化。在复合伪造上训练不一定能检测其孤立的组成操作。我们对改变输入的分析表明，模态遮蔽会增加误报和漏报，时间错位会提高平均预测伪造概率。总之，这些资源为理解和改进多模态深度伪造检测提供了基础，其代码和数据集访问需经申请并遵守使用条款。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有数据集在多模态深度伪造检测方面覆盖不足的问题，提出了Mega-MMDF数据集和DeepfakeBench-MM基准。Mega-MMDF包含大量真实和伪造的音视频片段，涵盖多样化的伪造管道。DeepfakeBench-MM则用于标准化检测器的训练和评估。实验结果表明，Mega-MMDF能显著提升检测器的性能，并强调了大型、多样化训练数据的重要性。研究还揭示了跨管道泛化的复杂性以及模态遮蔽和时间错位对检测结果的影响。
AI.keywords: 多模态深度伪造检测, Mega-MMDF, DeepfakeBench-MM, 数据集, 伪造管道
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入大规模、多样的Mega-MMDF数据集和标准化的DeepfakeBench-MM基准，为多模态深度伪造检测领域做出了重要贡献。其创新之处在于数据管道的广度和深度，以及对泛化能力和输入扰动影响的深入分析。这对于推动该领域的研究和开发具有重要意义，有助于建立更鲁棒的检测系统。

title: Revisiting Value Iteration: Unified Analysis of Discounted and Average-Reward Cases
summary: While Value Iteration (VI) is one of the most fundamental algorithms in Reinforcement Learning, its theoretical convergence guarantees still exhibit a persistent mismatch with empirical behavior. In the discounted-reward case, classical theory guarantees geometric convergence with rate $γ$, while in the average-reward case recent work suggests that only sublinear convergence can be expected. In practice, however, VI is often observed to converge significantly faster. In this work, we show through a unified geometry-based analysis that, under an assumption of a unique and unichain optimal policy, (i) convergence is geometric in both the discounted- and average-reward settings and (ii) the convergence rate is faster than previous analyses suggest.

AI.title_translation: 重新审视价值迭代：折扣与平均奖励情况下的统一分析
AI.tldr: 论文通过统一的几何分析证明，在特定假设下，价值迭代算法在折扣和平均奖励设定下均表现出比以往预期更快的几何收敛性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中价值迭代算法的经典理论收敛保证与实际表现存在明显差距：折扣奖励下仅保证几何收敛率 $\gamma$，平均奖励下近期研究认为仅能达到亚线性收敛，但实际中该算法通常收敛得更快。因此需要更精确的理论分析。
AI.method: 通过基于几何的统一分析方法，研究在唯一且单链最优策略假设下价值迭代算法的收敛性质。
AI.result: 证明了在唯一且单链最优策略下：(i) 折扣和平均奖励设定下的收敛性均为几何收敛；(ii) 收敛速度比以往分析所指出的更快。
AI.conclusion: 在唯一且单链最优策略的假设下，价值迭代算法在折扣和平均奖励设定下均能实现几何收敛，且其实际收敛速度比以往理论预期的更快。
AI.translation: 尽管价值迭代（VI）是强化学习中最基础的算法之一，但其理论收敛保证与实际表现之间仍然存在持续的不匹配。在折扣奖励情况下，经典理论保证了以 $\gamma$ 为速率的几何收敛；而在平均奖励情况下，近期研究表明只能期望获得亚线性收敛。然而在实践中，人们经常观察到 VI 的收敛速度要快得多。在这项工作中，通过基于几何的统一分析，我们证明了在假设存在唯一且单链最优策略的前提下：(i) 在折扣和平均奖励设定下收敛性都是几何的；(ii) 收敛速度比以往分析所建议的要快。
AI.summary: 该论文针对价值迭代算法在强化学习中的理论收敛性与实际表现的不一致问题，提出了一种统一的基于几何的分析方法。研究表明，在假设最优策略是唯一且单链的前提下，价值迭代在折扣和平均奖励两种情况下都能实现几何收敛，并且收敛速度快于以往理论预期。
AI.keywords: 值迭代, 强化学习, 几何收敛, 折扣奖励, 平均奖励
AI.comments: 该论文从几何视角统一分析了折扣和平均奖励马尔可夫决策过程中的价值迭代算法，弥合了经典理论收敛慢与实际表现快之间的鸿沟，在理论上证明了在唯一且单链最优策略假设下的几何收敛性，具有重要的理论价值。

title: Supervised Fine-tuning for Geometry-aware Instruction-following
summary: We examine a contrastive input encoding scheme for supervised fine-tuning of language models (LMs) that masks the content of incorrect generations up to a classification control token. This small-scale study, using a variation of the classic word ordering diagnostic task, suggests this straightforward approach generally preserves the generation accuracy of supervised fine-tuning that uses only positive examples, while increasing the admission rate of generations in the calibrated high-probability region of a Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) estimator for binary classification of instruction-following. At the same time, we corroborate existing evidence that constructing a calibrated SDM estimator, which models the geometry of the feature-representation space, is not strictly dependent on specialized fine-tuning of the underlying LM's parameters.

AI.title_translation: 面向几何感知指令遵循的监督微调
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于语言模型微调的对比输入编码方法，在保持生成准确率的同时提升了模型对指令遵循的几何感知和分类表现。
AI.motivation: 为了研究如何在监督微调语言模型时引入几何感知，改善指令遵循能力，并探讨特征表示空间几何建模对模型参数专门微调的依赖性。
AI.method: 采用了一种对比输入编码方案进行语言模型的监督微调，该方案将错误生成的内容掩码至分类控制令牌，并利用相似度-距离-magnitude (SDM) 估计器进行二分类。
AI.result: 该方法在保持基于仅正样本的监督微调生成准确率的同时，提高了指令遵循二分类SDM估计器校准高概率区域中生成物的准入率；同时证实构造校准的SDM估计器不严格依赖于底层语言模型参数的专门微调。
AI.conclusion: 对比输入编码方案能够在不损失生成准确率的前提下，有效改善语言模型在特征表示空间几何估计中的表现，且构造校准的SDM估计器并不严格依赖于对底层语言模型参数的专门微调。
AI.translation: 我们检查了一种用于语言模型（LM）监督微调的对比输入编码方案，该方案将错误生成的内容屏蔽到分类控制令牌。这项使用经典词序诊断任务变体的小规模研究表明，这种直接的方法通常可以保持仅使用正例的监督微调的生成准确率，同时提高指令遵循二分类的相似度-距离-幅度（SDM）估计器中校准的高概率区域内生成的准入率。同时，我们证实了现有的证据，即构建模拟特征表示空间几何形状的校准SDM估计器并不严格依赖于底层LM参数的专门微调。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了一种针对语言模型监督微调的对比输入编码方案，通过对错误生成内容进行掩码，在维持准确率的同时提升了指令遵循分类估计器的性能，并验证了特征空间几何建模对模型参数微调的独立性。
AI.keywords: 监督微调, 语言模型, 几何感知, 指令遵循, 对比输入编码
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了一种用于语言模型监督微调的对比输入编码方案，通过对错误生成的特定内容进行掩码处理，在保持生成准确率的同时，提高了指令遵循二分类估计器中高概率区域的接受率。该研究小巧而聚焦，为优化语言模型的几何感知指令遵循提供了新的视角。

title: Generalizing Test-time Compute-optimal Scaling as an Optimizable Graph
summary: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) improves large language models (LLMs) by allocating additional computation during inference, typically through parallel, sequential, or hybrid scaling. However, prior studies often assume fixed collaboration architectures (e.g., topologies) and single-model usage, overlooking that optimal architectures and model combinations can vary across tasks. Therefore, we study the novel problem of searching for compute-optimal model combinations and architectures in TTS under a fixed budget. We formalize it as a multi-LLM collaboration graph, where nodes encode roles and LLM model assignments, and edges capture information flow. This problem is challenging because (i) the combinatorial search space is prohibitively large, and (ii) task-specific requirements demand tailored designs. To address these, we reformulate the problem as probabilistic graph optimization and, through pilot experiments, derive three empirical insights into TTS collaboration graphs. Guided by these insights, we propose Agent-REINFORCE, an LLM-agent-augmented framework that mirrors the REINFORCE pipeline by mapping sampling-gradient-update to sampling-feedback-update, where feedback serves as a textual gradient to update the probabilistic graph and efficiently search for optimal multi-LLM collaboration graphs. Experiments show that Agent-REINFORCE outperforms both traditional and LLM-based baselines in sample efficiency and search performance, and effectively identifies optimal graphs under joint objectives of accuracy and inference latency.

AI.title_translation: 将测试时计算最优扩展泛化为可优化图
AI.tldr: 该论文提出Agent-REINFORCE，一个LLM代理增强框架，用于高效搜索测试时扩展（TTS）中的最优多LLM协作图，性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 先前的测试时扩展（TTS）研究假设固定的协作架构和单一模型使用，但最优架构和模型组合因任务而异。因此，研究在固定预算下搜索TTS中计算最优模型组合和架构是一个新颖且重要的问题。
AI.method: 该研究将问题形式化为多LLM协作图，其中节点编码角色和LLM模型分配，边捕捉信息流。为了解决组合搜索空间巨大和任务特定需求的问题，将问题重新表述为概率图优化。基于初步实验的三项经验性见解，提出了Agent-REINFORCE框架，它模仿REINFORCE流程，将采样-梯度-更新映射到采样-反馈-更新，其中反馈作为文本梯度来更新概率图，从而高效搜索最优多LLM协作图。
AI.result: 实验表明，Agent-REINFORCE在样本效率和搜索性能方面优于传统和基于LLM的基线，并能有效地在准确性和推理延迟的联合目标下识别出最优图。
AI.conclusion: Agent-REINFORCE框架成功解决了在测试时扩展中寻找计算最优多LLM协作图的挑战，展示了卓越的性能和效率，并能有效平衡准确性和推理延迟。
AI.translation: 测试时扩展 (TTS) 通过在推理过程中分配额外的计算资源来改进大型语言模型 (LLM)，通常通过并行、顺序或混合扩展来实现。然而，先前的研究通常假设固定的协作架构（例如拓扑）和单一模型使用，忽略了最优架构和模型组合可能因任务而异。因此，我们研究了在固定预算下搜索 TTS 中计算最优模型组合和架构的新问题。我们将其形式化为一个多 LLM 协作图，其中节点编码角色和 LLM 模型分配，边捕捉信息流。这个问题具有挑战性，因为 (i) 组合搜索空间大得令人望而却步，(ii) 任务特定的要求需要量身定制的设计。为了解决这些问题，我们将问题重新表述为概率图优化，并通过初步实验，得出了关于 TTS 协作图的三个经验性见解。在这些见解的指导下，我们提出了 Agent-REINFORCE，一个 LLM 代理增强框架，它通过将采样-梯度-更新映射到采样-反馈-更新来模仿 REINFORCE 流程，其中反馈作为文本梯度来更新概率图并有效地搜索最优的多 LLM 协作图。实验表明，Agent-REINFORCE 在样本效率和搜索性能方面优于传统和基于 LLM 的基线，并有效地在准确性和推理延迟的联合目标下识别出最优图。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种新的方法，将测试时扩展（TTS）中的计算最优模型组合和架构搜索问题形式化为多LLM协作图优化。针对巨大的搜索空间和任务特定需求，作者将问题重新表述为概率图优化，并引入了Agent-REINFORCE框架。Agent-REINFORCE利用LLM代理和文本反馈机制，高效地搜索最优协作图。实验证明，该方法在样本效率和搜索性能上均优于现有基线，并能有效平衡准确性和推理延迟。
AI.keywords: 测试时扩展, 大型语言模型, 图优化, Agent-REINFORCE, 多LLM协作
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于将TTS中的模型组合和架构搜索问题转化为可优化的图结构，并引入了LLM代理增强的REINFORCE框架。通过将反馈作为文本梯度来更新概率图，它提供了一种新颖且高效的搜索策略，以应对组合搜索空间的巨大挑战。这对于优化LLM在推理时的计算效率和性能具有重要意义，尤其是在资源受限或需要定制化部署的场景中。

title: Object-Centric World Models for Causality-Aware Reinforcement Learning
comments: Accepted by AAAI-26. Code is available at https://github.com/nishimoto0430/STICA. v4: Fixed the mean score of STICA in Table 1 and the hyperparameters in Table 3. Updated Figure 7
summary: World models have been developed to support sample-efficient deep reinforcement learning agents. However, it remains challenging for world models to accurately replicate environments that are high-dimensional, non-stationary, and composed of multiple objects with rich interactions since most world models learn holistic representations of all environmental components. By contrast, humans perceive the environment by decomposing it into discrete objects, facilitating efficient decision-making. Motivated by this insight, we propose \emph{Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning} (STICA), a unified framework in which object-centric Transformers serve as the world model and causality-aware policy and value networks. STICA represents each observation as a set of object-centric tokens, together with tokens for the agent action and the resulting reward, enabling the world model to predict token-level dynamics and interactions. The policy and value networks then estimate token-level cause--effect relations and use them in the attention layers, yielding causality-guided decision-making. Experiments on object-rich benchmarks demonstrate that STICA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agents in both sample efficiency and final performance.

AI.title_translation: 面向因果感知强化学习的面向对象世界模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为STICA的面向对象因果感知强化学习框架，显著提升了智能体在高维复杂环境中的样本效率和决策性能。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型采用整体式表征，难以准确模拟高维、非平稳且包含多个丰富交互物体的环境；受人类通过分解离散物体来高效决策的启发，需要开发更具因果感知能力的面向对象世界模型。
AI.method: 提出了STICA（Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning）框架，利用对象级Transformer作为世界模型来预测标记级的动态与交互，并采用因果感知的策略与价值网络在注意力层中实现因果引导的决策。
AI.result: 在多物体基准测试上的实验表明，STICA在样本效率和最终性能上均持续优于当前的先进智能体。
AI.conclusion: STICA框架通过结合面向对象的世界模型与因果感知策略，有效提升了强化学习在高维复杂环境中的样本效率与决策性能。
AI.translation: 世界模型已被开发用于支持样本效率高的深度强化学习智能体。然而，由于大多数世界模型学习所有环境组件的整体表征，要让世界模型准确复制高维、非平稳且由多个具有丰富交互的物体组成的坏境仍然具有挑战性。相比之下，人类通过将环境分解为离散的物体来感知环境，从而促进高效决策。受这一洞察的启发，我们提出了Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning (STICA)，这是一个统一的框架，其中面向对象的Transformer充当世界模型，以及因果感知的策略和价值网络。STICA将每个观察表示为一组面向对象的标记，连同智能体动作和产生的奖励的标记一起，使世界模型能够预测标记级的动态和交互。然后，策略和价值网络估计标记级的因果关系，并将其用于注意力层，产生因果引导的决策。在富含物体的基准测试上的实验表明，STICA在样本效率和最终性能上都持续优于最先进的智能体。
AI.summary: 本文提出了STICA框架，利用面向对象的世界模型和因果感知强化学习，解决了传统世界模型在高维多物体环境中表征能力不足的问题，并在基准测试中取得了优于现有先进方法的样本效率与性能。
AI.keywords: 面向对象的世界模型, 因果感知, 深度强化学习, Transformer, 样本效率
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入面向对象的Transformer和因果感知机制，解决了传统世界模型在高维、多物体环境中无法捕捉细粒度交互和泛化能力不足的问题。其创新之处在于将对象级动态预测与因果引导决策完美结合，显著提升了强化学习的样本效率和性能。

title: Verify Before You Generate: Sketch-Guided Efficient Motion-Planning for Video Generation
summary: Recent video generation approaches increasingly rely on planning intermediate control signals like object trajectories to improve temporal coherence and motion fidelity. However, these methods mostly employ single-shot plans that are typically limited to simple motion instructions, leading to suboptimal motion quality, or iterative refinement which requires multiple calls to the video generator and incurs high computational cost. To address this trade-off, we propose SketchVerify, a training-free framework whose key insight is to verify motion plans using lightweight video sketches before invoking the expensive video generator. This lightweight planning space enables efficient comparison of multiple candidate trajectories and bounded iterative refinement before a single final video-generation pass. Given a prompt and a reference image, SketchVerify samples multiple candidate trajectories and renders each as a lightweight video sketch by compositing the moving objects over a static background. A vision-language verifier then ranks these sketches according to instruction alignment and visual motion consistency, allowing unsuitable trajectories to be rejected before full video synthesis. The motion plan is iteratively refined until a satisfactory one is identified, then passed to a trajectory-conditioned generator for final synthesis. Experiments on WORLDMODELBENCH and PHYWORLDBENCH demonstrate consistent improvements in instruction following and temporally coherent, visually plausible motion. Using the same ATI-14B generator, SketchVerify improves the aggregate WorldModelBench score from 7.71 to 8.71. Compared with full-video iterative refinement, it achieves a 13.1x planning-stage speedup and a 3.6x end-to-end speedup.

AI.title_translation: 生成前验证：草图引导的视频生成高效运动规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 SketchVerify 框架，通过在视频生成前利用轻量级视频草图验证和精炼运动轨迹，实现了高效且高质量的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成方法依赖于单次规划（受限于简单指令，运动质量次优）或迭代优化（需多次调用视频 generator，计算成本高昂）。为了解决这一准确性与计算效率的权衡问题，本文旨在设计一种高效的运动规划与验证机制。
AI.method: 提出了 SketchVerify 框架。给定提示词和参考图像，采样多个候选轨迹并渲染为轻量级视频草图（静态背景上的移动物体）；利用视觉语言验证器根据指令对齐和视觉运动一致性对草图进行排序和拒绝不适合的轨迹；进行有界限的迭代优化，选出满意的运动计划后传给轨迹条件生成器进行最终合成。
AI.result: 在 WORLDMODELBENCH 和 PHYWORLDBENCH 上的实验表明，SketchVerify 在指令遵循和时序一致、视觉合理的运动方面带来了一致的提升；使用相同的 ATI-14B 生成器，将 WorldModelBench 综合评分从 7.71 提升至 8.71；与全视频迭代优化相比，规划阶段加速 13.1 倍，端到端加速 3.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: SketchVerify 框架通过引入轻量级视频草图和视觉语言验证器，成功解决了现有视频生成方法在运动规划中的准确性与计算开销之间的权衡问题，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能和效率。
AI.translation: 近期的视频生成方法越来越依赖于规划中间控制信号（如物体轨迹）来提高时间一致性和运动保真度。然而，这些方法大多采用单次规划（通常局限于简单的运动指令，导致运动质量欠佳）或者迭代优化（需要多次调用视频生成器，带来高计算成本）。为了解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了 SketchVerify，这是一个无需训练的框架，其核心洞察是在调用昂贵的视频生成器之前，使用轻量级视频草图来验证运动规划。这种轻量级的规划空间能够在单次最终视频生成通过之前，对多个候选轨迹进行高效比较和有界的迭代优化。给定提示词和参考图像，SketchVerify 采样多个候选轨迹，并通过将运动物体合成到静态背景上来将每个轨迹渲染为轻量级视频草图。随后，一个视觉语言验证器根据指令对齐和视觉运动一致性对这些草图进行排序，从而在进行完整视频合成之前拒绝不合适的轨迹。运动规划经过迭代优化直至确定满意的规划，然后传递给轨迹条件生成器进行最终合成。在 WORLDMODELBENCH 和 PHYWORLDBENCH 上的实验证明了其在指令遵循、时间一致且视觉合理的运动方面的一致改进。使用相同的 ATI-14B 生成器，SketchVerify 将综合 WorldModelBench 得分从 7.71 提高到 8.71。与全视频迭代优化相比，它实现了 13.1 倍的规划阶段加速和 3.6 倍的端到端加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SketchVerify，一个用于视频生成的无训练草图引导高效运动规划框架。它利用轻量级视频草图和视觉语言验证器在昂贵的视频生成过程之前对多个候选轨迹进行评估和迭代精炼，在显著提升视频运动质量和指令遵循能力的同时，大幅降低了计算开销。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 运动规划, 草图引导, 视觉语言模型, 高效合成
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种训练（training-free）且高效的草图引导视频生成运动规划框架 SketchVerify。其核心创新在于利用轻量级视频草图在视频生成前对运动轨迹进行验证和迭代优化，在保证时序一致性和运动逼真度的同时，大幅降低了计算成本，取得了显著的加速和性能提升。

title: Numerical Analysis of 2D Stochastic Navier--Stokes Equations with Transport Noise: Regularity and Spatial Semidiscretization
summary: This paper establishes a strong convergence rate for the spatial finite element discretization of a two-dimensional stochastic Navier--Stokes system with transport noise and no-slip boundary conditions on a convex polygonal domain. The main challenge arises from the lack of spatial $D(A)$-regularity of the solutio (where $A$ is the Stokes operator), which prevents the direct applicability of standard error analysis techniques. Under a smallness assumption on the transport noise, for a MINI-element spatial semidiscretization, we establish a strong convergence rate of order $h^{\varrho} \log\big(1 + \frac{1}{h}\big)$, where $\varrho \in (0,1/2)$.

title: S2WMamba: Modality-Specific Wavelet Decomposition with Learnable Detail Bands for Pansharpening
comments: 10 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Pansharpening reconstructs a high-resolution multispectral image from a high-resolution panchromatic (PAN) image and a low-resolution multispectral (MS) image. The MS bands carry the colour that must be preserved, but they enter most networks as an undifferentiated feature dimension, mixed with the spatial correction before any spectral decomposition is formed. We propose S2WMamba (spatial, spectral, wavelet, Mamba), which treats the spatial and the spectral axes with different transforms: a two-dimensional wavelet decomposition applied to a learned embedding of the PAN image isolates spatial edges and textures, while a one-dimensional wavelet decomposition applied along the spectral axis of the fused cue separates the spectral base shared by all bands from the band-specific variation. In both transforms the approximation (low-pass) filter is fixed and carries no learned parameters, and only the detail filters are learned. The two branches are coupled in one direction: the spatial branch first reconstructs a correction to the upsampled MS image, which then conditions the input of the spectral branch. A Mamba-based aggregator merges the two branch outputs. On the PanCollection benchmark, S2WMamba attains the best reduced-resolution PSNR on each of WorldView-3 (39.502 dB), GF2 (50.083 dB) and QuickBird (38.802 dB), and in full resolution its HQNR is within 0.011 of the best on every sensor. Ablations show that the benefit of the cascade lies entirely in its direction: reversing it yields the same accuracy as removing the coupling altogether. title: gHAWK: Structural Encoding for Scalable Training of Graph Neural Networks on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are a rich source of structured data, and graph neural networks (GNNs) are the dominant tool for learning over them. However, existing message-passing GNNs struggle to scale to large KGs because they rely on the iterative message passing process to learn graph structure. This process is inefficient, especially under mini-batch training, where a node sees only a partial view of its neighborhood. In this paper, we address this problem and present gHAWK, a novel and scalable GNN training framework for large KGs. The key idea is to precompute structural features for each node that capture its local and global structure before GNN training even begins. Specifically, gHAWK introduces a preprocessing step that computes: (a) Bloom filters to compactly encode local neighborhood structure, and (b) TransE embeddings to represent each node's global position in the graph. These features are then fused with any domain-specific features (e.g., text embeddings), producing a node feature vector that can be used with any GNN backbone. Equipped with these structural priors, the GNN no longer needs to rediscover graph structure, significantly improving convergence and model accuracy with little memory overhead. Extensive experiments on large datasets from the Open Graph Benchmark demonstrate that gHAWK improves accuracy on both node property prediction and link prediction tasks. Remarkably, gHAWK enables simple GNNs to match or exceed more complex relation-aware ones, suggesting that careful preprocessing can substitute for architectural complexity in KG learning.

title: HiFi-Portrait: Zero-shot Identity-preserved Portrait Generation with High-fidelity Multi-face Fusion
summary: Recent advancements in diffusion-based technologies have made significant strides, particularly in identity-preserved portrait generation (IPG). However, when using multiple reference images from the same ID, existing methods typically produce lower-fidelity portraits and struggle to customize face attributes precisely. To address these issues, this paper presents HiFi-Portrait, a high-fidelity method for zero-shot portrait generation. Specifically, we first introduce the face refiner and landmark generator to obtain fine-grained multi-face features and 3D-aware face landmarks. The landmarks include the reference ID and the target attributes. Then, we design HiFi-Net to fuse multi-face features and align them with landmarks, which improves ID fidelity and face control. In addition, we devise an automated pipeline to construct an ID-based dataset for training HiFi-Portrait. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses the SOTA approaches in face similarity and controllability. Furthermore, our method is also compatible with previous SDXL-based works.

title: SC-LDPC Codes Over $\mathbb{F}_q$: Minimum Distance, Decoding Analysis and Threshold Saturation
summary: We investigate random spatially coupled low-density parity-check (SC-LDPC) code ensembles over finite fields. Under different variable-node edge-spreading rules, the random Tanner graphs of several coupled ensembles are defined by multiple independent, uniformly random monomial maps. The two main coupled ensembles considered are referred to as the standard coupled ensemble and the improved coupled ensemble. We prove that both coupled ensembles exhibit asymptotically good minimum distance and minimum stopping set size. Theoretical and numerical results show that the improved coupled ensemble can achieve better distance performance than the standard coupled ensemble. We introduce the essential preliminaries and analytical tools needed to analyze the iterative decoding threshold of coupled ensembles over any finite field. We consider a class of memoryless channels with special symmetry, termed q-ary input memoryless symmetric channels (QMSCs), and show that, for these channels, the distribution of channel messages (in form of probability vectors) likewise exhibits this symmetry. Consequently, we define symmetric probability measures and their reference measures on a finite-dimensional probability simplex, analyze their foundational properties and those of their linear functionals, endow their respective spaces with metric topologies, and conduct an in-depth study of their degradation theory. Based on our analytical framework, we establish a universal threshold saturation result for both of the coupled ensembles over a q-ary finite field on QMSCs. Specifically, as the coupling parameters increase, the belief-propagation threshold of a coupled system saturates to a well-defined threshold that depends only on the underlying ensemble and the channel family.

title: Efficient Inference for Inverse Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
comments: 117 pages, including supplementary appendix. Revised theory and added empirical applications to medical care and fertility decisions
summary: In many sequential decision-making problems, researchers observe actions but not the rewards that drive behavior, yet wish to evaluate counterfactual policies. Flexible inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) methods accommodate rich reward representations but typically lack valid inference, whereas classical dynamic discrete choice (DDC) methods provide inference under restrictive parametric structure. We develop a semiparametric framework for debiased inverse reinforcement learning in maximum-entropy IRL and Gumbel-shock DDC models. We show that the log behavior policy acts as a pseudo-reward, identifying policy-value differences without point identifying the reward and, under a normalization, yielding a point-identified reward representative. This reduces inference on reward-dependent estimands to inference on smooth functionals of the behavior policy and transition kernel. We establish pathwise differentiability and characterize efficient influence functions through reward and transition Riesz representers, with the transition component obtainable from existing observed-reward off-policy evaluation theory. For normalized rewards, we derive an explicit transformation of these representers that accounts for the normalization constraint. We construct automatic debiased machine-learning estimators that permit flexible nuisance estimation while attaining $\sqrt{n}$-consistency, asymptotic normality, and semiparametric efficiency. We illustrate the theory through efficient inference for fixed-policy values under pseudo-rewards and normalized rewards, and for counterfactual values when the agent reoptimizes over a restricted action set.

title: PsyAgent: Constructing Human-like Agents Based on Psychological Modeling and Contextual Interaction
comments: 35 pages, 22 figures. Published in EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Updated to match the published version
summary: Human-like agents must express stable dispositions while adapting to roles, relationships, and norms. We present PsyAgent, a schema-first framework that operationalizes the trait-context interface by coupling a Big Five trait prior with explicit social-structural conditioning. PsyAgent comprises (i) Individual Structure (IS), a machine-usable trait-grounded profile, and (ii) Multi-Scenario Contexting (MSC), a curated library of role-relationship-norm frames spanning eight everyday arenas. At inference, fixed structured prompts couple the active MSC frame with the IS profile, encouraging behavior that is stable yet context-sensitive. To demonstrate learnability beyond prompt engineering, we use IS x MSC to synthesize supervision and fine-tune compact backbones with PEFT (SFT and optional DPO). Under a controlled psychometric-style evaluation protocol in percentile space, PsyAgent improves trait-faithfulness and multi-turn persona consistency, and is competitive with several larger general-purpose instruction-tuned baselines under matched decoding and scoring controls. We further triangulate the automatic protocol with external benchmarks and a small blinded human study. Overall, PsyAgent provides a precise and data-efficient approach to personality-grounded, norm-aware agents.

title: Learning and Comparing Local Traces for Weakly Supervised Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization identifies edited regions and provides spatial evidence for assessing image reliability, but fully supervised methods require costly pixel-level annotations. Weakly supervised methods reduce this cost using image-level labels, but classification can rely on a few salient cues without ensuring accurate or complete localization. This difficulty is pronounced when manipulation traces are weak and unevenly distributed and authentic and manipulated regions share similar appearance. We propose a CLIP-based framework that integrates Trace-Oriented Vision--Language Adaptation (TOVA) and Relation-Aware Trace Discrimination (RATD). TOVA adapts the visual encoder and uses global visual context to aggregate edge-weighted patch features into image-conditioned class prompts. The resulting class representations support image-level alignment and guide patch selection for Hierarchical Trace Contrastive Learning, providing local contrastive supervision across visual layers. RATD combines local context, spatial structure, and original-image details, then compares learned descriptors between appearance-matched regions. Bidirectional comparison messages are integrated with local features for dense localization. The two components share a visual encoder and are jointly trained using only image-level authenticity labels. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms the evaluated weakly supervised baselines in image manipulation localization.

title: The many faces of multivariate information
summary: Total correlation, dual total correlation, S-information, and O-information are usually presented as a family of related but distinct measures of higher-order dependency in complex systems. Here we show that three of them (S-information, dual total correlation, and negative O-information) are in fact collinear samples of a single affine function of an integer parameter $k$, which we call $Δ^{k}$. This form provides a well-defined notion of interaction order: fragility under single-variable deletion. We then show that $Δ^{k}$ has a conjugate partner, $Γ^{k}$, which arranges S-information, total correlation, and O-information into a dual spectrum of redundancy rather than synergy. Finally, we relax the implicit maximum-entropy reference distribution built into all of these measures, defining a Kullback-Leibler generalization $Λ^{k}(P\|Q)$ that measures higher-order information gain when updating from an arbitrary prior to an arbitrary posterior.

title: Highly Deformable Proprioceptive Membrane for Real-Time 3D Shape Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing the three-dimensional (3D) geometry of surfaces is essential for robot perception and physical interaction. Vision-based approaches reconstruct surfaces at high resolution from an external viewpoint but often require a clear line of sight. A conformable membrane that reconstructs its own deformation offers a complementary route. Based on optical waveguide shape sensing, this work presents a stretchable proprioceptive silicone membrane that reconstructs localized contact and in-plane stretching under large deformation. The membrane integrates edge-mounted light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and centrally distributed photodiodes (PDs) in an elastomeric waveguide using liquid-metal interconnects. A neural network maps the optical intensity measurements to a dense point cloud of the membrane surface. Optical acquisition and model inference run in real time at about 90~Hz. Under localized pressing of up to about 25~mm depth, the membrane achieves an overall shape reconstruction error of 1.580~mm. It also localizes finger contacts with a mean error of 1.779~mm. Extreme strain tests show that the optical signals remain informative for in-plane outline reconstruction up to 75\% strain, approaching the mechanical limit of the liquid-metal circuit. These results indicate a practical route to proprioceptive shape sensing in deformable robotic systems.

title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by compressing the knowledge of a teacher LLM to train smaller LLMs. On-policy distillation advances this approach by having the student sample its own trajectories while a teacher LLM provides dense token-level supervision, addressing the distribution mismatch between training and inference in off-policy distillation methods. However, on-policy distillation typically requires a separate, often larger, teacher LLM and does not explicitly leverage ground-truth solutions available in reasoning datasets. Inspired by the intuition that a sufficiently capable LLM can rationalize external privileged reasoning traces and teach its weaker self, we introduce On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), a learning algorithm where a single LLM acts as both teacher and student with different contexts. The teacher policy conditions on privileged information (e.g., verified reasoning traces) while the student policy sees only the question; training minimizes the per-token divergence between these distributions over the student's own rollouts. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, achieving superior token efficiency compared to reinforcement learning methods and better performance over off-policy distillation methods. Code repo: https://github.com/siyan-zhao/OPSD.

title: MA-LipNet: Multi-Dimensional Attention Networks for Robust Lipreading
comments: arXiv admin note: This paper has been withdrawn by arXiv due to unverifiable authorship and affiliation
summary: Lipreading, the technology of decoding spoken content from silent videos of lip movements, holds significant application value in fields such as public security. However, due to the subtle nature of articulatory gestures, existing lipreading methods often suffer from limited feature discriminability and poor generalization capabilities. To address these challenges, this paper delves into the purification of visual features from temporal, spatial, and channel dimensions. We propose a novel method named Multi-Attention Lipreading Network(MA-LipNet). The core of MA-LipNet lies in its sequential application of three dedicated attention modules. Firstly, a \textit{Channel Attention (CA)} module is employed to adaptively recalibrate channel-wise features, thereby mitigating interference from less informative channels. Subsequently, two spatio-temporal attention modules with distinct granularities-\textit{Joint Spatial-Temporal Attention (JSTA)} and \textit{Separate Spatial-Temporal Attention (SSTA)}-are leveraged to suppress the influence of irrelevant pixels and video frames. The JSTA module performs a coarse-grained filtering by computing a unified weight map across the spatio-temporal dimensions, while the SSTA module conducts a more fine-grained refinement by separately modeling temporal and spatial attentions. Extensive experiments conducted on the CMLR and GRID datasets demonstrate that MA-LipNet significantly reduces the Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER), validating its effectiveness and superiority over several state-of-the-art methods. Our work highlights the importance of multi-dimensional feature refinement for robust visual speech recognition.

title: SAME: Stabilized Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
comments: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/Prism
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, but real-world deployment requires them to continually expand their capabilities, making Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) essential. Recent methods leverage sparse expert routing to promote task specialization, but we find that the expert routing process suffers from drift as the data distribution evolves. For example, a grounding query that previously activated localization experts may instead be routed to irrelevant experts after learning OCR tasks. Meanwhile, the grounding-related experts can be overwritten by new tasks and lose their original functionality. Such failure reflects two problems: router drift, where expert selection becomes inconsistent over time, and expert drift, where shared experts are overwritten across tasks. Therefore, we propose StAbilized Mixture-of-Experts (SAME) for MCIT. To address router drift, SAME stabilizes expert selection by decomposing routing dynamics into orthogonal subspaces and updating only task-relevant directions. To mitigate expert drift, we regulate expert updates via curvature-aware scaling using historical input covariance in a rehearsal-free manner. SAME also introduces adaptive expert activation to freeze selected experts during training, reducing redundant computation and cross-task interference. We also introduce a new benchmark to evaluate MCIT with long task sequence, and extensive experiments demonstrate SAME's SOTA performance. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/Prism.
