title: TabularMath: Evaluating Computational Extrapolation in Tabular Learning via Program-Verified Synthesis
comments: 31 pages, 7 figures, 22 tables. Final version. A preliminary version appeared at the ICML 2026 AI4Math Workshop
summary: Standard tabular benchmarks reward interpolation: predicting values inside the data manifold, where local statistical smoothing works. However, much high-value tabular data, from pricing and financial rules to physical simulation, is produced by deterministic computations rather than noisy relationships. Can tabular models move from statistical interpolation to computational extrapolation, returning exact answers even beyond the range seen in training? We introduce TabularMath, a benchmark of 114 deterministic computations (233,472 rows) compiled from GSM8K and AIME problems into verified programs. We evaluate nine tabular methods, closed-form and symbolic regression baselines, and in-context learning with GPT-OSS-120B. On regression metrics, TabPFN v2.5 looks excellent: with 128 rows its median $R^2$ is 0.999 in-distribution, and it is the only tabular method whose median $R^2$ stays positive (0.76) when nearly every answer exceeds the training range. Exact answers tell a different story. Out of distribution (OOD), its accuracy falls from 39.5% to 7.8%, it answers no query correctly in 70 of 100 GSM8K tasks, and sixteen times more rows raise its OOD accuracy by only 0.4 points. Yet the answers are in the table: by construction, every label is a program's output on the row's inputs, and the training rows typically suffice to recover that program. Symbolic regression on the numbers alone recovers every OOD answer in 72 of 100 GSM8K tasks, and in-context learning with GPT-OSS-120B answers 39.2% of OOD queries. Tabular foundation models fit the trend but miss the computation, an inductive-bias gap that more data does not close. The competition-level AIME tasks remain open for every method.

title: Geometry-Preserving Neural Architectures on Manifolds with Boundary
summary: A growing number of neural architectures have been developed to enforce geometric constraints, including projection-based networks, exponential-map updates, and manifold neural ODEs. In this paper, we study several such architectures, with the goal of understanding their approximation-theoretic properties and trade-offs. We distinguish between architectures that enforce constraints at intermediate layers and those that enforce constraints only at the output. For projected neural ODEs on uniformly prox-regular sets, we establish stability estimates and derive universal approximation results on compact smooth manifolds, including manifolds with boundary. In particular, we establish universal approximation of measurable manifold-valued maps in the $L^2$ topology. In contrast, architectures that enforce constraints only at the output can admit uniform approximation guarantees for continuous target maps under suitable geometric assumptions. We further investigate how the choice of constraint-enforcing map, namely metric projection or the Riemannian exponential map, affects these guarantees. While both constructions can be used to preserve constraints at intermediate layers, their use at the output leads to different approximation properties. In particular, exponential-map output architectures can encounter topological obstructions to uniform approximation, motivating approximation guarantees in $L^2$. On the other hand, metric projection-based output architectures can retain uniform approximation guarantees when the constraint set has positive reach. Our study raises the broader question of when the additional complexity of enforcing constraints at intermediate layers, as motivated by neural ODE approaches, and different choices of constraint-enforcing map are justified by the resulting benefits in approximation and learning performance.

title: AgentArk: Distilling Multi-Agent Intelligence into a Single LLM Agent
summary: While large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems achieve superior reasoning performance through iterative debate, practical deployment is limited by their high computational cost and error propagation. This paper proposes AgentArk, a novel framework to distill multi-agent dynamics into the weights of a single model, effectively transforming explicit test-time interactions into implicit model capabilities. This equips a single agent with the intelligence of multi-agent systems while remaining computationally efficient. Specifically, we investigate three hierarchical distillation strategies across various models, tasks, scaling, and scenarios: reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning; trajectory-based augmentation; and process-aware distillation. By shifting the burden of computation from inference to training, the distilled models preserve the efficiency of one agent while exhibiting strong reasoning and self-correction performance of multiple agents. They further demonstrate enhanced robustness and generalization across diverse reasoning tasks. We hope this work can shed light on future research on efficient and robust multi-agent development. Our code is at https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/AgentArk.

title: EMA Policy Gradient: Taming Reinforcement Learning for LLMs with EMA Anchor and Top-k KL
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to acquire increasingly complex reasoning and agentic behaviors. In this work, we propose two simple techniques to improve policy gradient algorithms for LLMs. First, we replace the fixed anchor policy during RL with an Exponential Moving Average (EMA), similar to a target network in deep Q-learning. Second, we introduce Top-$k$ KL estimator, which allows for flexible interpolation between exact KL and sampled KL. We derive the stability conditions for using EMA anchor; moreover, we show that our Top-$k$ KL estimator yields both unbiased KL values and unbiased gradients at any $k$, while bringing the benefits of exact KL. When combined with GRPO, the two techniques (EMA-PG) lead to a significant performance boost. On math reasoning, it allows R1-distilled Qwen-1.5B to reach 53.9% on OlympiadBench compared to 50.8% by GRPO. On agentic RL domains, with Qwen-3B base, EMA-PG improves GRPO by an average of 35.6% across 7 datasets of Q&A with search engines, including 29.7% $\rightarrow$ 45.8% on HotpotQA, 27.4% $\rightarrow$ 40.5% on 2WikiMultiHopQA. Overall, we show that EMA-PG is a simple, principled, and powerful approach to scaling RL for LLMs. Code: https://github.com/LunjunZhang/ema-pg

title: Revisiting the Efficient Architectures for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Being a cornerstone of temporal analysis, change detection has been playing a pivotal role in modern earth observation. Existing change detection methods rely on the Siamese encoder to individually extract temporal features followed by temporal fusion. Subsequently, these methods design sophisticated decoders to improve the change detection performance without taking into consideration the complexity of the model. These aforementioned issues intensify the overall computational cost as well as the network's complexity which is undesirable. Alternatively, few methods utilize the early fusion scheme to combine the temporal images. These methods prevent the extra overhead of Siamese encoder, however, they also rely on sophisticated decoders for better performance. In addition, these methods demonstrate inferior performance as compared to late fusion based methods. To bridge these gaps, we introduce a simple and effective method for the change detection task. The proposed method performs the early fusion of the temporal data and replaces the decoder with a parameter-free multiscale feature fusion module thereby significantly reducing the overall complexity of the model. Our method demonstrates the optimal balance between change detection performance and the prediction speed across a variety of encoder architectures. Extensive experimentation on four challenging change detection datasets reveals the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Learning to Allocate Resources with Censored Feedback
summary: We study the online resource allocation problem in which at each round, a budget $B$ must be allocated across $K$ arms under censored feedback. An arm yields a reward if and only if two conditions are satisfied: (i) the arm is activated according to an arm-specific Bernoulli random variable with unknown parameter, and (ii) the allocated budget exceeds a random threshold drawn from a parametric distribution with unknown parameter. Over $T$ rounds, the learner must jointly estimate the unknown parameters and allocate the budget so as to maximize cumulative reward facing the exploration-exploitation trade-off. We prove a worst-case regret lower bound $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ for the general model, even with known uniform threshold distributions. We then propose RA-UCB, an optimistic algorithm that leverages non-trivial parameter estimation and confidence bounds. When the budget $B$ is known at the beginning of each round and every arm receives a positive allocation at the optimum (interior optimum, with a known lower bound), RA-UCB achieves a regret bound of order $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, and even $O(\mathrm{poly}\log T)$ under stronger assumptions. For unknown, round-dependent budgets, we introduce MG-UCB, which allows within-round switching and infinitesimal allocations, and matches the regret guarantees of RA-UCB; we also discuss an implementable discretization. We then validate our theoretical results through experiments on real-world datasets.

title: Going with the Flow: Koopman Behavioral Models as Pseudo Planners for Visuo-Motor Dexterity
summary: Contemporary visuo-motor dexterity models often rely on expressive policy classes with diffusion and transformer backbones to achieve strong performance. However, these architectures require significant data and computational resources, and remain far from reliable, particularly for multi-fingered dexterity. Importantly, they model skills as reactive mappings and rely on fixed-horizon action chunking, creating a rigid trade-off between temporal coherence and reactivity. To address these issues, we first introduce Unified Behavioral Models (UBMs), a framework to represent dexterous skills as coupled dynamical systems that capture how visual features of the environment (visual flow) and proprioceptive states of the robot (action flow) co-evolve. As such, UBMs ensure temporal coherence by construction rather than heuristic averaging. Unlike world models that attempt to predict the impact of arbitrary robot actions on the environment, UBMs target behavioral dynamics that encode how demonstrated robot behavior is related to desired impacts on the environment. A UBM can be viewed as a pseudo planner: given an initial condition, it computes the desired robot behavior over the entire skill horizon, while simultaneously "imagining" the resulting flow of visual features. We propose Koopman-UBM as a first instantiation of UBMs in the form of a structured latent linear system. K-UBM's inherent structure enables reactivity and adaptation via automated online replanning: the model acts as its own runtime monitor, automatically triggering replanning when predicted and observed visual flow diverge beyond a threshold. Across seven simulated tasks and four real-world tasks, our approach performs comparably to state-of-the-art baselines, while offering considerably smoother executions, fast inference, efficient learning, robustness to occlusions, and automated online replanning.

title: Beyond Arrow: From Impossibility to Possibility in Multi-Criteria Benchmarking
summary: Modern benchmarks such as HELM MMLU account for multiple metrics like accuracy, robustness and efficiency. When trying to turn these metrics into a single ranking, natural aggregation procedures can produce cyclic pairwise comparisons or rankings that are unstable to changes in the model set. We formalize this aggregation as a social choice problem where each metric induces a preference ranking over models on each dataset, and a benchmark operator aggregates these votes across metrics. While prior work has focused on Arrow's impossibility result, we identify sufficient conditions under which the impossibility disappears and meaningful multi-criteria benchmarking becomes possible. In particular, we deal with three restrictions on the combinations of rankings and show that on single-peaked, group-separable and distance-restricted preferences, the benchmark operator allows for the construction of well-behaved rankings of the involved models. Empirically, we investigate several modern benchmark suites like HELM MMLU and verify which structural conditions are fulfilled on which benchmark problems.

title: VeRA: Verified Reasoning Data Augmentation at Scale
comments: 29 pages, 9 figures. Final version. A preliminary version appeared at the ICML 2026 AI4Math Workshop
summary: Static benchmarks wear out: their problems circulate widely and can enter training data, and their scores saturate as models improve. Renewing a benchmark requires new problems with reliable answers, which are expensive to write by hand at competition level. We introduce VeRA (Verified Reasoning Data Augmentation), in which a language model automatically compiles each benchmark problem into an executable specification: a question template, a generator of valid inputs, and a program that computes the answer. Once its programs pass automatic checks, a specification yields many fresh, code-labeled problems at almost no cost, and people are needed only to audit. VeRA-E (equivalent) draws new instances of the same computation. VeRA-H (hardened) modifies the computation to create harder problems where scores saturate; because code computes every answer, the language model that writes them never has to solve them. VeRA-H Pro keeps the hardest of up to five such candidates, as ranked by a judge. Across 16 frontier models, fresh instances of AIME 2024 problems lower accuracy from 84.46% to 70.25%, and every model drops. GSM8K and the less-circulated Beyond-AIME, compiled by the same pipeline, stay essentially unchanged, so the drop reflects familiarity with specific problems, not an artifact of rewriting. On the near-saturated AIME 2024 II problems, VeRA-H Pro lowers accuracy from 84.91% to 58.57%. Expert audits back the labels, with all 220 audited fresh instances accepted and 95.1% of hardened candidates usable after repair. Compiling all 1,319 GSM8K problems cost about USD 100. VeRA thus makes benchmarks renewable by construction: wherever code can compute the answer, a benchmark can be refreshed whenever its problems leak or models catch up.

title: Train Short, Inference Long: Training-Free Horizon Extension for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models such as CausVid and Self Forcing enable efficient long-video generation through chunk-wise rollout with local sliding-window attention, yet suffer from visual degradation, appearance drift, and motion collapse beyond their training horizons. From a long-context sequence modeling perspective, we identify two underexplored inference-time bottlenecks in AR video length extrapolation. First, scarce high-quality long-video data and high training costs restrict video models to short training horizons. Consequently, low-frequency dimensions of 3D temporal RoPE remain under-exposed during training, inducing stronger spectral bias than in LLMs and hindering direct transfer of LLM context-extension methods. Second, both standard independent noise initialization and consistency-oriented methods with positive inter-frame correlation lack high-frequency dynamic priors to counter motion decay over long rollouts. To address these issues, we propose FLEX (Frequency-aware Length EXtension), a training-free, plug-and-play inference framework comprising three complementary components. Frequency-aware 3D RoPE modulation interpolates under-exposed low frequencies while extrapolating well-exposed high frequencies. Antiphase Noise Sampling (ANS) introduces negative intra-chunk correlation to inject high-frequency motion priors at initialization. An inference-only attention sink works with RoPE modulation to anchor global consistency. Experiments on Self Forcing and CausVid show substantial gains in long-horizon synthesis, with Self Forcing + FLEX matching or surpassing both training-free and training-based baselines on VBench-Long at $6\times$ to $12\times$ length extrapolation. Additional evaluations on Krea-14B and minute-level generation with LongLive demonstrate strong generalization across model scales, inference pipelines, and native long-video generators.

title: Image Generation with a Sphere Encoder
summary: We introduce the Sphere Encoder, an efficient generative framework capable of producing images in a single forward pass and competing with many-step diffusion models using fewer than five steps. Our approach works by learning an encoder that maps natural images uniformly onto a spherical latent space, and a decoder that maps random latent vectors back to the image space. Trained solely through image reconstruction losses, the model generates an image by simply decoding a random point on the sphere. Our architecture naturally supports conditional generation, and looping the encoder/decoder a few times can further enhance image quality. Across several datasets, the sphere encoder approach yields performance competitive with state of the art diffusions, but with a small fraction of the inference cost. Project page is available at https://sphere-encoder.github.io .

title: Impact of Markov Decision Process Design on Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated strong potential for industrial process control, yet policies trained in simulation often suffer from a significant sim-to-real gap when deployed on physical hardware. This work systematically analyzes how core Markov Decision Process (MDP) design choices -- state composition, target inclusion, reward formulation, termination criteria, and environment dynamics models -- affect this transfer. Using a color mixing task, we evaluate different MDP configurations and mixing dynamics across simulation and real-world experiments. We validate our findings on physical hardware, demonstrating that physics-based dynamics models achieve up to 50% real-world success under strict precision constraints where simplified models fail entirely. Our results provide practical MDP design guidelines for deploying RL in industrial process control.

title: The Landscape of Generative AI in Information Systems: A Synthesis of Secondary Reviews and Research Agendas
summary: The post-ChatGPT surge has rapidly reframed IS research and practice. As organizations and society grapple with GenAI adoption, a body of secondary studies and research agendas has emerged to synthesize early evidence and chart directions for future inquiry. This study reviews secondary and roadmap papers to synthesize the state of knowledge on GenAI's benefits and challenges in IS, and to identify future research directions. We performed a systematic search across Scopus, WoS, and eAIS for publications from 2023 onwards. Following a rigorous, multi-stage screening process, we selected a final set of 28 papers for analysis using bibliometric mapping and thematic analysis. We also conducted a quality assessment of all sources to gauge confidence in each source's contribution to the findings. GenAI offers transformative potential to drive productivity, accelerate innovation, personalize services, and democratize access to expertise. However, its adoption is constrained by interrelated challenges: technical unreliability, societal-ethical risks, and a governance vacuum. Interpreted through a socio-technical lens, our findings reveal a persistent misalignment between GenAI's fast-evolving technical subsystem and the slower-adapting social subsystem, positioning IS research as critical for achieving joint optimization. To bridge this gap, we propose a research agenda that reorients IS scholarship from analyzing impacts toward actively shaping the co-evolution of technical capabilities with organizational routines, societal values, and regulatory institutions: emphasizing hybrid human-AI ensembles, situated validation, design principles for probabilistic systems, and adaptive governance. For practitioners and policymakers, responsible adoption requires balancing automation with human augmentation alongside transparent governance and adaptive regulations to ensure broadly shared benefits.

summary: Automated visual inspection of locomotive coil springs presents significant challenges due to the morphological diversity of surface defects, substantial scale variations, and complex industrial backgrounds. This paper proposes MSD-DETR (Multi-Scale Deformable Detection Transformer), a novel detection framework that addresses these challenges through three key innovations: (1) a structural re-parameterization strategy that decouples training-time multi-branch topology from inference-time efficiency, enhancing feature extraction while maintaining real-time performance; (2) a deformable attention mechanism that enables content-adaptive spatial sampling, allowing dynamic focus on defect-relevant regions regardless of morphological irregularity; and (3) a cross-scale feature fusion architecture incorporating GSConv modules and VoVGSCSP blocks for effective multi-resolution information aggregation. Comprehensive experiments on a real-world locomotive coil spring dataset demonstrate that MSD-DETR achieves 92.4\% mAP@0.5 at 98 FPS, outperforming state-of-the-art detectors including YOLOv8 (+3.1\% mAP) and the baseline RT-DETR (+2.8\% mAP) while maintaining comparable inference speed, establishing a new benchmark for industrial coil spring quality inspection.

title: Sparse but Not Simpler: Pruning Makes a Vision Transformer's Weights More Modular, but Not Its Computation
summary: Sparse networks are often expected to be easier to interpret, and language models trained with sparse weights have much smaller circuits than dense ones. We test whether pruning brings this benefit to vision transformers with IMPACT, an evaluation that compares dense and pruned models on weights, neurons, sparse-autoencoder features, class circuits and attribution maps, with a dense model finetuned without pruning as a control. Pruning makes the weights more modular, but no other level becomes simpler than the dense model. Decisions are compared through class circuits, the small sets of nodes behind the decision for one class, extracted so that circuits of different models are comparable. Restoring the weights that pruning removed from a class's dense circuit undoes most of that class's damage, far more than restoring as many weights elsewhere, so the circuits hold what each class depends on. Pruned circuits hold far fewer weights, but only because pruning removed weights everywhere; counted in nodes, they are no smaller and no less shared. Sparser or more modular weights are therefore no evidence of simpler decisions. At the other levels, finetuning alone changes the measures about as much as pruning does, so comparing the interpretability of compressed models needs a finetuned dense control.

title: GIST: Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformers for Scalable Graph Neural Operators
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 25 pages. Code: https://github.com/ibm/gist-neurips-2026
summary: Neural operators on irregular meshes face a fundamental tension. Spectral positional encodings, a natural choice in graph learning for capturing geometry, require cubic-complexity eigendecomposition and inadvertently break gauge invariance through numerical solver artifacts; existing efficient approximations typically sacrifice gauge symmetry by design. Both failure modes break discretization invariance: models fail to transfer across mesh resolutions of the same domain, and similarly across different graphs of related structure in inductive settings. We propose GIST (Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformer), a scalable neural operator that resolves this tension by restricting attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings. We prove these inner products estimate an exactly gauge-invariant graph kernel at end-to-end $\mathcal{O}(N)$ complexity, and establish a formal connection between gauge invariance and discretization-invariant learning with bounded mismatch error. To our knowledge, GIST is the first scalable graph neural operator with a provable discretization-mismatch bound. Empirically, GIST sets state-of-the-art on the AirfRANS, ShapeNet-Car, DrivAerNet, and DrivAerNet++ mesh benchmarks (up to 750K nodes), and additionally matches strong baselines on standard graph benchmarks (e.g., 99.53% micro-F1 on PPI). Code available at https://github.com/ibm/gist-neurips-2026.

title: Empathetic Motion Generation for Humanoid Educational Robots via Reasoning-Guided Vision--Language--Motion Diffusion Architecture
summary: This article suggests a reasoning-guided vision-language-motion diffusion framework (RG-VLMD) for generating instruction-aware co-speech gestures for humanoid robots in educational scenarios. The system integrates multi-modal affective estimation, pedagogical reasoning, and teaching-act-conditioned motion synthesis to enable adaptive and semantically consistent robot behavior. A gated mixture-of-experts model predicts Valence/Arousal from input text, visual, and acoustic features, which then mapped to discrete teaching-act categories through an affect-driven policy.These signals condition a diffusion-based motion generator using clip-level intent and frame-level instructional schedules via additive latent restriction with auxiliary action-group supervision. Compared to a baseline diffusion model, our proposed method produces more structured and distinctive motion patterns, as verified by motion statics and pairwise distance analysis. Generated motion sequences remain physically plausible and can be retargeted to a NAO robot for real-time execution. The results reveal that reasoning-guided instructional conditioning improves gesture controllability and pedagogical expressiveness in educational human-robot interaction.

AI.title_translation: 情感化人形教育机器人动作生成：基于推理引导的视觉-语言-运动扩散架构
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为RG-VLMD的推理引导视觉-语言-运动扩散框架，用于为教育场景中的人形机器人生成情感化、教学行为感知的伴随语音手势，以提高人机交互中的手势可控性和教学表现力。
AI.motivation: 为教育场景中的人形机器人生成指令感知、伴随语音的手势，以实现自适应且语义一致的机器人行为。
AI.method: 提出了一个推理引导的视觉-语言-运动扩散框架（RG-VLMD）。该系统整合了多模态情感估计、教学推理和教学行为条件下的动作合成。具体来说，一个门控专家混合模型从文本、视觉和音频特征预测效价/唤醒度，然后通过情感驱动策略映射到离散的教学行为类别。这些信号通过辅助动作组监督的附加潜在限制，利用片段级意图和帧级教学计划来调节基于扩散的动作生成器。
AI.result: 相比基线扩散模型，该方法生成了更结构化和独特的动作模式，并通过动作统计和成对距离分析得到验证。生成的动作序列具有物理合理性，并可重新定向到NAO机器人进行实时执行。结果表明，推理引导的教学条件作用改善了教育人机交互中的手势可控性和教学表现力。
AI.conclusion: 推理引导的教学条件作用显著提高了教育人机交互中机器人手势的可控性和教学表达能力。

title: Delightful Policy Gradient under Distributed Friction
summary: Distributed reinforcement learning trains on data from stale, buggy, or mismatched actors, whose actions often have high surprisal (negative log-probability) under the learner's policy. Supervised fine-tuning learns stably from such logged data, while policy gradient often does not. We trace the difference to negative learning from surprising data: rare failures can dominate finite-batch updates, while rare successes carry information the current policy would otherwise miss. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) separates the two by gating each term with delight, the product of advantage and surprisal, and needs no behavior probabilities. In a contaminated bandit, DG suppresses the perpendicular noise of rare failures by a factor that vanishes as the learner improves; no gate based only on learner probability can do this without also suppressing rare successes. On MNIST with stale actors, DG beats importance-weighted policy gradient given the exact behavior probabilities. On a transformer sequence task, DG often reaches an order of magnitude lower error under staleness, actor--learner probability mismatch, actor bugs, reward corruption, and rare discovery. With four frictions combined, its sample-efficiency advantage grows with sequence length. All experiments are controlled diagnostics; we do not evaluate an end-to-end distributed system.

AI.title_translation: 分布式摩擦下的愉悦策略梯度
AI.tldr: 在分布式强化学习中，策略梯度在面对陈旧、有缺陷或不匹配的行动者数据时往往表现不佳。愉悦策略梯度（DG）通过引入“愉悦”门控机制，将优势和意外性结合，有效解决了这一问题，在多种“摩擦”场景下提高了学习的稳定性和效率。
AI.motivation: 在分布式强化学习中，策略梯度通常无法从陈旧、有缺陷或不匹配的行动者数据中稳定学习，而有监督微调则可以。本文旨在解决策略梯度在面对此类“意外”数据时，稀有失败可能主导更新导致负面学习，而稀有成功所携带的重要信息却被忽视的问题。
AI.method: 愉悦策略梯度（DG）通过使用“愉悦”（优势与意外性之积）来门控每个项，从而将稀有失败和稀有成功区分开。该方法不需要行为概率。DG通过抑制稀有失败的垂直噪声来提高稳定性，且在学习者改进时，抑制因子会消失。
AI.result: 在受污染的强盗问题中，DG抑制了稀有失败的垂直噪声，且该因子随学习者的改进而消失，同时不抑制稀有成功。在陈旧行动者的MNIST任务上，DG在给定精确行为概率的情况下优于重要性加权策略梯度。在Transformer序列任务上，DG在陈旧性、行动者-学习者概率不匹配、行动者缺陷、奖励损坏和稀有发现等条件下，通常能达到一个数量级更低的错误率。当四种摩擦结合时，其样本效率优势随序列长度增加而增长。
AI.conclusion: 愉悦策略梯度（DG）通过利用“愉悦”机制选择性地处理更新，有效解决了分布式强化学习中策略梯度面临的由陈旧、有缺陷或不匹配数据引起的稳定性问题，从而在各种数据不完美的情况下实现了更稳定、更高效的学习。
AI.translation: 分布式强化学习从陈旧、有缺陷或不匹配的行动者数据中进行训练，这些行动者在学习者的策略下，其行动通常具有高意外性（负对数概率）。有监督微调可以从这些日志数据中稳定学习，而策略梯度通常不能。我们将这种差异追溯到来自意外数据的负面学习：稀有失败可能在有限批次更新中占据主导地位，而稀有成功则携带着当前策略可能错过的有用信息。愉悦策略梯度（DG）通过用“愉悦”（优势与意外性之积）门控每个项来区分这两者，并且不需要行为概率。在受污染的强盗问题中，DG通过一个随着学习者改进而消失的因子抑制了稀有失败的垂直噪声；任何仅基于学习者概率的门控都无法在不抑制稀有成功的同时做到这一点。在陈旧行动者的MNIST任务上，DG在给定精确行为概率的情况下优于重要性加权策略梯度。在Transformer序列任务上，DG在陈旧性、行动者-学习者概率不匹配、行动者缺陷、奖励损坏和稀有发现等条件下，通常能达到一个数量级更低的错误率。当四种摩擦结合时，其样本效率优势随序列长度增加而增长。所有实验都是受控诊断；我们不评估端到端的分布式系统。
AI.summary: 分布式强化学习因行动者数据的不完美（如陈旧、有缺陷或不匹配）而面临挑战，传统策略梯度方法在此类场景下往往不稳定。本文提出了愉悦策略梯度（DG），通过引入一个“愉悦”门（优势与意外性之积）来选择性地处理更新。这种机制旨在减轻来自意外失败的负面学习影响，同时保留来自意外成功的重要信息，且无需行为概率。实验结果表明，DG在多种分布式摩擦场景下（包括陈旧行动者、概率不匹配、行动者缺陷和奖励损坏）均优于重要性加权策略梯度，显著提高了学习的稳定性和样本效率。
AI.keywords: 策略梯度, 分布式强化学习, 愉悦, 意外性, 摩擦
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“愉悦”机制，通过结合优势和意外性来智能地门控策略梯度更新。这一方法有效地解决了分布式强化学习中策略梯度在面对噪声和不完美数据时的固有不稳定性问题，并且无需精确的行为概率，极大地提升了其实用性。研究通过受控诊断实验充分展示了DG在各种“摩擦”条件下的鲁棒性和性能优势。然而，论文明确指出并未在端到端分布式系统中进行评估，这可能是未来研究的一个方向。

title: Does This Gradient Spark Joy?
summary: Policy gradient computes a backward pass for every sample, although the backward pass is expensive and most samples carry little learning value. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) scores learning value in the forward pass with \emph{delight}, the product of advantage and surprisal (negative log-probability). We introduce the \emph{Kondo gate}, which compares delight against a compute price and pays for a backward pass only when the sample is worth it; sweeping the price traces a quality--cost trade-off. On MNIST, keeping 3\% of gradient terms learns faster than standard policy gradient even when backward passes are free, and nearly matches full DG. In bandits, zero-price gating preserves the expected gradient direction and removes its perpendicular noise, delight ranks samples more reliably than additive mixes of value and surprise, and a rare action with high reward variance marks where delight fails. On transformer token reversal, the gate's advantage grows with sequence length and vocabulary size. Because delight tolerates moderate noise, a cheap approximate forward pass could screen samples before expensive backpropagation, a training analogue of speculative decoding.

AI.title_translation: 这个梯度会带来喜悦吗？
AI.tldr: 为了解决策略梯度中反向传播的昂贵问题，本文提出了“愉悦策略梯度（DG）”。DG在正向传播中通过“愉悦”（优势值与惊喜度的乘积）来评估学习价值，并引入“近藤门”根据价值决定是否进行反向传播。实验表明，这种方法可以显著节省计算成本，同时提高学习效率，甚至在某些情况下加速学习。
AI.motivation: 标准的策略梯度对每个样本都进行反向传播计算，但反向传播成本高昂，且大多数样本的学习价值很小，导致计算效率低下。
AI.method: 本文提出了“愉悦策略梯度（Delightful Policy Gradient, DG）”。DG在正向传播中计算样本的“愉悦度”（优势值与惊喜度，即负对数概率的乘积）来衡量其学习价值。接着，引入“近藤门（Kondo gate）”，该门将愉悦度与计算成本进行比较，仅当样本值得时才进行反向传播。通过调整计算成本，可以权衡质量与成本。
AI.result: 在MNIST数据集上，即使反向传播免费，只保留3%的梯度项也能比标准策略梯度学得更快，并几乎与完整的DG方法匹配。在多臂赌博机任务中，零价格门控保留了预期的梯度方向并消除了其垂直噪声；愉悦度比价值和惊喜度的加性混合更能可靠地对样本进行排序；对于具有高奖励方差的稀有动作，愉悦度可能会失效。在Transformer令牌反转任务中，门的优势随着序列长度和词汇量的增加而增长。由于愉悦度能容忍适度的噪声，廉价的近似正向传播可以在昂贵的反向传播之前筛选样本，这类似于推测解码的训练模拟。
AI.conclusion: 愉悦策略梯度（DG）及其近藤门机制通过在正向传播中评估样本学习价值并有选择地进行反向传播，显著提高了策略梯度的计算效率。它提供了一种质量-成本权衡，并在多种任务上展现了优势，为深度强化学习的训练提供了一种类似于推测解码的新范式。
AI.translation:
论文题目：这个梯度会带来喜悦吗？

论文摘要：策略梯度为每个样本计算一次反向传播，尽管反向传播成本高昂，但大多数样本的学习价值很小。“愉悦策略梯度（Delightful Policy Gradient, DG）”在正向传播中通过“愉悦度”（优势值与惊喜度，即负对数概率的乘积）来评估学习价值。我们引入了“近藤门（Kondo gate）”，它将愉悦度与计算成本进行比较，仅当样本值得时才支付反向传播的费用；调整成本可以描绘出质量-成本的权衡曲线。在MNIST数据集上，即使反向传播免费，只保留3%的梯度项也能比标准策略梯度学得更快，并几乎与完整的DG方法匹配。在多臂赌博机任务中，零价格门控保留了预期的梯度方向并消除了其垂直噪声，愉悦度比价值和惊喜度的加性混合更能可靠地对样本进行排序，而具有高奖励方差的稀有动作则标志着愉悦度失效的地方。在Transformer令牌反转任务中，门的优势随着序列长度和词汇量的增加而增长。因为愉悦度能容忍适度的噪声，廉价的近似正向传播可以在昂贵的反向传播之前筛选样本，这类似于推测解码的训练模拟。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“愉悦策略梯度（Delightful Policy Gradient, DG）”的新方法，旨在解决标准策略梯度中反向传播计算成本高昂且效率低下的问题。DG在正向传播阶段，通过计算“愉悦度”（优势值与惊喜度之积）来量化每个样本的学习价值。随后，引入“近藤门”机制，根据愉悦度与预设的计算成本进行比较，从而决定是否对该样本执行昂贵的反向传播。实验结果表明，在MNIST任务中，即使仅保留3%的梯度项，其学习速度也优于标准策略梯度，且接近完整DG的性能。在多臂赌博机和Transformer令牌反转任务中，该方法也展现出显著的计算效率提升和梯度处理的优势。研究还指出，愉悦度能容忍适度噪声，暗示可以通过廉价的近似正向传播来预筛选样本，为高效策略优化提供了一种新范式。
AI.keywords: 策略梯度, 样本效率, 愉悦度, 近藤门, 强化学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的方法来优化策略梯度训练，通过引入基于新颖的“愉悦度”指标的选择性计算机制，有效地平衡了计算成本和学习效率。论文中“近藤门”的隐喻非常巧妙，它提供了一个实用的框架来决定何时值得进行昂贵的反向传播。在昂贵的反向传播之前，在正向传播中筛选样本的理念是深度强化学习领域的一个重要贡献，有望大大提高训练效率。然而，其潜在的局限性可能包括“计算价格”的调优复杂性，以及在处理具有高奖励方差的稀有动作时，愉悦度可能失效的问题。

title: See, Remember, Explore: A Benchmark and Baselines for Streaming Spatial Reasoning
comments: Superseded by arXiv:2610.17640 (MemAct), a substantially revised and extended version of this work. The two entries describe the same work, not independent contributions
summary: Spatial understanding is fundamental for embodied agents, yet most spatial VLMs and benchmarks remain offline-evaluating post-hoc QA over pre-recorded inputs and overlooking two crucial deployment-critical requirements: long-horizon streaming inference and active perception when the current view is insufficient. To address this gap, we introduce S3-Bench, a benchmark suite for streaming spatial question answering with active exploration, where queries are temporally grounded to specific timestamps and must be answered using only observations available up to that moment. S3-Bench adopts a dual-domain design, combining a scalable simulator with controllable trajectories and exploration actions, and real-world streaming videos that capture practical sensing artifacts for rigorous generalization evaluation. Overall, it spans 10K+ scenes and 26K+ trajectories, with dedicated training (S3-Train) and evaluation (S3-Eval) splits. We further propose AMF-VLM, which supports streaming spatial reasoning under bounded computing via (i) memory folding, which compresses long-horizon observations into compact structured memory, and (ii) active exploration, which outputs explicit actions (e.g. move/rotate/scan) to acquire missing evidence before answering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared to models using identical training data, our approach yields improvements of 8.8% and 13.3% on the simulated and real splits of S3-Eval, respectively, while maintaining competitive transferability to standard spatial benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 看、记、探索：流式空间推理的基准与基线
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了S3-Bench，一个用于流式空间问答与主动探索的基准，以及AMF-VLM模型，该模型通过内存折叠和主动探索显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的空间理解至关重要，但大多数空间VLMs和基准都是离线评估预录输入的事后问答，忽视了部署关键的两个要求：长时程流式推理和当前视图不足时的主动感知。
AI.method: 本文引入了S3-Bench，一个用于流式空间问答和主动探索的基准套件。它采用双域设计，结合了可扩展模拟器和真实世界流媒体视频，包含10K+场景和26K+轨迹，并有专门的训练和评估划分。此外，本文提出了AMF-VLM模型，它通过(i)内存折叠（将长时程观测压缩成紧凑结构化内存）和(ii)主动探索（输出显式动作以获取缺失证据）来支持有界计算下的流式空间推理。
AI.result: 与使用相同训练数据的模型相比，我们的方法在S3-Eval的模拟和真实数据集上分别带来了8.8%和13.3%的改进，同时对标准空间基准保持了有竞争力的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: S3-Bench和AMF-VLM有效解决了现有空间VLMs在流式推理和主动感知方面的局限性，显著提升了具身智能体的空间理解能力。
AI.translation: 空间理解对具身智能体至关重要，然而大多数空间VLMs和基准仍然是离线评估预录输入的事后问答，并且忽视了两个关键的部署要求：长时程流式推理和当前视图不足时的主动感知。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了S3-Bench，一个用于流式空间问答和主动探索的基准套件，其中查询与特定时间戳在时间上关联，并且必须仅使用截至该时刻可用的观测数据进行回答。S3-Bench采用双域设计，结合了具有可控轨迹和探索动作的可扩展模拟器，以及捕获实际感知伪影以进行严格泛化评估的真实世界流媒体视频。总体而言，它涵盖了10K+场景和26K+轨迹，并具有专门的训练（S3-Train）和评估（S3-Eval）划分。我们进一步提出了AMF-VLM，它通过(i)内存折叠（将长时程观测压缩成紧凑的结构化内存）和(ii)主动探索（在回答之前输出明确的动作，例如移动/旋转/扫描，以获取缺失的证据）来支持有界计算下的流式空间推理。大量的实验表明，与使用相同训练数据的模型相比，我们的方法在S3-Eval的模拟和真实划分上分别带来了8.8%和13.3%的改进，同时对标准空间基准保持了有竞争力的可迁移性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了S3-Bench，一个解决现有空间视觉语言模型（VLMs）在流式推理和主动感知方面不足的新基准。S3-Bench支持具身智能体的流式空间问答和主动探索，结合了模拟器和真实世界视频数据。为应对此挑战，论文提出了AMF-VLM模型，该模型通过内存折叠和主动探索机制，在S3-Eval基准上取得了显著的性能提升（模拟数据提升8.8%，真实数据提升13.3%），并保持了良好的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 流式空间推理, 主动探索, 具身智能体, 基准, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于解决了具身智能体空间推理中长期被忽视但至关重要的流式推理和主动感知问题。S3-Bench提供了一个急需的严格基准，而AMF-VLM的内存压缩和主动探索策略为长时程、资源受限场景提供了一个实用的解决方案。这对于开发更鲁棒、更自主的具身AI具有重要意义。

title: TopoPilot: Reliable Conversational Workflow Automation for Topological Data Analysis and Visualization
summary: Recent agentic systems demonstrate that large language models can generate complex codebases from natural language prompts. Despite this progress, they present reliability concerns for scientific visualization due to invalid operations, subtle errors, and failure to resolve underspecified inputs. In this work, we introduce TopoPilot, a reliable and extensible agentic framework for automating complex scientific visualization workflows. We focus on topological data analysis and visualization as a primary use case, while designing the framework to generalize to broader visualization domains. TopoPilot employs a two-agent architecture: an orchestrator translates user prompts into workflows composed of atomic backend actions, while a verifier evaluates workflows prior to execution. Its modular design isolates components and supports new topological descriptors and domain-specific workflows without modifying the core system. It also employs numerous deterministic guardrails to ensure semantic consistency and accurate execution. To systematically improve reliability, we develop a taxonomy of failure modes and employ targeted safeguards for each class of error. Across 2,000 simulated multi-turn conversations spanning 100 prompts, including adversarial and infeasible requests, TopoPilot achieves a success rate exceeding 95%, compared with under 50% for a baseline without comprehensive guardrails and verification. We also show that TopoPilot outperforms Claude Code and Codex on similar prompts in terms of accuracy, completion time, and token usage.

AI.title_translation: TopoPilot：用于拓扑数据分析和可视化的可靠对话式工作流程自动化
AI.tldr: TopoPilot是一个可靠且可扩展的智能体框架，通过双智能体架构和确定性防护措施，显著提高了科学可视化（特别是拓扑数据分析）中对话式工作流程自动化的成功率和可靠性，解决了现有大型语言模型智能体在代码生成方面的可靠性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统在从自然语言提示生成复杂代码库方面取得了进展，但它们在科学可视化中存在可靠性问题，表现为无效操作、细微错误以及未能解决未充分指定输入等。
AI.method: TopoPilot采用双智能体架构：一个协调器将用户提示转换为由原子后端操作组成的工作流程，一个验证器在执行前评估工作流程。它采用模块化设计以隔离组件并支持新的拓扑描述符和特定领域工作流程。此外，它还使用大量确定性防护措施来确保语义一致性和准确执行，并开发了故障模式分类法，针对每类错误采用有针对性的安全措施。
AI.result: 在包含100个提示（包括对抗性和不可行请求）的2,000次模拟多轮对话中，TopoPilot的成功率超过95%，而没有全面防护措施和验证的基线系统成功率低于50%。TopoPilot在准确性、完成时间和令牌使用方面也优于Claude Code和Codex。
AI.conclusion: TopoPilot通过其创新的双智能体架构、模块化设计和全面的防护措施，显著提升了科学可视化中对话式工作流程自动化的可靠性和性能，尤其在拓扑数据分析领域表现出色，有效解决了现有LLM智能体系统的局限性。
AI.translation: 最近的智能体系统表明，大型语言模型可以从自然语言提示生成复杂的代码库。尽管取得了这些进展，但由于无效操作、细微错误以及未能解决未充分指定输入，它们在科学可视化方面存在可靠性问题。在这项工作中，我们介绍了TopoPilot，一个可靠且可扩展的智能体框架，用于自动化复杂的科学可视化工作流程。我们以拓扑数据分析和可视化作为主要用例，同时将该框架设计为可推广到更广泛的可视化领域。TopoPilot采用双智能体架构：一个协调器将用户提示转换为由原子后端操作组成的工作流程，一个验证器在执行前评估工作流程。其模块化设计隔离了组件，并支持新的拓扑描述符和特定领域工作流程，而无需修改核心系统。它还采用了许多确定性防护措施，以确保语义一致性和准确执行。为了系统地提高可靠性，我们开发了故障模式分类法，并针对每类错误采用了有针对性的安全措施。在涵盖100个提示（包括对抗性和不可行请求）的2,000次模拟多轮对话中，TopoPilot的成功率超过95%，而没有全面防护措施和验证的基线系统成功率低于50%。我们还表明，TopoPilot在准确性、完成时间和令牌使用方面优于Claude Code和Codex。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了TopoPilot，一个为拓扑数据分析和可视化设计的可靠且可扩展的智能体框架，旨在自动化复杂的科学可视化工作流程。它通过双智能体架构（协调器和验证器）、模块化设计以及确定性防护措施和故障模式分类法，解决了现有大型语言模型智能体在代码生成可靠性方面的挑战。实验结果表明，TopoPilot在2,000次模拟对话中实现了超过95%的成功率，显著优于没有全面防护措施的基线系统及其他现有模型。
AI.keywords: 拓扑数据分析, 科学可视化, 智能体系统, 工作流程自动化, 可靠性
AI.comments: TopoPilot的创新之处在于其双智能体架构和系统化的可靠性保障机制，特别是引入验证器和确定性防护措施来解决LLM智能体在科学可视化中常见的可靠性问题。其模块化设计也增强了框架的通用性和可扩展性。这项工作为构建更可靠、更实用的LLM驱动的科学工具提供了重要的方向。

title: How Effective Are NPM Malicious Package Detectors? A Large-Scale Empirical Study
summary: The NPM ecosystem faces escalating threats from malicious packages that exploit its open publication model. While numerous detection tools have been proposed, they are evaluated on disparate datasets with inconsistent settings, making cross-tool comparison unreliable and leaving practitioners without clear guidance. We present the first large-scale empirical study of NPM malicious package detection, evaluating 11 tools with 16 variants on a unified benchmark of 6,420 malicious and 7,288 benign packages annotated with 11 behavior categories and 8 evasion techniques. Unlike prior work, we inspect each tool's source code to explain why tools succeed or fail, not merely how often. Our key findings: (1) the precision and recall a tool achieves are structurally determined by how it resolves the ambiguity between code capability and malicious intent, with IntelGuard reaching the best F1 at 95.98% by grounding its judgment in retrieved evidence and GuardDog the best among conventional tools at 93.32%; (2) behavioral coupling amplifies detection signals when behaviors co-occur, raising SAP_DT from 3.2% to 79.3% for the collect-and-exfiltrate chain; (3) 80.3% of malware uses no evasion because the ecosystem lacks mandatory pre-publication scanning; (4) ML degradation is driven by concept convergence rather than concept drift, since malware became simpler and every decision boundary fitted to a corpus ages with it; (5) combination effectiveness equals complementarity minus false-positive introduction, not paradigm diversity. Strategic combinations reach up to 97.21% accuracy and 97.02% F1. We release our benchmark and evaluation framework.

AI.title_translation: NPM恶意包检测器有多有效？一项大规模实证研究
AI.tldr: 这项大规模实证研究评估了11种NPM恶意包检测工具，发现现有评估方法的局限性。研究揭示了工具性能的关键决定因素，包括如何解决代码能力与恶意意图的歧义，并指出战略组合能显著提高检测准确率和F1值。
AI.motivation: NPM生态系统面临日益严重的恶意包威胁，现有检测工具的评估标准不一，导致工具间比较不可靠，从业者缺乏明确指导。
AI.method: 本研究进行了首次大规模NPM恶意包检测实证研究，在一个包含6,420个恶意包和7,288个良性包的统一基准上，评估了11种工具的16个变体。研究还检查了每个工具的源代码，以解释其成功或失败的原因。
AI.result:
1. 工具的精度和召回率取决于其如何解决代码能力与恶意意图之间的歧义，IntelGuard的F1值最高（95.98%），GuardDog在传统工具中表现最佳（93.32%）。
2. 行为耦合在行为共同发生时会放大检测信号，使SAP_DT对于“收集-外泄”链的检测率从3.2%提高到79.3%。
3. 80.3%的恶意软件不使用规避技术，因为生态系统缺乏强制性的发布前扫描。
4. 机器学习性能下降是由概念收敛而非概念漂移驱动的，因为恶意软件变得更简单，且每个拟合到语料库的决策边界都会随时间老化。
5. 组合的有效性等于互补性减去误报引入，而不是范式多样性。战略组合的准确率可达97.21%，F1值可达97.02%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次大规模评估了NPM恶意包检测器，揭示了其性能的关键决定因素，并提出了通过战略组合显著提高检测效果的方法。研究发布了统一的基准和评估框架，以期为社区提供指导。
AI.translation: NPM生态系统正面临来自恶意软件包的日益严重的威胁，这些软件包利用其开放的发布模型。尽管已经提出了许多检测工具，但它们在不同的数据集和不一致的设置下进行评估，使得工具间的比较不可靠，并使从业者缺乏明确的指导。我们首次对NPM恶意软件包检测进行了大规模实证研究，在一个包含6,420个恶意软件包和7,288个良性软件包的统一基准上评估了11种工具的16个变体，这些软件包标有11种行为类别和8种规避技术。与以往的工作不同，我们检查了每个工具的源代码，以解释工具成功或失败的原因，而不仅仅是其频率。我们的主要发现是：（1）工具实现的精度和召回率在结构上取决于其如何解决代码能力和恶意意图之间的歧义，IntelGuard通过将其判断基于检索到的证据，达到了95.98%的最佳F1值，GuardDog在传统工具中以93.32%表现最佳；（2）行为耦合在行为共同发生时会放大检测信号，使SAP_DT对于“收集-外泄”链的检测率从3.2%提高到79.3%；（3）80.3%的恶意软件不使用规避技术，因为生态系统缺乏强制性的发布前扫描；（4）机器学习性能下降是由概念收敛而非概念漂移驱动的，因为恶意软件变得更简单，并且每个拟合到语料库的决策边界都会随时间老化；（5）组合的有效性等于互补性减去误报引入，而不是范式多样性。战略组合的准确率可达97.21%，F1值可达97.02%。我们发布了我们的基准和评估框架。
AI.summary: 这项大规模实证研究评估了11种NPM恶意包检测工具，揭示了现有评估方法的局限性。研究在一个统一的基准上分析了工具的性能，并深入检查了源代码以理解其成功或失败的原因。主要发现包括工具性能受代码能力与恶意意图歧义解决方式的影响，行为耦合能增强检测信号，大多数恶意软件不使用规避技术，以及机器学习性能下降的原因。研究还指出，通过战略性组合工具可以显著提高检测准确率和F1值，并发布了相关的基准和评估框架。
AI.keywords: NPM恶意包检测, 实证研究, 工具评估, 恶意软件规避, 机器学习退化
AI.comments: 这项研究通过首次大规模、统一的实证评估，为NPM恶意包检测领域提供了重要的见解。其创新之处在于不仅评估了工具的性能，还深入分析了其成功或失败的内在机制（通过源代码检查），并提出了具体的性能决定因素（如歧义解决、行为耦合）。研究结果对指导从业者选择和组合检测工具具有重要意义，同时发布的基准和框架也将促进未来研究。其对ML模型退化的分析也很有启发性。

title: GAAMA: Graph Augmented Associative Memory for Agents
summary: AI agents that talk with users across many sessions need long-term memory to stay coherent and personalized. Existing approaches use either flat retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that ignores how memories connect, or entity-centric knowledge graphs. Entity-centric graphs split each message into separate triples, which loses its context, and in conversations the speakers become hubs linked to almost every message, so propagation through them tells retrieval little. We present GAAMA, a graph-augmented associative memory that organizes conversations around topics. It keeps verbatim episodes, uses an LLM to distill them into atomic facts and topic concepts, and then synthesizes higher-order reflections. These four node types are linked by five kinds of structural edges, and topic concepts supply the cross-cutting paths, so mega-hubs do not form. Retrieval blends nearest-neighbor similarity search with Personalized PageRank whose transitions depend on edge type. We also introduce GRAFT (Graph Repair by Augmenting Facts & Topology), an offline repair step: for questions whose retrieved evidence fell short, a bounded ReAct agent searches memory again and records the grounded answer as a fresh fact, so later questions find it directly without extra query-time cost. On LoCoMo10, GAAMA achieves the highest average score of all compared methods (79.1%) and is competitive in every question category; GRAFT adds a small further gain. In a controlled comparison, replacing GAAMA's concept-linked facts with entity relation triples lowers reward by 3.0 pp. On MemoryArena, scored on what memory alone determines, GAAMA has the best score on average.

AI.title_translation: GAAMA：用于智能体的图增强关联记忆
AI.tldr: GAAMA是一种图增强关联记忆，通过围绕主题组织对话来解决现有AI智能体长期记忆的不足。它结合了最近邻相似性搜索和个性化PageRank进行检索，并引入了GRAFT进行离线记忆修复，在LoCoMo10和MemoryArena数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI智能体在多会话场景中需要长期记忆以保持连贯性和个性化。现有方法存在不足：扁平的检索增强生成（RAG）忽略了记忆之间的连接；实体中心知识图谱将每条消息分割成独立的知识三元组，失去了上下文，并且在对话中说话者成为几乎与每条消息都关联的中心节点，导致通过它们传播的信息检索价值低。
AI.method: GAAMA（图增强关联记忆）通过围绕主题组织对话来构建长期记忆。它保留逐字记录的事件（episodes），使用大型语言模型（LLM）将其提炼为原子事实（atomic facts）和主题概念（topic concepts），然后合成高阶反思（higher-order reflections）。这四种节点类型通过五种结构化边连接，其中主题概念提供交叉路径以避免形成巨型中心节点。检索结合了最近邻相似性搜索和个性化PageRank，其转换取决于边的类型。此外，GAAMA引入了GRAFT（通过增强事实和拓扑进行图修复），这是一个离线修复步骤：对于检索证据不足的问题，一个有界限的ReAct智能体再次搜索记忆，并将有根据的答案记录为新的事实，以便后续问题可以直接找到，而无需额外的查询时成本。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo10数据集上，GAAMA取得了所有比较方法中的最高平均分数（79.1%），并在每个问题类别中都具有竞争力；GRAFT进一步带来了小幅提升。在一项受控比较中，用实体关系三元组替换GAAMA中概念链接的事实会使奖励降低3.0个百分点。在MemoryArena数据集上，GAAMA在仅由记忆决定的评分方面平均表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: GAAMA提供了一种有效的图增强关联记忆框架，通过其独特的主题组织、多节点类型和边结构，以及结合最近邻搜索和个性化PageRank的检索机制，显著提高了AI智能体在多会话场景中的长期记忆表现。GRAFT进一步提升了记忆的准确性和效率。其概念链接的事实优于传统的实体关系三元组。
AI.translation: AI智能体在多个会话中与用户交流时，需要长期记忆来保持连贯性和个性化。现有方法要么使用扁平的检索增强生成（RAG），但它忽略了记忆之间的连接方式；要么使用以实体为中心的知识图谱。以实体为中心的图谱将每条消息分割成独立的三元组，这会丢失上下文，并且在对话中，说话者会成为几乎与每条消息都关联的中心节点，因此通过它们传播的信息对检索的帮助很小。我们提出了GAAMA，一种图增强关联记忆，它围绕主题组织对话。它保留逐字记录的事件，使用LLM将其提炼为原子事实和主题概念，然后合成高阶反思。这四种节点类型通过五种结构化边连接，主题概念提供交叉路径，因此不会形成巨型中心节点。检索结合了最近邻相似性搜索和个性化PageRank，其转换取决于边的类型。我们还引入了GRAFT（通过增强事实和拓扑进行图修复），这是一个离线修复步骤：对于检索证据不足的问题，一个有界限的ReAct智能体再次搜索记忆，并将有根据的答案记录为新的事实，以便后续问题可以直接找到，而无需额外的查询时成本。在LoCoMo10数据集上，GAAMA取得了所有比较方法中的最高平均分数（79.1%），并在每个问题类别中都具有竞争力；GRAFT带来了小幅的额外收益。在一项受控比较中，用实体关系三元组替换GAAMA中概念链接的事实会使奖励降低3.0个百分点。在MemoryArena数据集上，GAAMA在仅由记忆决定的评分方面平均表现最佳。
AI.summary: GAAMA提出了一种图增强关联记忆框架，旨在解决AI智能体在多会话长期记忆中存在的连贯性和个性化问题。该框架通过围绕主题组织对话，利用LLM将事件提炼为原子事实和主题概念，并合成高阶反思，形成由四种节点类型和五种结构化边连接的知识图谱。其检索机制结合了最近邻相似性搜索和个性化PageRank。此外，GAAMA引入了GRAFT离线修复机制，以增强检索失败时的记忆准确性。实验结果表明，GAAMA在LoCoMo10和MemoryArena数据集上均表现优异，超越了现有方法，并证明了其概念链接事实的有效性。
AI.keywords: 图增强记忆, 关联记忆, AI智能体, 长期记忆, 对话系统
AI.comments: GAAMA的创新点在于其独特的记忆组织方式，通过围绕主题构建对话图谱，并引入四种节点类型和五种结构化边，有效解决了传统RAG忽略记忆连接和实体中心图谱丢失上下文、形成巨型中心节点的问题。特别是主题概念的引入，为信息检索提供了更有效的交叉路径。GRAFT作为离线修复步骤，进一步提升了记忆系统的鲁棒性和效率。该方法为AI智能体长期记忆的构建和检索提供了新的思路，对于提升对话系统在多会话场景下的性能具有重要意义。

title: Transmittance-Guided Structure-Texture Decomposition for Nighttime Image Dehazing
comments: arXiv admin note: This paper has been withdrawn by arXiv due to unverifiable authorship and affiliation
summary: Nighttime images captured under hazy conditions suffer from severe quality degradation, including low visibility, color distortion, and reduced contrast, caused by the combined effects of atmospheric scattering, absorption by suspended particles, and non-uniform illumination from artificial light sources. While existing nighttime dehazing methods have achieved partial success, they typically address only a subset of these issues, such as glow suppression or brightness enhancement, without jointly tackling the full spectrum of degradation factors. In this paper, we propose a two-stage nighttime image dehazing framework that integrates transmittance correction with structure-texture layered optimization. In the first stage, we introduce a novel transmittance correction method that establishes boundary-constrained initial transmittance maps and subsequently applies region-adaptive compensation and normalization based on whether image regions correspond to light source areas. A quadratic Gaussian filtering scheme operating in the YUV color space is employed to estimate the spatially varying atmospheric light map. The corrected transmittance map and atmospheric light map are then used in conjunction with an improved nighttime imaging model to produce the initial dehazed image. In the second stage, we propose a STAR-YUV decomposition model that separates the dehazed image into structure and texture layers within the YUV color space. Gamma correction and MSRCR-based color restoration are applied to the structure layer for illumination compensation and color bias correction, while Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtering is applied to the texture layer for detail enhancement. A novel two-phase fusion strategy, comprising nonlinear Retinex-based fusion of the enhanced layers followed by linear blending with the initial dehazing result, yields the final output.
