AI.keywords: 全数字近似, 数学常数, 穷举搜索, 认证计算, π, γ, δ, e
AI.comments: 该论文通过穷举搜索和独立的认证算法（利用Arb和精确算术），为数学常数的全数字近似问题提供了严谨且可靠的解决方案。这种结合计算发现与数学证明的方法，确保了结果的高度可信度。代码和证书的公开进一步增强了研究的透明度和可重复性，对计算数学和数论领域具有重要意义。

title: Bird-Call Recognition Across Distance: Acoustic Degradation and BirdNET Performance
summary: As bird calls weaken with distance, their recordings lose spectral detail. We examine how species recognition varies with distance using controlled playback of ten-second excerpts from 20 bird species at seven distances from 1 to 48 ft. An STM32-based recording system acquires and stores the audio, which is subsequently analyzed on a computer using acoustic measurements and BirdNET. Across four metadata configurations, mean-aggregated top-1 accuracy is 95--100% through 24 ft, 90--95% at 36 ft, and 80--90% at 48 ft, with 20 recordings evaluated per configuration at each distance. Across the screened recordings, the median upper spectral edge is below its 1-ft reference at every evaluated distance from 4 to 36 ft, indicating an overall reduction in upper-frequency content with distance. These results show that recognition remains high through 24 ft despite measurable spectral degradation, followed by greater and configuration-dependent losses at longer distances.

AI.title_translation: 远距离鸟鸣识别：声学退化与BirdNET性能
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了BirdNET在不同距离下识别鸟鸣的性能，发现识别准确率在24英尺内保持高水平（95-100%），随后在更长距离上有所下降，尽管声谱细节随距离显著退化。
AI.motivation: 了解鸟鸣信号随距离减弱及其录音如何失去声谱细节，并探究物种识别准确率如何随距离变化。
AI.method: 通过控制回放20种鸟类各10秒的录音片段，在1至48英尺的七个不同距离进行测试。使用基于STM32的录音系统采集音频，然后通过声学测量和BirdNET进行分析。每种配置在每个距离评估20个录音，并分析了四种元数据配置下的平均聚合前1准确率和声谱边缘变化。
AI.result: 在24英尺内，平均聚合前1准确率达到95-100%；在36英尺时为90-95%；在48英尺时为80-90%。从4到36英尺的每个评估距离，中位数上声谱边缘均低于1英尺的参考值，表明高频内容随距离整体减少。
AI.conclusion: 尽管存在可测量的声谱退化，但鸟鸣识别在24英尺内仍保持高水平；在更长距离上，识别准确率下降幅度更大且依赖于配置。
AI.translation: 随着鸟鸣声随距离减弱，它们的录音会失去频谱细节。我们通过在1到48英尺的七个距离上，对20种鸟类各10秒的片段进行受控回放，来研究物种识别如何随距离变化。一个基于STM32的录音系统采集并存储音频，随后在计算机上使用声学测量和BirdNET进行分析。在四种元数据配置下，平均聚合的top-1准确率在24英尺内为95-100%，在36英尺时为90-95%，在48英尺时为80-90%，每个距离的每种配置评估了20个录音。在筛选出的录音中，从4到36英尺的每个评估距离，中位数上频谱边缘都低于其1英尺的参考值，这表明高频内容随距离整体减少。这些结果表明，尽管存在可测量的频谱退化，但识别在24英尺内仍保持高水平，随后在更长距离上出现更大且依赖于配置的损失。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了鸟鸣识别系统BirdNET在不同距离下识别鸟鸣的性能，并分析了声学退化对其准确率的影响。实验通过在1至48英尺的多个距离回放20种鸟类的录音，并使用STM32系统记录和BirdNET分析。结果显示，在24英尺内，识别准确率高达95-100%，而声谱高频内容随距离显著减少。研究得出结论，尽管存在声学退化，BirdNET在短距离内表现优异，但在长距离上的性能下降更为明显且受配置影响。
AI.keywords: 鸟鸣识别, 距离, 声学退化, BirdNET, 准确率
AI.comments: 这项研究通过量化声学退化对自动鸟鸣识别系统（如BirdNET）性能的影响，为野生动物监测和生态声学研究提供了重要见解。其创新之处在于采用受控实验设计，精确测量了距离对识别准确率和频谱特征的影响。研究结果对于部署声学传感器网络以进行远距离鸟类监测具有实际指导意义，提示在规划监测范围时需考虑距离限制及其对数据质量的影响。

title: Efficient Conversational Multi-Talker ASR with Predicted Speaker-Agnostic Activity Streams
summary: Multi-talker automatic speech recognition (ASR) can be performed by conditioning a single-speaker recognizer on frame-level speaker activity. However, this approach requires a complete diarization pass to obtain the conditioning signals and one ASR pass per speaker, making both the frontend and recognition costs dependent on the number of speakers. We reduce these costs by using Heuristic Error Assignment Training (HEAT) to merge the activities of an arbitrary number of speakers into two speaker-agnostic streams. Conditioning on these streams limits recognition to two ASR passes regardless of the number of participants. Through an analysis of the resulting encoder representations, we show that under a stream-assignment heuristic suited to conversational speech, the recognizer represents a stream target much as it does a speaker target. Because the streams do not encode persistent speaker identities, we further replace the conventional sliding-window diarization and clustering frontend with a model that predicts both activity streams directly from the audio in a single pass. A combination of arrival-order and permutation-invariant training objectives over the two-stream powerset labels prevents the predictor from collapsing to identical streams. We also investigate post-hoc speaker attribution by matching decoded utterances to speaker activities within their assigned streams. Experiments on corpora with diverse conversational dynamics demonstrate a favorable efficiency--accuracy tradeoff. On AMI and ICSI, two-stream conditioning is respectively 44\% and 87\% faster than per-speaker conditioning using the same diarization frontend, with less than 2\% relative WER degradation. Direct activity prediction increases these speedups to 79\% and 132\%, with relative WER degradations of 10\% and 21\%, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 使用预测的说话人无关活动流实现高效的会话多说话人ASR
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过预测说话人无关的双活动流来实现高效多说话人语音识别的新方法，大幅降低了计算成本，且仅伴随较小的准确率损失。
AI.motivation: 传统的多说话人语音识别需要完整的说话人双谱（diarization）过程以及每个说话人一次ASR过程，导致前端和识别成本随说话人数量增加而剧烈上升。为降低这些计算成本，作者旨在设计一种高效的会话多说话人ASR系统。
AI.method: 使用启发式错误分配训练（HEAT）将任意数量说话人的活动合并为两个说话人无关的流；采用直接从音频预测活动流的模型代替传统的滑动窗口双谱和聚类前端，并结合到达顺序和置换不变训练目标。
AI.result: 在AMI和ICSI语料库上的实验表明，双流条件比同等双谱前端的每个说话人条件分别快44%和87%，相对WER降幅小于2%；直接活动预测将加速提升至79%和132%，相对WER降幅分别为10%和21%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持较低词错误率（WER）的同时，大幅降低了多说话人语音识别的计算复杂度和处理时间，实现了高效性与准确性的良好平衡。
AI.translation: 多说话人自动语音识别（ASR）可以通过将单说话人识别器条件化在帧级说话人活动上来实现。然而，这种方法需要完整的双谱（diarization）过程来获取条件信号，并且每个说话人需要进行一次ASR传递，这使得前端和识别成本都依赖于说话人的数量。我们通过使用启发式错误分配训练（HEAT）将任意数量说话人的活动合并为两个说话人无关的流，从而降低了这些成本。以这些流为条件将识别限制为两次ASR传递，而不管参与者的数量如何。通过对生成的编码器表示的分析，我们表明在适合会话语音的流分配启发式下，识别器对流目标的表示与对说话人目标的表示非常相似。由于这些流不编码持久的说话人身份，我们进一步用一个直接从音频中单通道预测两个活动流的模型取代了传统的滑动窗口双谱和聚类前端。结合两流幂集标签的到达顺序和置换不变训练目标，防止了预测器坍缩为相同的流。我们还研究了通过将解码的话语与分配流中的说话人活动相匹配来进行事后说话人归属。在具有不同会话动态的语料库上的实验证明了良好的效率-准确率权衡。在AMI和ICSI上，双流条件化比使用相同双谱前端的单说话人条件化分别快44%和87%，相对词错误率（WER）降幅小于2%。直接活动预测将这些加速比分别提高到79%和132%，相对WER降幅分别为10%和21%。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种高效的会话多说话人语音识别（ASR）方法，通过将多个说话人的活动合并为两个说话人无关的流，并将识别过程限制为两次ASR传递，从而消除了计算成本随说话人数量增加而上升的弊端。同时，引入了直接预测活动流的前端模型，在多个数据集上实现了显著的加速且保持了较低的WER下降。
AI.keywords: 多说话人语音识别, 说话人双流活动, 启发式错误分配训练, 音频流直接预测
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种高效的会话多说话人语音识别方法，通过引入说话人无关的活动流和启发式错误分配训练（HEAT），将识别成本降至恒定的两次传递，显著提升了处理效率，同时保持了较高的准确率。对于处理复杂对话场景具有重要意义。

title: On Pareto-Optimal Estimation-Information Limits-Achieving Distributions for Integrated Sensing and Communications
summary: ISAC systems enable simultaneous data transmission and environmental sensing using a common waveform. Characterizing their fundamental estimation-information performance limits is of core interest in information theory. In this paper, the achievable data rate for communications and the Miller-Chang-type CRB on sensing distortion are adopted as ISAC performance metrics, both of which are functionals of the ISAC waveform distribution. Our aim is to characterize the optimal input distributions across the entire CRB-rate Pareto boundary, corresponding to different sensing-communication tradeoff preferences. Three types of power constraint on input waveform are considered, namely, i) general power (GP), ii) maximum amplitude (MA), and iii) constant modulus (CM) constraints. Under these constraints, Pareto-optimal input distributions are shown to exhibit a common structural property: the directional component is uniformly distributed over the complex unit sphere; the power distribution is discrete (excluding the communication-optimal point under GP, where it follows a Gamma distribution induced by Gaussian inputs). We further investigate and characterize their Pareto-optimal sensing-communication preference dependent support structures. Finally, numerical algorithms are developed under GP and MA to trace their Pareto boundaries and determine corresponding optimal power distributions based on their respective support characteristics. From both analytical and numerical results, we conclude sensing prefers deterministic power while communication benefits from a richer distribution of power levels, thereby revealing the sensing-communication waveform uncertainty tradeoff in the fundamental power domain.

AI.title_translation: 集成感知与通信中帕累托最优估计-信息极限实现分布的研究
AI.tldr: 研究了ISAC系统在不同功率约束下的Pareto最优输入分布，揭示了感知偏好确定性功率而通信偏好丰富功率分布的本质权衡。
AI.motivation: 表征集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中基本估计-信息性能极限，特别是在不同感知-通信权衡偏好下，确定整个CRB-rate Pareto边界上的最优输入分布。
AI.method: 通过理论分析波形分布泛函，推导出在不同功率约束（GP、MA、CM）下Pareto最优输入分布的结构特性与支撑集，并开发数值算法追踪Pareto边界。
AI.result: 证明了Pareto最优输入分布具有共同的结构属性：方向分量在复单位球上均匀分布，功率分布为离散分布（GP下的通信最优解除外）；并开发了相应的数值算法。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，感知倾向于确定性的功率，而通信则受益于更丰富的功率水平分布，揭示了基础功率域中感知-通信波形的不确定性权衡。
AI.translation: ISAC系统能够使用公共波形同时进行数据传输和环境感知。表征其基本的估计-信息性能极限是信息论的核心兴趣。在本文中，采用通信的可用数据速率和关于感知畸变的Miller-Chang型CRB作为ISAC性能指标，这两者都是ISAC波形分布的泛函。我们的目标是表征整个CRB-rate帕累托边界上的最优输入分布，对应于不同的感知-通信权衡偏好。考虑了输入波形的通用的功率（GP）、最大幅度（MA）和恒模（CM）三种功率约束。在这些约束下，帕累托最优输入分布表现出共同的结构特性：方向分量在复单位球上均匀分布；功率分布是离散的（除了GP下的通信最优解，此时它遵循由高斯输入诱导的伽马分布）。我们进一步研究并表征了它们与帕累托最优感知-通信偏好相关的支撑结构。最后，在GP和MA下开发了数值算法，以根据各自的支撑特征追踪其帕累托边界并确定相应的最优功率分布。从理论和数值结果中，我们得出结论，感知偏好确定性功率，而通信受益于更丰富的功率水平分布，从而揭示了基础功率域中的感知-通信波形不确定性权衡。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中的Pareto最优估计-信息极限实现分布，分析了不同功率约束下的输入分布结构属性、支撑集特征，并揭示了感知与通信在功率域的波形不确定性权衡。
AI.keywords: Integrated Sensing and Communications, Pareto-Optimal, Cramér-Rao Bound, Waveform Distribution, Power Constraint
AI.comments: 该论文在集成感知与通信（ISAC）领域作出了重要贡献，通过理论分析和数值算法揭示了感知与通信在功率域的权衡关系，对未来ISAC波形设计具有重要的指导意义。

title: Particle picking with an earth mover's seminorm
summary: Particle picking is a key step in single-particle cryo-electron microscopy. It is a challenging task where tomographic projections of proteins and other macromolecules are identified in extremely noisy images. In this work, we introduce a particle picker based on a seminorm defined in terms of a fast wavelet approximation to the earth mover's distance. Our picker is template-free, self-supervised and does not require any prior knowledge of the molecules of interest other than their approximate size. We test it on three public datasets and show that it achieves state-of-the-art reconstructions.

AI.title_translation: 基于推土机距离半范数的颗粒挑选方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于推土机距离半范数的无模板自监督冷冻电镜颗粒挑选方法，并在公开数据集上实现了最先进的重建效果。
AI.motivation: 冷冻电镜单颗粒挑选是关键且极具挑战性的一步，需要在极度噪声的图像中识别蛋白质和大分子投影，现有的方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入了一种基于推土机距离快速小波近似定义的半范数的颗粒挑选器，该挑选器无需模板、采用自监督方式，且只需大致尺寸这一先验知识。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的测试表明，该方法实现了最先进的重建效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于推土机距离半范数的小波近似方法能够有效且准确地从高噪声冷冻电镜图像中挑选颗粒，实现最先进的3D重建。
AI.translation: 颗粒挑选是单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜的关键一步。在极度嘈杂的图像中识别蛋白质和其他大分子的断层投影是一项具有挑战性的任务。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于推土机距离的快速小波近似定义的半范数的颗粒挑选器。我们的挑选器是无模板的、自监督的，除了分子的近似大小外，不需要任何关于目标分子的先验知识。我们在三个公共数据集上对其进行了测试，并证明它实现了最先进的重建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于推土机距离快速小波近似半范数的冷冻电镜颗粒挑选方法。该方法无需模板和复杂的分子先验知识（仅需大致尺寸），采用自监督机制，在公开数据集上取得了领先的重建效果。
AI.keywords: 冷冻电镜, 颗粒挑选, 推土机距离, 自监督学习, 小波近似
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将基于小波近似的推土机距离半范数应用于冷冻电镜单颗粒挑选，实现了无模板、自监督且无需先验知识的高效颗粒识别，展现出顶尖的重建性能。

title: Hybrid-Field Interference Suppression for Low-Complexity Uplink Channel Estimation
summary: Uplink channel estimation can be severely degraded by hybrid-field interference, where strong near-field intra-site interference is coupled with far-field inter-site interference. Although a joint near-/far-field dictionary can capture this interference structure, it requires dense angle--distance matching that may incur high complexity and performance degradation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hybrid-field interference suppression framework for uplink channel estimation. First, we formulate a hybrid-field interference model and analyze its sparse reconstruction. Then, to avoid exhaustive near-field dictionary matching, we propose a low-complexity interference-parameter estimation method based on the angle--domain diffusion pattern of the dominant interference. Using the estimated parameters, the proposed parametric interference-nulling orthogonal matching pursuit (PIN-OMP) algorithm suppresses the dominant interference components and reconstructs the desired uplink channel from the interference-suppressed observation. Furthermore, a physical critical-distance bound is derived to characterize the feasible distance-inversion region, and a conditional hybrid Cram'er--Rao bound (HCRB) is established to quantify the desired channel reconstruction limit under a reconstructed interference basis. Finally, numerical results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

AI.title_translation: 面向低复杂度上行链路信道估计的混合场干扰抑制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种低复杂度的混合场干扰抑制框架和PIN-OMP算法，有效解决了上行链路信道估计中的近远场干扰耦合与高复杂度匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 上行链路信道估计严重受到混合场干扰的影响（强近场站内干扰与远场站间干扰耦合）。传统的联合近/远场字典虽然可以捕捉这种结构，但需要密集的角度-距离匹配，导致高复杂度和性能退化，因此需要开发低复杂度的干扰抑制框架。
AI.method: 首先建立混合场干扰模型并分析稀疏重构；接着基于主导干扰的角度域扩散模式提出低复杂度干扰参数估计方法；然后提出参数化干扰置零正交匹配追踪（PIN-OMP）算法来抑制干扰并重构信道；最后推导了物理临界距离界和条件混合克拉美-罗界（HCRB）。
AI.result: 数值结果验证了所提方案的有效性，能够在低复杂度下实现高效的混合场干扰抑制和精确的上行链路信道估计。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的混合场干扰抑制框架和PIN-OMP算法，能够有效克服近场和远场干扰，实现低复杂度的精确上行链路信道估计。
AI.translation: 上行链路信道估计会受到混合场干扰的严重影响，其中强近场站内干扰与远场站间干扰相互耦合。尽管联合近/远场字典可以捕获这种干扰结构，但它需要密集的角度-距离匹配，这可能会引起高复杂度和性能退化。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种用于上行链路信道估计的混合场干扰抑制框架。首先，我们建立了混合场干扰模型并分析了其稀疏重构。然后，为了避免穷举式的近场字典匹配，我们基于主导干扰的角度域扩散模式，提出了一种低复杂度的干扰参数估计方法。利用估计出的参数，所提出的参数化干扰置零正交匹配追踪（PIN-OMP）算法能够抑制主导干扰分量，并从抑制干扰后的观测中重构出所需的上行链路信道。此外，推导了一个物理临界距离界来表征可行的距离反演区域，并建立了条件混合克拉美-罗界（HCRB）来量化重构干扰基下的期望信道重构极限。最后，数值结果证明了所提方案的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于低复杂度上行链路信道估计的混合场干扰抑制框架。通过分析混合场干扰模型，利用主导干扰的角度域扩散模式避免了穷举式近场字典匹配，并设计了PIN-OMP算法来抑制干扰和重构信道。同时，推导了物理临界距离界和条件混合克拉美-罗界（HCRB）来量化性能极限。
AI.keywords: 混合场干扰, 上行链路信道估计, 近场与远场, 干扰抑制, 正交匹配追踪
AI.comments: 该论文针对上行链路信道估计中的混合场干扰问题，提出了一种低复杂度的参数化干扰抑制框架，避免了传统的密集网格匹配，同时在理论上推导了物理临界距离界和条件混合克拉美-罗界，具有较高的理论与应用价值。

title: ECG-LabWAS: A Laboratory-Wide Association Study Using a Fine-Tuned Single-Lead Electrocardiogram Foundation Model
summary: Laboratory testing guides clinical diagnosis but requires blood sampling and processing. The electrocardiogram (ECG) is fast and noninvasive and may carry information about laboratory abnormalities, yet most AI-ECG models target one test at a time using 12-lead recordings. We conducted an exploratory ECG laboratory-wide association study (ECG-LabWAS), fine-tuning an ECG foundation model pretrained on 10.8 million ECGs to screen 50 laboratory tests from single-lead waveforms alone. The model was developed in an emergency-department cohort (MC-MED; 31,826 patients) and applied unchanged to an independent hospital cohort (MIMIC-IV; 115,921 patients). Of 89 abnormality directions (low or high values of each test), 33 met the same screening criteria in both cohorts. Areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve in the two cohorts were 0.841 and 0.838 for elevated NT-proBNP, 0.769 and 0.740 for elevated cardiac troponin, 0.755 and 0.731 for elevated creatinine, and 0.713 and 0.710 for low potassium. Discrimination changed little when the ECG--laboratory matching window was widened from $\pm$1 to $\pm$24 hours. Model predictions reproduced the co-occurrence of observed abnormalities but were about twice as tightly coupled, largely along one shared component consistent with overall illness severity; low potassium, elevated NT-proBNP and troponin, and markers of renal function retained discrimination beyond that of correlated tests. In exploratory analyses, ECG-assisted versions of the modified Glasgow Prognostic Score and the systemic inflammatory response syndrome criteria were associated with in-hospital and one-year mortality. These results identify which laboratory abnormalities warrant analyte-specific study with single-lead ECG.

AI.title_translation: ECG-LabWAS：使用微调单导联心电图基础模型的实验室广泛关联研究
AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于单导联心电图的基础模型，能够无创、有效地从心电图波形中筛查多种实验室检查异常。
AI.motivation: 传统的实验室检查需要血液采样和处理，而心电图快速且无侵入性，且可能包含实验室异常的信息，但现有的AI-ECG模型大多针对单导联或12导联的单一测试。因此需要通过大范围关联研究探索单导联心电图预测多种实验室异常的能力。
AI.method: 对在一个包含1080万份心电图上预训练的心电图基础模型进行微调，使用急诊科队列（MC-MED，31,826名患者）进行模型开发，并在独立的医院队列（MIMIC-IV，115,921名患者）中进行验证，从单导联波形中筛查50项实验室测试。
AI.result: 在两个队列中，有89个异常方向中有33个满足相同的筛查标准。对于升高的NT-proBNP、心脏肌钙蛋白、肌酐以及低钾血症，模型在两个队列中均表现出良好的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），并且部分标志物保留了超出相关测试的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: 单导联心电图基础模型能够有效筛查多种实验室检查异常，部分标志物（如NT-proBNP、肌钙蛋白、肌酐和钾）具有独立于总体疾病严重程度的预测能力。
AI.translation: 实验室检查指导临床诊断，但需要血液采样和处理。心电图（ECG）快速且无创，可能携带有关实验室异常的信息，但大多数AI-ECG模型使用12导联记录一次针对一项测试。我们进行了探索性ECG实验室广泛关联研究（ECG-LabWAS），微调了一个在1080万份ECG上预训练的ECG基础模型，仅从单导联波形筛查50项实验室测试。该模型在急诊科队列（MC-MED；31,826名患者）中开发，并在独立医院队列（MIMIC-IV；115,921名患者）中无修改地应用。在89个异常方向（每个测试的低值或高值）中，有33个在两个队列中均满足相同的筛查标准。在两个队列中，接收者操作特征曲线下面积对于升高的NT-proBNP为0.841和0.838，对于升高的心脏肌钙蛋白为0.769和0.740，对于升高的肌酐为0.755和0.731，对于低钾为0.713和0.710。当ECG与实验室匹配窗口从±1小时扩大到±24小时时，区分度几乎没有改变。模型预测重现了观察到的异常的共现，但耦合度大约紧密两倍，主要沿着一个与总体疾病严重程度一致的共享成分；低钾、升高的NT-proBNP和肌钙蛋白以及肾功能标志物保留了超出相关测试的区分能力。在探索性分析中，修改后的格拉斯哥预后评分和全身性炎症反应综合征标准的ECG辅助版本与住院和一年死亡率相关。这些结果确定了哪些实验室异常值得用单导联ECG进行分析物特异性研究。
AI.summary: 该论文进行了ECG-LabWAS研究，利用微调的单导联心电图基础模型从无创心电图数据中预测50种实验室检查结果，并在两个大型独立患者队列中验证了其有效性和临床应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 心电图, 基础模型, 实验室广泛关联研究, 深度学习, 非侵入性检测
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于单导联心电图基础模型实验室范围关联研究（ECG-LabWAS），探讨了利用非侵入性心电图预测多种实验室检查异常的可行性，为快速、无创的临床筛查提供了新途径。

title: PepDeTech: Anonymous Occupancy Monitoring on a Battery-Powered 2.3k-Zone dToF LiDAR Node with On-Chip Processing and Bluetooth LE Reporting
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: As populations grow, society is increasingly required to shift towards systems of shared resources, which allow space, energy and time to be optimised. Facilitating this transition depends on data: how many people are present, when and where. From such information, schedules can be organised more efficiently and resources allocated where they matter. At the same time, privacy concerns and energy consumption limit deployment: cameras are frequently unacceptable, while simpler sensors miss people and cannot provide the full picture. This paper presents PepDeTech, a compact, battery-powered occupancy node that combines a 54 x 42-zone direct Time-of-Flight (dToF) Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) (VL53L9CX) with a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) System on Chip (SoC). Three deterministic algorithms, background subtraction, motion history and a track lifecycle, run on-chip and count the people simultaneously, providing real-time occupancy monitoring. No trained model is involved, and setup takes less than a minute. Over three scenarios, background subtraction reaches a per-frame +-1-person accuracy of 83.6 % (mean absolute error (MAE) 0.70 persons), tested with up to five people present. At a 30 s interval the node draws only 3.1 mW, lasting 60 d on a 1200 mA h cell. Several weeks of deployment on a single charge make the node usable as a survey instrument for facility management: a room can be characterised for a measurement campaign without cabling, network provisioning or a camera, and the resulting occupancy record is what ventilation, lighting, cleaning and space-allocation decisions are argued from, ultimately resulting in more efficient resource allocation.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: PepDeTech：基于电池供电的 2.3k 区域 dToF LiDAR 节点的匿名占用监测，具备片上处理与蓝牙 LE 上报功能
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于 dToF LiDAR 和低功耗蓝牙的电池供电占用监测节点 PepDeTech，无需摄像头或训练模型，即可实现隐私安全的实时人数统计与长达数月的续航。
AI.motivation: 为了应对日益增长的共享资源空间优化需求，同时解决传统摄像头存在隐私争议、简单传感器精度不足，以及部署受限于功耗和布线的问题，开发一种低功耗、匿名、便携且易于部署的占用监测节点。
AI.method: 结合了 54 x 42 区域的 dToF LiDAR（VL53L9CX）与蓝牙低功耗（BLE）SoC，在芯片上运行三种确定性算法（背景减除、运动历史和轨迹生命周期）来进行人数统计和实时监测。
AI.result: 在三个场景测试中，背景减除法达到了 83.6% 的单帧 ±1 人准确率（平均绝对误差 MAE 为 0.70 人，测试人数最多达 5 人）。在 30 秒上报间隔下，节点功耗仅为 3.1 mW，使用 1200 mAh 电池可续航 60 天。
AI.conclusion: PepDeTech 成功展示了一种基于电池供电的低功耗、免训练且注重隐私的 dToF LiDAR 占用监测节点，非常适合设施管理和资源优化。
AI.translation: 随着人口增长，社会正日益转向共享资源系统，以优化空间、能源和时间。促进这一转变取决于数据：有多少人存在、何时何地。从此类信息中，可以更有效地组织日程并分配重要资源。同时，隐私问题和能耗限制了部署：摄像头常常不可接受，而简单的传感器则会漏掉人群且无法提供全貌。本文提出了 PepDeTech，一个紧凑的、电池供电的占用节点，它将 54 x 42 区域的直接飞行时间（dToF）激光雷达（VL53L9CX）与蓝牙低能耗（BLE）片上系统（SoC）结合起来。三种确定性算法（背景减除、运动历史和轨迹生命周期）在芯片上运行并同时计算人数，提供实时的占用监测。不涉及训练模型，设置时间不到一分钟。在三个场景中，背景减除法达到了每帧 ±1 人的 83.6% 的准确率（平均绝对误差（MAE）0.70 人），测试时最多有五人在线。在 30 秒的间隔下，该节点仅消耗 3.1 mW 的功率，在 1200 mA h 的电池上可持续使用 60 天。单次充电可部署数周，使该节点可用作设施管理的调查工具：可以在没有电缆、网络配置或摄像头的情况下对房间进行测量活动的表征，由此产生的占用记录是通风、照明、清洁和空间分配决策的论据，最终带来更有效的资源分配。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 PepDeTech，一个紧凑、电池供电的占用监测节点，它集成了 dToF LiDAR 与 BLE SoC。通过在芯片上运行确定性算法，该节点能够在不使用摄像头和训练模型的情况下，实现匿名、实时的人数统计与低功耗长续航运行，非常适用于设施管理中的空间表征和资源优化。
AI.keywords: dToF LiDAR, 占用监测, 蓝牙低功耗, 片上处理, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的低功耗、注重隐私保护的人数统计与占用监测方案，巧妙结合了dToF LiDAR与片上确定性算法，避免了复杂的机器学习模型，在电池供电和隐私合规的场景下具有极高的实用价值。

title: Learned Score-Based Turbo Message Passing for Compressive Image Recovery
summary: Score-based generative models have been incorpo-rated into message passing algorithms for compressive image recovery, providing a prior for the denoising module in message passing. Score-based generative models assume the input signal to be a clean signal perturbed by independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) Gaussian noise. Yet, this assumption often fails during message passing, leading to slow convergence and limited reconstruction quality. In this letter, we propose the learned score-based turbo message passing (LSTMP) algorithm to overcome this limitation. By employing a deep unfolding framework, LSTMP unrolls the iterative process into a neural network, enabling the denoiser to adapt to complicated noise distributions inherent in the iterative updates. Furthermore, by treating the denoiser as an iterative solver, we incorporate the likelihood information of compressed measurements into the neural network of the denoiser, resembling the message passing between linear and nonlinear modules in STMP. Experiments on the FFHQ dataset show that LSTMP achieves convergence in no more than three iterations while delivering high-ffdelity re-constructions, signiffcantly outperforming the existing baselines.

AI.title_translation: 用于压缩图像恢复的学习型基于得分的涡轮消息传递算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于深度展开的LSTMP算法，解决了压缩图像恢复中得分模型的噪声不匹配问题，实现了3次迭代内的高质量图像重建。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于得分的生成模型假设输入信号是被独立同分布高斯噪声扰动的干净信号，但在消息传递过程中这一假设常不成立，导致收敛缓慢且重建质量有限。
AI.method: 提出学习型基于得分的涡轮消息传递（LSTMP）算法，利用深度展开框架将迭代过程展开为神经网络，使去噪器适应复杂的噪声分布，并通过将去噪器视为迭代求解器，将压缩测量的似然信息融入其中。
AI.result: 在FFHQ数据集上的实验表明，LSTMP算法在不超过3次迭代内即可实现收敛，并提供高保真的重建效果，显著优于现有基线算法。
AI.conclusion: LSTMP算法通过深度展开和融合似然信息，有效解决了压缩图像恢复中基于得分的生成模型噪声假设不匹配问题，实现了高效、高质量的图像重建。
AI.translation: 基于得分的生成模型已被引入用于压缩图像恢复的消息传递算法中，为消息传递中的去噪模块提供先验。然而，基于得分的生成模型通常假设输入信号是被独立同分布（i.i.d.）高斯噪声扰动的干净信号。在消息传递过程中，这一假设往往失效，导致收敛缓慢且重建质量有限。在本快报中，我们提出了学习型基于得分的涡轮消息传递（LSTMP）算法来克服这一局限性。通过采用深度展开框架，LSTMP将迭代过程展开为神经网络，使去噪器能够适应迭代更新中固有的复杂噪声分布。此外，通过将去噪器视为一个迭代求解器，我们将压缩测量的似然信息融入去噪器的神经网络中，类似于STMP中线性和非线性模块之间的消息传递。在FFHQ数据集上的实验表明，LSTMP在不超过三次迭代内即可实现收敛，同时提供高保真的重建效果，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LSTMP的学习型基于得分的涡轮消息传递算法，用于压缩图像恢复。该方法通过深度展开框架解决了解析过程中噪声分布复杂的难题，并将似然信息融入去噪器中，实现了极快收敛和卓越的图像重建性能。
AI.keywords: Compressive image recovery, Score-based generative models, Turbo message passing, Deep unfolding
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了基于得分的生成模型与深度展开框架（Deep Unfolding），解决了传统消息传递算法中噪声假设不匹配的问题，不仅大幅提升了图像重建质量，还将收敛速度缩短至3次迭代以内，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: From Pilots to Position: Experimental Near-Field Localization for ISAC
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables wireless systems to reuse communication signals for environmental sensing, potentially reducing the need for dedicated sensing resources. However, the achievable localization accuracy of communication-centric waveforms under practical hardware constraints remains an important challenge. In this paper, we experimentally investigate near-field target localization using OFDM pilot signals in a distributed communication system. We consider both coherent and noncoherent localization approaches, exploiting multistatic propagation delays and time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) information extracted from pilot-based channel estimates. A hardware setup comprising two transmitters and four receivers was developed and configured to operate at 3.4 GHz with 198 MHz occupied bandwidth to evaluate localization performance under realistic propagation and synchronization conditions. Experimental results across 16 static target positions demonstrate mean localization errors of 19.8 cm and 18.8 cm for coherent backprojection and noncoherent delay-TDOA fusion, respectively. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of occupied bandwidth on localization accuracy of the two proposed algorithms. These findings provide experimental insights into the capabilities and practical limitations of OFDM pilot-based sensing, supporting resource-efficient localization in future ISAC systems.

AI.title_translation: 从导频到位置：面向ISAC的实验性近场定位
AI.tldr: 本文通过实验验证了在ISAC系统中使用OFDM导频信号进行近场目标定位的可行性，并展示了相干和非相干定位算法在实际硬件下的定位性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管集成感知与通信（ISAC）能够利用通信信号进行环境感知从而节省资源，但在实际硬件约束下，以通信为中心的波形所能达到的定位精度仍然是一个重要挑战，因此需要通过实验来研究其可行性和局限性。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含两个发射器和四个接收器的硬件实验平台（工作频率3.4 GHz，带宽198 MHz），采用基于OFDM导频的信道估计，研究并实现了相干反投影和非相干（基于多基地传播延迟与到达时间差TDOA信息融合）两种定位方法。
AI.result: 在16个静态目标位置进行的实验表明，相干反投影和非相干延迟-TDOA融合方法的平均定位误差分别达到了19.8厘米和18.8厘米，同时还研究了占用带宽对定位精度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，相干反投影和非相干延迟-TDOA融合方法在实际硬件约束下均可实现亚分米级的平均定位误差（分别为19.8厘米和18.8厘米），验证了利用通信OFDM导频信号进行近场定位的可行性与有效性。
AI.translation: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）使无线系统能够重用通信信号进行环境感知，从而有可能减少对专用感知资源的需求。然而，在实际硬件约束下，以通信为中心的波形所能达到的定位精度仍然是一个重要挑战。在本文中，我们通过实验研究了分布式通信系统中使用OFDM导频信号的近场目标定位。我们考虑了相干和非相干定位方法，利用从基于导频的信道估计中提取的多基地传播延迟和到达时间差（TDOA）信息。开发了一个由两个发射器和四个接收器组成的硬件平台，并将其配置为在3.4 GHz频率、198 MHz占用带宽下运行，以评估真实传播和同步条件下的定位性能。在16个静态目标位置上的实验结果表明，相干反投影和非相干延迟-TDOA融合的平均定位误差分别为19.8厘米和18.8厘米。此外，我们研究了占用带宽对两种所提算法定位精度的影响。这些发现为基于OFDM导频的感知的性能和实际局限性提供了实验见解，支持了未来ISAC系统中资源高效的定位。
AI.summary: 本文通过实验研究了分布式通信系统中利用OFDM导频信号进行近场目标定位的方法。通过搭建实际硬件平台评估了相干和非相干定位算法的性能，实验结果证明了利用通信导频信号进行资源高效定位的可行性。
AI.keywords: 集成感知与通信 (ISAC), 近场定位, 正交频分复用 (OFDM) 导频, 到达时间差 (TDOA), 实验验证
AI.comments: 该论文通过搭建硬件平台，对集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中的近场目标定位进行了实心验证，评估了相干反投影和非相干TDOA融合算法在实际硬件约束下的性能，为未来资源高效的ISAC系统提供了宝贵的实验洞察。

title: Geometrical Estimation of Electromagnetic Degrees of Freedom in Reflecting Environments
summary: The number of spatial degrees of freedom (NDoF) of electromagnetic communication channels in reflecting environments is investigated using a full-vector formulation based on dyadic Green's functions and equivalent electric and magnetic surface currents. The channel correlation eigenproblem characterizes the electromagnetic communication modes and their coupling strengths, while the leading-order NDoF is estimated geometrically from the receiver-accessible phase space volume in the electrically large regime. By combining two geometrical projection Jacobians, the phase space volume is related to the mutual shadow area, establishing the equivalence between the two geometrical NDoF formulations and yielding a two-polarization estimate equal to twice the mutual shadow area divided by the squared wavelength. The free-space mutual shadow formulation is extended to perfect electric conductor (PEC) reflecting environments through image construction and phase space ray tracing, accounting for specular reflections and geometrical visibility constraints. The formulation is validated against the eigenvalue spectra of full-vector electromagnetic channels involving planar PEC reflectors, a parabolic reflector, a parallel-plate waveguide, and a non-line-of-sight L-shaped corridor. The geometrical predictions agree with the observed spectral transitions across configurations involving multiple reflections, focusing, and blockage.

AI.title_translation: 反射环境中电磁自由度的几何估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于几何方法（互阴影面积与相空间体积）估计反射环境中电磁空间自由度的新框架，并通过复杂反射环境的验证证明了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 探究并估计电磁通信信道在反射环境中的空间自由度（NDoF），以克服传统方法在处理复杂反射、多径效应和几何可见性约束时的不足。
AI.method: 利用基于并矢格林函数和等效电磁表面电流的全矢量公式，结合接收器可访问相空间体积、几何投影雅可比行列式、镜像构造以及相空间射线追踪方法进行估计。
AI.result: 推导出了两极化自由度估计公式（等于两倍的互阴影面积除以波长平方），并在包含平面PEC反射器、抛物面反射器、平行板波导和非视距L形走廊等多种复杂反射环境的全矢量电磁信道验证中，几何预测与特征值谱高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相空间体积与互阴影面积相联系，并利用镜像构造和相空间射线追踪将自由度估计扩展到完美电导体反射环境中，该研究成功实现了对复杂反射环境下电磁空间自由度的精确几何估计，预测结果与全矢量特征值谱高度一致。
AI.translation: 本文利用基于并矢格林函数和等效电磁表面电流的全矢量公式，研究了反射环境中电磁通信信道的空间自由度（NDoF）。信道相关特征值问题表征了电磁通信模式及其耦合强度，而主阶NDoF则在电大尺寸区域通过接收器可访问的相空间体积进行几何估计。通过结合两个几何投影雅可比行列式，相空间体积与互阴影面积相关联，建立了两种几何NDoF公式之间的等价性，从而得出两极化估计值等于互阴影面积的两倍除以波长平方。通过镜像构造和相空间射线追踪，将自由空间互阴影公式扩展到完美电导体（PEC）反射环境，考虑了镜面反射和几何可见性约束。该公式通过涉及平面PEC反射器、抛物面反射器、平行板波导和非视距L形走廊的全矢量电磁信道的特征值谱进行了验证。几何预测与涉及多重反射、聚焦和阻塞的配置中所观察到的光谱转变相一致。
AI.summary: 本文研究了反射环境中电磁通信信道的空间自由度（NDoF），通过结合几何投影雅可比行列式与相空间体积，建立了自由度与互阴影面积的等价关系，并将其扩展至完美电导体（PEC）反射环境。多种复杂配置下的验证表明，该几何预测能够准确反映多重反射、聚焦和阴影约束下的谱转换。
AI.keywords: 空间自由度, 电磁信道, 反射环境,  dyadic Green's functions, 相空间体积
AI.comments: 该论文利用基于并矢格林函数的全矢量公式和几何光学方法，研究了反射环境中电磁通信信道的空间自由度（NDoF），通过引入互阴影面积和相空间体积的概念，成功将几何估计扩展到包含PEC的复杂反射环境，具有较高的理论创新性和实用价值。

title: A Dual-Mode Protocol for Space-Time-Coding Metasurfaces in OFDM ISAC Systems
summary: Existing integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) frameworks assisted by space-time-coding metasurfaces (STCMs) rely on idealized surface models, which neglect the frequency-selective and angle-dependent response of the meta-atoms, and are typically limited to narrowband single-carrier communications. This paper addresses these limitations by developing a physics-based signal-processing framework for STCM-assisted ISAC systems employing wideband orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms, which accounts also for beam squint effects across the STCM aperture. On this basis, we propose a dual-mode protocol, in which the STCM operates as a time-varying surface during a short acquisition phase and as a conventional reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) during data transmission. In the acquisition phase, the angle of arrival (AoA) and the composite channel are jointly estimated by maximum likelihood from a single pilot OFDM symbol transmitted over a subset of active subcarriers, together with deliberately introduced virtual carriers; these estimates are then used to configure the RIS for data transmission. Numerical results validate the considered framework and quantify the gains achievable by the proposed dual-mode protocol.

AI.title_translation: 面向OFDM ISAC系统的空时编码超表面的双模协议
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于OFDM ISAC系统的空时编码超表面（STCM）的双模协议，解决了现有模型忽略频率选择性和角度依赖性以及仅限于窄带通信的问题。该协议在短时采集阶段使用时变表面估计到达角和复合信道，然后在数据传输阶段作为常规可重构智能表面（RIS）。数值结果表明该协议有效且有增益。
AI.motivation: 现有ISAC框架依赖于理想化的STCM模型，忽略了元原子的频率选择性和角度依赖性响应，并且通常仅限于窄带单载波通信。
AI.method: 提出一个基于物理的信号处理框架，用于STCM辅助的ISAC系统，采用宽带OFDM波形，并考虑了STCM孔径上的波束倾斜效应。在此基础上，提出一种双模协议，在采集阶段STCM作为时变表面，在数据传输阶段作为RIS。在采集阶段，通过最大似然估计联合估计到达角和复合信道，并利用这些估计来配置RIS用于数据传输。
AI.result: 数值结果验证了所考虑的框架，并量化了所提出的双模协议可实现的增益。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双模协议通过在采集阶段进行精确的信道和到达角估计，然后将这些信息用于数据传输阶段的RIS配置，有效地解决了现有STCM-ISAC系统的局限性，并在OFDM ISAC系统中实现了可观的性能增益。
AI.translation: 现有的由时空编码超表面（STCM）辅助的集成传感与通信（ISAC）框架依赖于理想化的表面模型，该模型忽略了元原子的频率选择性和角度依赖性响应，并且通常仅限于窄带单载波通信。本文通过为采用宽带正交频分复用（OFDM）波形的STCM辅助ISAC系统开发一个基于物理的信号处理框架来解决这些局限性，该框架还考虑了跨STCM孔径的波束倾斜效应。在此基础上，我们提出了一种双模协议，在该协议中，STCM在短时采集阶段充当一个时变表面，在数据传输阶段充当一个传统的可重构智能表面（RIS）。在采集阶段，联合通过最大似然法从通过部分有源子载波以及故意引入的虚拟载波传输的单个导频OFDM符号中估计到达角（AoA）和复合信道；然后，这些估计值用于配置RIS以进行数据传输。数值结果验证了所考虑的框架，并量化了所提出的双模协议可实现的增益。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个用于OFDM ISAC系统的双模协议，该协议基于物理的信号处理框架，解决了现有STCM-ISAC模型忽略频率选择性和角度依赖性以及仅限于窄带通信的局限性。该协议在采集阶段通过时变表面进行精确的到达角和信道估计，然后将这些信息用于配置RIS以优化数据传输阶段的性能。数值结果证明了该框架的有效性和所提出协议的性能增益。
AI.keywords: ISAC, STCM, OFDM, 双模协议, RIS
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的双模协议，用于解决现有STCM-ISAC系统中模型理想化和窄带限制的问题。通过引入一个明确的采集阶段来估计信道参数，并将其用于后续的数据传输阶段，该方法在理论上和实践中都具有潜力。然而，协议的复杂性、实际部署的挑战以及在不同环境下的鲁棒性仍需进一步研究。

title: A Spatial Clustering and Resource Allocation Approach for Critical Services in Massive MIMO-Enabled Cellular Networks
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: In this work, we address the challenge of providing quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees for critical real-time services in cellular networks where both real-time and non-real-time applications must be supported. Leveraging the spatial multiplexing capabilities of Massive Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) technology, we propose a joint clustering and resource allocation framework that limits network interference and enhances the ability to meet the QoS requirements of real-time services while still serving other applications. Our approach begins by clustering active users according to the direction of their channel vectors. Specifically, a downlink probing strategy is employed to group users whose channels lie in the same direction. Channel estimation and the derivation of the corresponding signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) are then performed based on this clustering. Subsequently, we formulate a resource allocation optimization problem across the user groups to satisfy the required QoS for critical real-time services while accommodating the remaining users. We rigorously prove that, in general, finding the global optimum of the resource allocation problem is NP-hard, and for a special case of the formulated problem, we establish a polynomial-time solvable algorithm based on linear programming. We then propose a suboptimal solution for the general problem using a linear relaxation technique. Simulation results are provided to confirm the effectiveness of our proposed approaches.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Communications

title: FR3-Band Capacitive-Piezoelectric Thin-Film LN Resonator for Heterogeneous Integration
summary: This letter presents a capacitively coupled piezoelectric lateral-field-excited bulk acoustic wave resonator (XBAR) in single-crystal lithium niobate (LN) for frequency range 3 (FR3, 7.125-24.25 GHz). We develop a platform that simultaneously maintains high electromechanical efficiency (\(k_t^2\)) and quality factor (\(Q\)) while alleviating challenges associated with parasitic galvanic interconnections and is fit for heterogeneous integration above integrated circuits. A 100 nm air gap excites the second-order symmetric Lamb wave (S2) mode in a 500 nm thick periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) LN from a fused silica substrate via flip-chip bonding, yielding a resonance frequency (\(f_s\)) of 7.16 GHz with an extracted \(k_t^2\) of 12.25\% and \(Q\) of 100, facilitating a high \(Q\cdot k_t^2\cdot f_s\) product of 87.71. The results demonstrate strong piezoelectric transduction through a nanoscale air gap, supporting further development of the platform for heterogeneous integration of compact, low-loss microwave components.

title: Passivity Correction of the Thermistor Model in Bolometric Power Sensors and Its Dependence on Bead Temperature
comments: 18 pages, 19 figures, 4 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: This paper closes a series of works on thermistor bolometric power sensors, coaxial and waveguide, by treating what the two have in common. The per-state transformation m introduced in the waveguide work, which corrects the thermistor impedances of the model in each bridge state so that the two-port of the mount is passive, is analyzed on the eleven sensors of the preceding papers: the corrections are a few tenths of a percent in the coaxial mounts and one to two percent in the waveguide mounts, follow one pattern within each family, and the hottest state is the one whose efficiency departs most from the others. The transformation is tested by an independent measurement: the substituted powers of the three states, read with the manufacturer's procedure against a leveled source whose reflection is obtained from the closure of three Apollonius circles, give efficiency ratios of 0.999 +/- 0.016 and 0.997 +/- 0.008 (k = 2), which contain the values at the passivity floor (0.996, 0.998) and exclude those of the first pass (0.941, 1.023). Three sensors were swept in the bridge resistance, 23 and 31 states, and a fourth is treated apart: the correction reduces to one constant per state, the parallel resistance of the bead, represented by a law with one term scaling with the bridge resistance and one exponential in the bead temperature, with one thermal coefficient per family. The same property explains why the cross-ratio of four measured reflection coefficients, invariant under any state-independent two-port, departs from that of the four bridge resistances.

title: A Microwave-Photonics Formulation of the Rydberg-Atom Receiver
summary: The performance of Rydberg-atom receivers is seldom stated as a radio-frequency (RF) link budget. The receiver is shown to be an intensity-modulated direct-detection analog optical link whose modulator is the laser-driven vapor. The transmission of a warm vapor is derived in closed form by averaging the four-level response over atomic velocities. The conversion gain, noise figure, bandwidth, intercept points, and spurious-free dynamic range follow from this one function. For a weak probe the instantaneous bandwidth is half the width of the transparency window in two-photon detuning. The local-oscillator beat places the second-order intercept near twice the local-oscillator field, so the local oscillator sets the even-order linearity. For a rubidium transition at 17.04 GHz the closed forms agree with a velocity-resolved density-matrix model to 1% for the slope and the intercepts and to 10% for the bandwidth. They underestimate the group delay by a third. The response is tied to atomic constants, and the sensing volume escapes the Chu limit. However, the noise figure of a warm vapor rules it out as a general replacement for an antenna and low-noise amplifier.

title: Emotion-Aware Prefix: Towards Explicit Emotion Control in Voice Conversion Models
summary: Recent advances in zero-shot voice conversion have exhibited potential in emotion control, yet the performance is suboptimal or inconsistent due to their limited expressive capacity. We propose Emotion-Aware Prefix for explicit emotion control in a two-stage voice conversion backbone. We significantly improve emotion conversion performance, doubling the baseline Emotion Conversion Accuracy (ECA) from 42.40% to 85.50% while maintaining linguistic integrity and speech quality, without compromising speaker identity. Our ablation study suggests that a joint control of both sequence modulation and acoustic realization is essential to synthesize distinct emotions. Furthermore, comparative analysis verifies the generalizability of proposed method, while it provides insights on the role of acoustic decoupling in maintaining speaker identity.

title: Unsupervised End-to-End Array Calibration for Multi-Target Integrated Sensing and Communication
comments: 16 pages, 12 figures, accepted at IEEE TWC
summary: In this work, we consider end-to-end calibration of an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) base station (BS) under gain-phase and antenna displacement impairments without collecting signals from predefined positions (labeled data). We consider a BS with two impaired uniform linear arrays used for simultaneous multi-target sensing and communication with a user equipment (UE) leveraging orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing signals. The main contribution is the design of a framework that can compensate for the impairments without labeled data and considering coherent receive signals. We harness a differentiable precoder based on the maximum array response in an angular direction at the transmitter and the orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm at the sensing receiver. We propose an ISAC loss as a combination of sensing and communication losses that provides a trade-off between the two functionalities. We compare two sensing objective alternatives: (i) maximize the maximum response of the angle-delay map of the targets or (ii) minimize the norm of the residual signal at the output of the OMP algorithm after all estimated targets have been removed. The communication objective maximizes the energy of the received signal at the UE. Additionally, our framework leverages an approximation of the channel gradient that avoids the impractical knowledge of the gradient of the channel. Our results show that the proposed method performs closely to using labeled data and knowledge of the channel gradient in terms of sensing position estimation and communication symbol error rate. When comparing the two sensing losses, minimizing the norm of the OMP residual yields significantly better sensing position estimation with slightly increased complexity.

title: Opportunistic Cooperative Sensing in mmWave ISAC Networks: A Meta-Distribution Analysis
comments: Submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: We propose an opportunistic cooperative sensing architecture for millimeter-wave (mmWave) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) networks that harvests bistatic echoes from already-active transmissions of neighboring base stations (BSs). Each target is sensed by its nearest BS, while neighboring BSs contribute only when their scheduled beams opportunistically illuminate the target. Cooperation requires neither beam reconfiguration nor dedicated air-interface resources and can leverage existing 5G transport and edge-computing infrastructure for synchronization and local echo processing. Using stochastic geometry, we characterize the sensing meta-distribution for cooperative ISAC, quantifying target-level reliability beyond spatial averages when multiple cooperative echoes are combined, while also analyzing sensing and communication coverage and ergodic rates. Results show that opportunistic cooperation substantially improves average sensing performance and target-level reliability. For instance, at a sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) threshold of 5 dB, increasing the maximum cooperative-cluster size from 1 to 6 raises the percentage of targets whose conditional sensing success probability exceeds 90% by over 55 percentage points. The results further reveal practical design tradeoffs in cluster sizing, BS densification, and sensing-communication energy allocation.

title: Set-Theoretic PAPR Reduction in Multi-Antenna Systems
comments: Submitted to IEEE WCNC 2027 for possible publication
summary: In this study, we propose an optimization framework for PAPR reduction in multi-antenna systems with beamforming. Unlike previous techniques, the proposed approach permits full control over the distorted symbol constellation via arbitrary (convex) constraints on the frequency domain symbols, while minimizing the PAPR at each individual transmit antenna. We propose an iterative algorithm based on an extrapolated alternating projection method, which relies on an iterative soft-thresholding subroutine to compute projections onto sublevel sets of the objective function, and we compare its performance to optimal solutions obtained with general-purpose convex solvers.

title: 20 GHz Longitudinal Surface Acoustic Wave Resonators in 100-nm X-Cut Lithium Niobate on Silicon Carbide
summary: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators above 15~GHz require a fast acoustic mode that retains strong electromechanical coupling ($k^2$). This work reports longitudinal SAW (L-SAW) resonators designed for high $k^2$ in 100-nm X-cut lithium niobate (LN) on 4H silicon carbide (SiC), operating up to 21.7~GHz and reaching a $k^2$ of 8.1\%, a maximum Bode $Q$ of 70, and a figure of merit (FoM) of 5.7 at 20.24~GHz. In this thin-film waveguide, shrinking the wavelength ($λ$) keeps the normalized LN thickness ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$) large, sustaining both $k^2$ and acoustic confinement. Conversely, increasing $λ$ from 292 to 471~nm lowers $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ from 0.34 to 0.21 and raises the L-SAW phase velocity from 6.32 to 7.05~km/s, within 1.1\% of the 7126-m/s shear-wave velocity of 4H-SiC. As the velocity approaches this limit, more of the acoustic energy spreads into the non-piezoelectric SiC, and $k^2$ falls from its 8.1\% peak at $λ= 322$~nm to 1.7\% at $λ= 471$~nm. No L-SAW resonance is observed for $λ\geq 518$~nm ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ\leq 0.19$), where the mode becomes leaky. Overall, the FoM stays within 5\% of its maximum for $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ between 0.26 to 0.31, defining a design window for L-SAW resonators in thin LN on SiC at K-band and beyond.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Deep Learning for Prediction of Radiation-Induced Xerostomia in Head and Neck Cancer
summary: To develop and evaluate an uncertainty-aware multimodal learning framework for predicting radiation-induced xerostomia in patients receiving head-and-neck cancer radiotherapy. We developed a Bidirectional Attention-enhanced Diffusion Transformer (BA-DiT) that combines self-supervised multimodal representation learning with supervised Bayesian fine-tuning. The model integrates pretreatment CT images and three-dimensional dose distributions, focusing on bilateral parotid glands while incorporating surrounding anatomical and dosimetric information. During pretraining, bidirectional cross-attention integrates anatomical and dosimetric features, while a latent Diffusion Transformer learns joint representations through diffusion-based learning, feature reconstruction, and contrastive alignment. Supervised fine-tuning employs a Bayesian classifier to predict individualized xerostomia risk and quantify predictive uncertainty, with a learnable label-transition model accounting for potential toxicity label uncertainty. BA-DiT was developed using four independent cohorts (Moffitt, Emory, MSHS, and TCIA) and evaluated against baseline and ablation models. Evaluation included predictive performance, calibration, uncertainty quantification, decision curve analysis, and patient-level case studies. In independent MSHS and Emory cohorts, BA-DiT achieved AUCs of 0.83 and 0.80, respectively, outperforming baseline models. Predictive uncertainty peaked near the decision boundary, with aleatoric uncertainty being the predominant component. Uncertainty-based selective prediction generally improved net benefit among retained patients, with greater gains at lower prediction coverage. BA-DiT enables individualized xerostomia risk prediction while providing complementary uncertainty estimates, potentially supporting informed clinical decision-making and personalized toxicity management.

title: A Deep Zero-Inflated Model of North Atlantic Right Whale Presence To Support Blue Economy Management
summary: Effective modeling of endangered marine mammal species, such as the North Atlantic Right Whale, is critical for balancing marine conservation with the growing blue economy. Passive acoustic monitoring data collected by autonomous underwater vehicles provide new opportunities for localized marine species detection and oceanographic sensing, but introduce complex statistical challenges such as zero inflation, imperfect detection, and intricate dependence structures. In response, we propose the Deep Zero-Inflated Bernoulli (DeepZIB) model, a deep statistical method which jointly models latent species presence and conditional detection probabilities while learning complex habitat relationships from heterogeneous covariate information. We establish theoretical results on the model's structural properties and conduct simulation experiments to demonstrate its ability to recover underlying parameters and latent presence fields. Application to real-world passive acoustic monitoring data on the North Atlantic Right Whale along the U.S. East Coast demonstrates improved model adequacy and predictive performance in capturing the species' dynamic and spatially varying habitat. We demonstrate DeepZIB's ability to generate high-resolution, spatially and temporally varying presence maps, providing valuable insights for targeted and risk-aware management of blue economy industries, ranging from offshore and marine energy, to fisheries management and maritime transport

AI.title_translation: 支持蓝色经济管理的北大西洋露脊鲸存在的深度零膨胀模型
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种名为DeepZIB的深度统计模型，用于分析北大西洋露脊鲸的声学监测数据，生成高分辨率存在图，以支持海洋经济和保护管理。
AI.motivation: 为了平衡海洋保护与不断增长的蓝色经济，需要对濒危海洋哺乳动物（如北大西洋露脊鲸）进行有效建模。然而，自主水下航行器收集的被动声学监测数据带来了零膨胀、不完美探测和复杂依赖结构等统计挑战。

title: Uncovering Multimorbidity Patterns Through a Novel Randomized Clustering Algorithm
summary: Patients with several chronic conditions rarely share the same combination: in four years of the nationally representative Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS), we find 32,789 distinct combinations of two to seven conditions, and over 90% of those involving four or more occur in a single patient. Methods that search for common combinations discard most of this heterogeneity. We present the Randomized Length Sequential Clustering Algorithm (RLSCA), which links diseases by lift, a pairwise association measure counted only above a user-set support threshold. A mixed-integer program repeatedly selects and removes the group of conditions with the greatest internal lift, up to a random size; 100 iterations yield a database of clusters scored by size, rediscovery frequency, and body systems spanned. In MEPS 2019, stratified by age and sex, RLSCA recovers known groupings at a high threshold, such as diabetes with lipid disorders and hypertension, and at a lower threshold returns clusters of up to eight conditions spanning five body systems. Frequent itemset mining, at its lowest feasible support, finds no set above five conditions; hierarchical clustering cannot control cluster size. With a clinical large language model, the database could suggest which further conditions a patient is at risk of.

AI.title_translation: 通过新型随机聚类算法揭示多病共存模式
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种名为RLSCA的新型随机聚类算法，能有效克服传统方法的局限性，从高度异质性的慢性病数据中挖掘并评分复杂的疾病共存模式。
AI.motivation: 传统寻找常见疾病组合的方法会丢弃慢性病数据中绝大部分的异质性，而现有的频繁项集挖掘和层次聚类方法在处理复杂多病共存时存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了随机长度序列聚类算法（RLSCA），通过提升度（lift）链接疾病，利用混合整数规划反复选择和移除内部提升度最大的条件组，并通过多次迭代构建并评分聚类数据库。
AI.result: 在MEPS 2019数据集中，RLSCA在高阈值下恢复了已知的疾病组合（如糖尿病、血脂异常和高血压），在低阈值下返回了跨越5个身体系统多达8种条件的聚类，表现优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: RLSCA算法能够成功揭示复杂的慢性病共病模式，在处理高度异质性医学数据方面优于传统方法。
AI.translation: 患有多种慢性疾病的患者很少有完全相同的组合：在具有全国代表性的医疗支出小组调查（MEPS）的四年数据中，我们发现了32789种不同的2到7种疾病组合，其中涉及4种或更多疾病的组合有90%以上只出现在单个患者身上。寻找常见组合的方法丢弃了大部分这种异质性。我们提出了随机长度序列聚类算法（RLSCA），它通过提升度（一种仅在用户设定的支持度阈值以上计算的成对关联度量）将疾病联系起来。混合整数规划重复选择和移除具有最大内部提升度的条件组，达到随机大小；100次迭代产生了一个按大小、重新发现频率和跨越的身体系统进行评分的数据库。在按年龄和性别分层的MEPS 2019中，RLSCA在高阈值下恢复了已知的组合（如糖尿病伴血脂异常和高血压），在较低阈值下返回了跨越5个身体系统的多达8种条件的聚类。频繁项集挖掘在其最低可行支持度下，找不到任何超过5个条件的集合；层次聚类无法控制聚类大小。结合临床大型语言模型，该数据库可以提示患者面临哪些进一步的疾病风险。
AI.summary: 本文针对慢性病多病共存高度异质性的问题，开发了一种名为RLSCA的新型随机聚类算法。该算法结合混合整数规划与提升度度量，能有效识别并评分复杂的疾病聚类模式，优于传统的频繁项集挖掘和层次聚类方法。
AI.keywords: 多病共存, 随机聚类算法, 混合整数规划, 医疗支出小组调查, 疾病关联
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的随机聚类算法（RLSCA），能够有效处理慢性病多病共存（multimorbidity）中高度异质性的数据，克服了传统频繁项集挖掘和层次聚类算法的局限性，对临床疾病预测具有重要价值。

title: Beware of complexity bias: A hindrance to conceptual model generalization and interpretability
summary: In the field of rainfall-runoff modeling, lumped conceptual models have been shown to be powerful representations of catchment filtering functions. They demonstrate fairly strong predictive performance in gauged catchments and have the ability to learn important intermediate latent variables and flow paths which increases their value as interpretable models. During calibration, these conceptual models may fit streamflow just as well as deep learning models, however, their performance often sharply degrades after deployment, suggesting the presence of overfitting. We hypothesize that complexity (or flexibility) bias is one of the causes of such overfitting. Complexity bias can appear within conceptual models when the number of effective degrees of freedom is parameter or flow path dependent. Using a popular conceptual model and a series of synthetic datasets, we illustrate the presence of complexity bias and demonstrate its impact on model interpretability/parameter inference. Then, using real rainfall-runoff data from CAMELS-US, we investigate if overfitting can be reduced by adding regularization terms that prevent complexity bias from forming. Our results suggest that conceptual and hybrid modeling can be further improved if hydrologists become aware of this pervasive bias.

AI.title_translation: 警惕复杂度偏差：概念模型泛化与可解释性的绊脚石
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了降雨-径流概念模型中存在的“复杂度偏差”是导致模型过拟合和可解释性下降的重要原因，并证明了通过正则化减轻这种偏差可以改善模型性能。
AI.motivation: 在降雨-径流建模中，集中式概念模型虽然表现出较强的预测性能和可解释性，但在部署后性能往往急剧下降，暗示存在过拟合现象。作者假设有效自由度随参数或流径变化的复杂度偏差是导致这种过拟合的原因之一。
AI.method: 使用一个流行的概念模型和一系列合成数据集来阐明复杂度偏差的存在及其对模型可解释性和参数推断的影响；随后利用 CAMELS-US 的真实降雨-径流数据，研究通过添加防止复杂度偏差形成的正则化项是否能减少过拟合。
AI.result: 研究证实了复杂度偏差的存在及其对模型可解释性和参数推断的负面影响，并且结果表明，通过添加能防止复杂度偏差形成的正则化项，可以有效减少过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 概念模型和混合建模可以通过意识到并应对复杂度偏差得到进一步改善，从而提升模型的泛化能力与可解释性。
AI.translation: 在降雨-径流建模领域，集中式概念模型已被证明是流域过滤功能的强大表征。它们在有实测资料的流域中表现出相当强的预测性能，并具有学习重要中间潜在变量和流径的能力，这增加了它们作为可解释模型的价值。在率定过程中，这些概念模型对径流的拟合效果可能与深度学习模型一样好，然而，它们的性能在部署后往往急剧下降，这表明存在过拟合现象。我们假设复杂度（或灵活性）偏差是导致这种过拟合的原因之一。当有效自由度取决于参数或流径时，复杂度偏差就会出现在概念模型中。通过使用一个流行的概念模型和一系列合成数据集，我们说明了复杂度偏差的存在，并证明了其对模型可解释性/参数推断的影响。然后，利用来自 CAMELS-US 的真实降雨-径流数据，我们研究了通过添加防止复杂度偏差形成的正则化项是否可以减少过拟合。我们的研究结果表明，如果水文学家意识到这种普遍存在的偏差，概念建模和混合建模可以得到进一步改善。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了降雨-径流建模中集中式概念模型的复杂度偏差问题。通过合成数据集和真实数据（CAMELS-US），研究表明参数或流径依赖的自由度会导致复杂度偏差和过拟合，而引入相应的正则化项可以缓解这一问题，从而提高模型的泛化能力和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 降雨-径流建模, 概念模型, 复杂度偏差, 模型泛化, 可解释性
AI.comments: 本文指出了水文概念模型中容易被忽视的“复杂度偏差”，揭示了其对模型泛化能力和可解释性的负面影响，并提出了通过正则化来缓解过拟合的思路，对概念模型和混合建模的发展具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: Statistical and Machine Learning Approaches for Estimating Visitation to Natural Spaces in the UK
summary: Natural spaces support health and well-being, but increasing recreational use can put pressure on ecologically sensitive sites. Understanding when, where and why people visit is important for planning, site management and evaluating interventions. Building on work by the Office for National Statistics, we developed statistical and machine learning models to predict visitor numbers at points located in natural spaces. We trained on automated people counter data across a range of green and blue spaces in England and Wales and tested the models' ability to generalise to unseen counter locations. Our models offer a scalable approach for predicting visitor numbers in natural spaces, reducing reliance on surveys and physical counters.

AI.title_translation: 英国自然空间访客估计的统计与机器学习方法
AI.tldr: 本研究开发了基于统计和机器学习的模型，利用自动化计数器数据来预测英国自然空间的访客数量，从而提供了一种高效且可扩展的管理规划工具。
AI.motivation: 自然空间对健康和福祉至关重要，但日益增加的休闲使用给生态敏感场地带来了压力；了解人们何时、何地以及为何造访对于规划、场地管理和评估干预措施至关重要。
AI.method: 基于英国国家统计局（Office for National Statistics）先前的工作，研究人员利用英格兰和威尔士各类绿地和蓝地中自动计数器的数据，开发并训练了统计模型与机器学习模型，并测试了模型对未见过的计数器地点的泛化能力。
AI.result: 成功开发了可预测自然空间中特定点访客数量的统计和机器学习模型，并具备在未知计数器地点进行良好泛化的能力，提供了一种可扩展的访客预测方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究所开发的模型提供了一种可扩展的预测自然空间访客数量的方法，减少了对昂贵且繁琐的调查及物理计数器的依赖，对未来的自然空间管理和规划具有重要价值。
AI.translation: 自然空间支持健康和福祉，但不断增加的休闲使用可能会对生态敏感的场地造成压力。了解人们何时、何地以及为何造访对于规划、场地管理和评估干预措施非常重要。在英国国家统计局（Office for National Statistics）工作的基础上，我们开发了统计和机器学习模型，用于预测自然空间中特定地点的访客数量。我们利用英格兰和威尔士各种绿地和蓝地的自动化人们计数器数据进行了模型训练，并测试了模型对未见过计数器地点的泛化能力。我们的模型为预测自然空间访客数量提供了一种可扩展的方法，减少了对调查和物理计数器的依赖。
AI.summary: 本文利用英国英格兰和威尔士自然空间中自动计数器的数据，开发了能够预测访客数量的统计与机器学习模型，并通过测试验证了其在未知地点的泛化能力，为自然空间的管理和规划提供了一种可扩展的预测方案。
AI.keywords: 自然空间, 访客预测, 机器学习, 统计模型, 英国
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了统计学和机器学习方法，利用自动化计数器数据来预测英国自然空间的访客数量。这对于平衡生态保护与公众健康具有重要意义，减少了对传统调查和物理计数器的依赖。

title: Synthetic Surrogate Functional Regression (SSFR): A Robust Framework for Estimating Spatially Varying Covariate Effects in Surrogate-Augmented Neuroimaging
comments: 72 pages (24 pages main text, 48 pages supplementary material)
summary: Relating demographic, clinical, and genetic covariates to high-dimensional imaging outcomes is a core problem in brain imaging, especially when the target modality is observed for only a subset of participants. Generative models can synthesize missing modalities from auxiliary data, but using synthetic images in regression requires care to ensure valid inference. We propose a two-stage Synthetic Surrogate Functional Regression (SSFR) framework for spatially varying covariate effects under partially observed imaging outcomes. By calibrating surrogate information against observed target images, SSFR improves efficiency while remaining robust to discrepancies between the surrogate and target regression functions. We establish consistency and the convergence rate of the estimator, and show that first-stage surrogate-model estimation error does not alter its asymptotic rate. We introduce a voxelwise surrogate explanatory measure $R^2(z)$, the fraction of residual target-image variation explained by a candidate surrogate; with the observation rate, it gives a principled criterion for surrogate screening and indicates the potential efficiency gain. We further develop a weighted bootstrap procedure for simultaneous confidence corridors (SCCs). As surrogate informativeness increases, SCC widths approach those obtained under complete observation, improving localization of significant effects that cannot be identified from the observed data alone. Simulations confirm accuracy and robustness under surrogate misspecification and with surrogates generated by image-to-image neural networks. Applied to spatially normalized PET images from ADNI, SSFR yields interpretable coefficient maps and uniformly narrower SCCs than an analysis using observed PET alone, enlarging the region over which age-related metabolic decline is simultaneously significant.
comment: 72 pages (24 pages main text, 48 pages supplementary material)

AI.title_translation: 合成代理泛函回归（SSFR）：代理增强神经影像中估计空间变异协变量效应的稳健框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SSFR的两阶段回归框架，能够在神经影像数据部分缺失时，安全且高效地利用生成式代理图像来估计空间变异协变量效应，并通过理论和实验证明了其稳健性与优越性。
AI.motivation: 在脑成像研究中，目标模态通常只在部分参与者中被观察到。虽然生成模型可以从辅助数据合成缺失模态，但在回归中使用合成图像需要谨慎以确保有效推断，因此需要一个既能利用合成代理数据提高效率、又能对代理偏差保持稳健的统计回归框架。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段的合成代理泛函回归（SSFR）框架，通过校准代理信息与观测到的目标图像来提高效率并保持稳健性；引入了体素级代理解释度量$R^2(z)$进行代理筛选；开发了用于同时置信走廊（SCCs）的加权自助法。
AI.result: 理论上证明了估计量的一致性和收敛速度，且第一阶段代理模型估计误差不改变渐近速率。模拟和对ADNI数据集PET图像的应用表明，SSFR能够产生稳健且可解释的系数图，提供比仅使用观测数据时更窄的同时置信走廊，从而扩大了显著效应的识别区域。
AI.conclusion: SSFR框架成功实现了在部分观测神经影像数据下稳健且高效的空间变异协变量效应估计，通过理论与实证分析验证了其在ADNI数据集上的优越性能。
AI.translation: 将人口统计学、临床和遗传学协变量与高维影像结果相关联是脑 imaging 的核心问题，尤其是当目标模态仅在部分参与者中被观察到时。生成模型可以从辅助数据中合成缺失模态，但在回归中使用合成图像需要谨慎以确保有效的推断。我们针对部分观测影像结果下的空间变异协变量效应，提出了一个两阶段的合成代理泛函回归（SSFR）框架。通过将代理信息与观测到的目标图像进行校准，SSFR 在保持对代理与目标回归函数之间差异的稳健性的同时，提高了效率。我们确立了估计量的一致性和收敛速度，并表明第一阶段代理模型估计误差不会改变其渐近速度。我们引入了体素级代理解释测度 $R^2(z)$（由候选代理解释的残差目标图像变异的分数），结合观测率，它为代理筛选提供了原则性标准并指示了潜在的效率增益。我们进一步开发了一种用于同时置信走廊（SCCs）的加权自助法。随着代理信息量的增加，SCC 的宽度接近于完全观测下获得的宽度，从而改善了无法仅从观测数据中识别的显著效应的定位。模拟证实了在代理错误指定以及由图像到图像神经网络生成的代理下的准确性和稳健性。应用于 ADNI 的空间标准化 PET 图像时，SSFR 产生了可解释的系数图，并且比单独使用观测 PET 的分析具有更均匀狭窄的 SCC，从而扩大了年龄相关代谢下降同时显著的区域。
AI.summary: 本文提出了合成代理泛函回归（SSFR）框架，用于解决神经影像学中目标模态部分缺失时的空间变异协变量效应估计问题。该方法通过将代理信息与观测目标图像进行校准，在对代理误设保持稳健的同时提高了估计效率，并通过理论证明、模拟实验以及在ADNI数据集上的应用验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: Functional Regression, Neuroimaging, Surrogate Modeling, Spatially Varying Effects, Simultaneous Confidence Corridors
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的SSFR框架，巧妙地解决了神经影像学中部分模态缺失时使用生成式代理图像进行回归分析的有效性和稳健性问题。理论上证明了第一阶段估计误差不影响渐近收敛率，并引入了新型的$R^2(z)$度量标准，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用前景。

title: The Science and Mythology of Sports Rankings: Evaluating the methods, assumptions, and attributes used to rank NCAA teams
summary: Selecting a sports-ranking system is not a purely mathematical decision. It also requires agreement about what the ranking should mean and what institutional purpose it should serve. This paper distinguishes four related but different tasks in sports ranking: prediction, retrospective evaluation, championship selection, and seeding; compares the governing philosophies of major ranking families; and identifies recurring errors in ranking debates. A descriptive comparison of nine NCAA Division I sport settings illustrates how schedule density, scoring environment, cross-conference connectivity, head-to-head meetings, and common-opponent availability vary from sport to sport. The central premise is that no ranking methodology is value-free. Every system reflects choices about evidence, competitive merit, and which tradeoffs are acceptable. The paper therefore offers a structured, multi-objective framework for evaluating ranking systems according to their intended purpose/goal rather than naming one universally superior method. Its principal contribution is to make the philosophical and institutional assumptions behind ranking decisions explicit, comparable, and testable.

AI.title_translation: 体育排名的科学与迷思：评估用于对NCAA球队进行排名的方、假设与属性
AI.tldr: 体育排名没有单一的完美数学方法；本文通过一个多目标框架，揭示并评估了NCAA球队排名背后的哲学与体制假设。
AI.motivation: 选择体育排名系统不仅是一个纯粹的数学决策，还涉及对排名含义及体制目的的共识；由于没有哪个排名方法是价值中立的，因此需要明确、比较和测试排名决策背后的哲学与体制假设。
AI.method: 区分了体育排名的四种不同任务；比较了主要排名家族的管理哲学；识别了排名争论中的常见错误；通过对九个NCAA第一级别运动项目的描述性比较，说明了不同运动在赛程密度、得分环境、跨区连接等方面的差异；并提出了一个用于评估排名系统的结构化多目标框架。
AI.result: 论文表明，每种排名系统都反映了关于证据、竞争优势以及可接受权衡的选择；通过九个NCAA运动项目的对比，展示了不同运动环境如何影响排名方法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 不存在一个普遍意义上最优的排名方法，体育排名系统的评估必须结合其特定的应用目标、哲学假设以及各项运动的结构性特征来进行。
AI.translation: 选择一个体育排名系统不仅仅是一个纯粹的数学决策。它还需要就排名的含义以及应服务的体制目的达成一致。本文区分了体育排名中四个相关但不同的任务：预测、回顾性评估、冠军选择和种子排位；比较了主要排名家族的管理哲学；并指出了排名争论中反复出现的错误。对九个NCAA第一级别（Division I）运动环境的描述性比较表明，赛程密度、得分环境、跨联盟连通性、直接交锋和共同对手的可获得性在不同运动中如何变化。核心前提是没有任何排名方法是价值中立的。每个系统都反映了关于证据、竞争优势以及哪些权衡是可以接受的选择。因此，本文提供了一个结构化的多目标框架，根据排名系统的预期目的/目标来评估它们，而不是指定一种普遍优越的方法。其主要贡献是使排名决策背后的哲学和体制假设变得明确、可比较和可测试。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了NCAA球队排名系统的科学性与迷思，指出排名决策并非纯粹的数学问题，而是包含价值选择与体制目的。作者区分了排名的四种任务，比较了不同的排名哲学，分析了九个NCAA运动项目的差异，并提出一个多目标框架，旨在使排名决策背后的假设显性化、可比较和可测试。
AI.keywords: NCAA, 体育排名系统, 评估方法, 哲学假设, 多目标框架
AI.comments: 本文跳出单纯的数学算法争论，从哲学和体制层面剖析了体育排名的本质，指出不存在放之四海皆准的最优排名法，强调必须根据具体目标和运动特性来评估排名系统，具有很高的理论价值和现实指导意义。

title: Multi-scale dynamic latent space models improve inference for a social predator
summary: Social networks are dynamic in nature. Examining changes in dynamic networks provides insights into the drivers and consequences of social interactions. Dynamic latent space models (DLSMs) quantify social tie strength through a distance measure between latent positions in an unobservable, low-dimensional space. Conditional on the latent positions, ties are assumed independent, and temporal dynamics are introduced through autocorrelated trajectories. These trajectories are typically modeled as random walks; however, random walks lack the mechanism to characterize network clustering, where individuals from the same group tend to form stronger ties than those across groups. Therefore, we extend the framework of DLSM to distinguish within-group dynamics from between-group dynamics. Our approach employs coupled movement models operating at two scales in the latent space to encode community structure using autoregressive processes with attraction. Through simulation studies, we show that when cluster separation is high, our framework improves coverage of linear predictors and enhances overall model fit relative to a naive DLSM. When cluster separation is moderate, performance remains comparable to that of the naive approach. In addition, our method demonstrates empirical computational advantages over the naive DLSM, with potential for further efficiency gains. We apply our framework to a case study of gray wolf (Canis lupus) interactions over three decades in Yellowstone National Park, where it provides improved model performance and novel insights into wolf social dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 多尺度动态潜在空间模型改善了对社会捕食者的推断
AI.tldr: 提出了一种多尺度动态潜在空间模型，通过耦合移动机制更好地刻画社会网络中的群落结构与动力学。
AI.motivation: 传统的动态潜在空间模型（DLSM）通常使用随机游走来模拟时间动态，但随机游走缺乏刻画网络聚类（即同组个体比跨组合个体形成更强联系）的机制。
AI.method: 扩展了动态潜在空间模型（DLSM），采用在潜在空间中以两个尺度运行的耦合移动模型，利用带有吸引力的自回归过程来编码群落结构，从而区分群内动态与群间动态。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，在高群落分离度下，该框架提高了线性预测因子的覆盖率并增强了整体模型拟合；在中等分离度下性能与传统方法相当，且具有经验上的计算优势。应用于黄石国家公园灰狼的案例研究验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度动态潜在空间模型通过引入双尺度耦合移动机制，有效刻画了社会网络中的群落结构，提高了推断精度和模型拟合优度，并在灰狼社会动力学研究中得到了成功应用。
AI.translation: 社会网络本质上是动态的。检查动态网络的变化可以深入了解社会互动的驱动因素和后果。动态潜在空间模型（DLSMs）通过不可观测的低维空间中潜在位置之间的距离度量来量化社会联系强度。在条件于潜在位置的情况下，联系被假设为独立的，时间动态则通过自相关轨迹引入。这些轨迹通常被建模为随机游走；然而，随机游走缺乏表征网络聚类的机制，即同一群体的个体往往比跨群体个体形成更强的联系。因此，我们扩展了DLSM的框架，以区分群内动态和群间动态。我们的方法采用在潜在空间中以两个尺度运行的耦合移动模型，使用带有吸引力的自回归过程来编码群落结构。通过模拟研究，我们表明当聚类分离度较高时，我们的框架改善了线性预测因子的覆盖率，并相对于朴素的DLSM增强了整体模型拟合。当聚类分离度适中时，性能与朴素方法保持相当。此外，我们的方法在经验上表现出优于朴素DLSM的计算优势，并具有进一步提高效率的潜力。我们将我们的框架应用於黄石国家公园灰狼（Canis lupus）三十年来互动的案例研究中，它提供了改进的模型性能和关于狼社会动力学的新见解。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种多尺度动态潜在空间模型，通过在潜在空间中引入双尺度耦合移动机制来编码群落结构，克服了传统随机游走无法刻画网络聚类的缺点，提升了社会网络推断的准确性和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 动态社会网络, 潜在空间模型, 多尺度移动模型, 群落结构, 灰狼社会动力学
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多尺度动态潜在空间模型引入社会网络分析中，通过耦合移动模型在潜在空间中编码群落结构，有效解决了传统随机游走模型无法刻画网络聚类的缺陷，对理解野生动物社会动态具有重要方法论价值。

title: Combining Past Experimental Data for Efficient Estimation: A Shrinkage Approach
summary: Firms routinely conduct randomized experiments, creating archives that could improve treatment-effect estimation in new experiments. However, past experiments evaluate related but different interventions, so their estimates may be biased for the current target. We study when and how borrowing from multiple auxiliary experiments can reduce the mean squared error (MSE) of a single treatment-effect estimate. In the oracle case, when biases and variances are known, borrowing from even one biased experiment strictly reduces MSE. In practice, we propose three shrinkage estimators and characterize their asymptotic MSE as the number of auxiliary experiments grows. Our analysis shows that average auxiliary bias and cross-study bias dispersion affect the relative performance of these estimators. As expected, smaller average bias magnitude generally improves performance. Surprisingly, bias dispersion can both benefit and harm our first estimator, the general plug-in estimator. On one hand, a more dispersed bias allows flexibility in cancelling the bias. On the other hand, the bias cancellation is imperfect as we only have an estimate of the bias, leading to overfitting. Motivated by this tradeoff, we propose a pooled plug-in estimator that restricts study-specific reweighting to limit this overfitting. However, both plug-in estimators can perform poorly when average bias is large. To address this, we develop a fixed-weight estimator with a hypothesis-testing gate that borrows only when the aggregate auxiliary mean is not significantly different from the target mean. Simulations illustrate the relative strengths of these estimators across bias environments and the relevance of the limiting analysis for finite collections of experiments. We also provide managerial guidance on which shrinkage estimator to use based on average bias and bias dispersion.

title: Extreme Value Inference with Measurement Error: Application to Earthquake Magnitudes
summary: Extreme value analyses typically assume that observations are measured without error, yet many environmental measurements are subject to different levels of observational uncertainty depending on the context. Ignoring such measurement error can distort inference on the tail behaviour. In this paper, we focus on peaks-over-threshold models, where exceedances above a high threshold are typically modelled using the generalised Pareto distribution (GPD). We develop a statistical framework for extreme value inference when observations are noisy measurements of an underlying true variable. Measurement error introduces a particular challenge in threshold-based extreme value analysis, as latent exceedances may be observed below the threshold, while latent non-exceedances may be observed above it. To address this problem, we represent the latent distribution using a hybrid body--tail specification, combining a flexible nonparametric body with a GPD tail. We develop a computationally efficient partially censored likelihood inference approach for data of this structure. The framework allows the measurement error scale and the GPD parameters to depend on covariates. Simulation studies demonstrate biases on the tail inference from ignoring measurement error and that our approach overcomes such impacts. The methodology is motivated by, and illustrated using, the catalogue of induced earthquake magnitudes from the Groningen, Netherlands, one of the largest gas fields in the world.

title: Explicational statistics: research for an AI age
summary: AI is dramatically changing the statistical research landscape. I argue that production of a distinct category of statistical knowledge, which I refer to as explicational statistics, is actually becoming more valuable as AI increasingly automates other parts of the research process. I define explicational statistics, contextualize it in terms of other forms of statistical knowledge, and explain why I think the rise of AI makes it more valuable. I demonstrate my framework by first developing a new dimension reduction method, Ambient Embedding Projection, that can simultaneously visualize the intrinsic geometry of a data manifold along with how that manifold is embedded into ambient space. I then use my new method to conceive of a new statistical property of a collection of manifolds, related to metric distortion, that in single-cell biology can capture the ensemble behavior of cell populations. I apply these ideas to single-nuclei RNA-seq data from the brains of mice from different behavioral conditions to reveal potential cellular mechanisms of chronic social defeat stress.

title: Trajectory-based cycle-level pedestrian crash prediction at intersections: A novel non-linear link function for block maxima led Bayesian GEV framework addressing heterogeneous traffic conditions
summary: This study develops a cycle-level framework for estimating pedestrian crash risk at signalized intersections under heterogeneous, non-lane-based traffic. Existing approaches often assume linear relationships between covariates and parameters, oversimplifying the complex, non-monotonic interactions among motorized vehicles (MVs), non-motorized vehicles (NMVs), and pedestrians. To address this limitation, the framework introduces a non-linear link function within a Bayesian generalized extreme value (GEV) structure to capture how traffic effects vary. It applies extreme value theory through the block maxima approach using post-encroachment time as a surrogate safety measure, with each signal cycle serving as an analysis block. It also proposes a behaviour-normalized modified crash risk (MRC) metric to account for pedestrians' habitual risk-taking behaviour in Dhaka's mixed traffic. Seven hierarchical Bayesian models were estimated using Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulation and compared using the deviance information criterion. Models with a non-linear link function only in the GEV location parameter fit the data better than their linear counterparts. Results suggest pedestrian speed is negatively associated with crash risk, while flow and speed of MVs, pedestrian flow, and NMV conflicting speed show positive associations, though all remain uncertain. The selected model's MRC estimate was close to the observed crashes at a 93% confidence level tuned to this dataset. These results suggest that the non-linear structure adds flexibility for capturing the non-stationary and non-linear nature of traffic extremes. This framework is a step towards proactive identification of pedestrian crash risk and after wider validation, it could support adaptive signal control and safety interventions in mixed-traffic environments.

title: Towards Fair Comparisons of AI- and Physics-Based Weather Models for Extreme Events via the Weighted Potential CRPS
summary: We study whether deterministic AI weather prediction (AIWP) models issue more informative forecasts for extreme weather events than deterministic numerical weather prediction (NWP) models. The deterministic model output is subjected to statistical post-processing via isotonic distributional regression (IDR), or EasyUQ, before the resulting probabilistic forecasts are assessed using weighted versions of the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS). This extends the recently proposed Potential CRPS (PCRPS) measure to focus on extreme outcomes. Since IDR exhibits optimality properties with respect to weighted versions of the CRPS, the proposed approach inherits desirable properties of the PCRPS, and, in particular, facilitates fair comparisons between data-driven and physics-based models when forecasting extreme weather events. We apply this evaluation framework to forecasts in the WeatherBench 2 dataset issued by the AIWP models GraphCast, Pangu-Weather, and FuXi, with the ECMWF's high-resolution NWP model serving as a physics-based reference. The forecast models are compared when predicting mean sea level pressure, temperature, wind speed, and precipitation extremes, defined as exceedances or non-exceedances of thresholds obtained from historical observation data. Across a range of extreme-event thresholds, including thresholds corresponding to record-breaking events, the ranking of the forecast models remains largely unchanged. We find that AIWP models, particularly GraphCast and FuXi, result in the most informative forecasts for extreme weather events across most settings, suggesting that AIWP models have the potential to outperform NWP models when forecasting extremes.

title: Forecast combination under temporal constraints: An application to day-ahead electricity prices
summary: Day-ahead electricity prices are forecast by many competing models and at several temporal granularities, from hourly prices to block and baseload products. The resulting forecasts suffer from two distinct problems: forecasts produced at different granularities are incoherent, as the aggregates do not match the averages of their components, and no single model is the most accurate in every market, period and level. We address both problems in one step by applying the coherent forecast combination framework, recently proposed for linearly constrained multiple time series, to temporal hierarchies. The resulting temporal coherent combination pools the forecasts that the competing experts produce at all the levels of the hierarchy into a single forecast that satisfies the aggregation constraints and has minimum error variance among the linear unbiased combinations. Since the optimal solution depends on a high-dimensional error covariance matrix, we compare different estimators obtained by crossing correlation structures with linear and nonlinear shrinkage approaches, and we contrast the simultaneous solution with sequential strategies. Using the base forecasts of four model classes for the German and Spanish day-ahead markets, the combined forecasts significantly outperform the base forecasts at every temporal level and are never significantly less accurate than the best reconciled expert, often improving upon it significantly.

title: A Bayesian Distance-Weighted Ising Model for Task-Related Regional Analysis of Neuroimaging Data
summary: Neuroimaging analysis commonly involves identifying task-relevant brain regions and examining functional connectivity. These objectives are typically addressed separately, without a model-based framework. We propose a Bayesian distance-weighted Ising model that jointly quantifies regional importance for task-label prediction and functional connectivity between brain regions. The Ising model favors agreement between interacting labels. We extend it with region-specific interaction parameters and weights based on distances between functional signals. The parameters quantify regional importance for distinguishing tasks, while the weights measure functional connectivity through signal similarity between regions. Inference for this model is challenging because the signals may be observed on unequal time grids and the likelihood function contains an intractable normalizing constant. To address this, we use a basis expansion and an auxiliary variable Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm. We apply the method to functional near-infrared spectroscopy data from younger and older adults, comparing resting-state and task-related activity. The model reveals age-dependent patterns of regional importance and connectivity. Among younger adults, the left orbitofrontal cortex contributes more strongly to task discrimination than the dorsolateral prefrontal and frontopolar cortices, whereas regional differences are less evident among older adults. Older adults also exhibit greater bilateral connectivity between corresponding regions, consistent with reduced hemispheric lateralization.

title: Efficient and Debiased Learning of Average Hazard Under Non-Proportional Hazards
comments: Main paper: 24 pages and 2 figures; Reference and Supplement: 22 pages and 8 Figures
summary: The hazard ratio from the Cox proportional hazards model is a ubiquitous summary of treatment effect. However, when hazards are non-proportional, the hazard ratio can lose a stable causal interpretation and become study-dependent because it effectively averages time-varying effects with weights determined by follow-up and censoring. We consider the average hazard (AH) as an alternative causal estimand: a population-level person-time event rate that remains well-defined and interpretable without assuming proportional hazards. Although AH can be estimated nonparametrically and regression-style adjustments have been proposed, existing approaches do not provide a general framework for flexible, high-dimensional nuisance estimation with valid sqrt{n} inference. We address this gap by developing a semiparametric, doubly robust framework for covariate-adjusted AH. We establish pathwise differentiability of AH in the nonparametric model, derive its efficient influence function, and construct cross-fitted, debiased estimators that leverage machine learning for nuisance estimation while retaining asymptotically normal, sqrt{n}-consistent inference under mild product-rate conditions. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed estimator achieves small bias and near-nominal confidence-interval coverage across proportional and non-proportional hazards settings, including crossing-hazards regimes where Cox-based summaries can be unstable. We illustrate practical utility in comparative effectiveness research by comparing immunotherapy regimens for advanced melanoma using SEER-Medicare linked data.

title: Error analysis for the numerical approximation of the quantile hedging problem
summary: We analyse numerical approximations of quantile hedging in complete linear markets with Markovian diffusion dynamics. The problem is formulated as stochastic control for an augmented state $(X,P)$, where the probability martingale $P$ is constrained to $[0,1]$ and controlled through an unbounded volatility coefficient. We combine control truncation with piecewise-constant policy time-stepping (PCPT), stopping controls continuously upon boundary hitting to preserve the state constraint. Using one-step dynamic programming principles and regularisation, we derive a generator inequality and explicit value-function error bounds. Under standard coefficient regularity and a Lipschitz payoff, optimising the truncation and regularisation parameters yields an error exponent arbitrarily close to $1/8$ from below, uniformly in the probability variable. For controls bounded from the outset, we obtain exponents arbitrarily close to $1/4$ from below, approaching the exponent established by Jakobsen, Picarelli and Reisinger without state constraints. We also implement a fully discrete scheme with neural-network controls. Grid-time projection onto $[0,1]$ introduces a martingale defect and a pricing bias. We quantify this bias in a toy problem and mitigate it using a state-dependent control bound. Experiments in Black--Scholes and Lipschitz local-volatility models illustrate the correction and the decrease in pricing errors under grid refinement.
